senses.text: 为支持某一主张而摆出的一整套理由与证据（a strong case that… 支持…的有力论据；make the case that… 论证、主张…）；SAT 阅读正确选项里的高频抽象义
as is / was the case（…的情况也是如此）、in this case（在这种情况下）、in most cases（多数情况下）、in any case（无论如何）
in each case（在每一个案例中）、case study（个案研究）；法律语境另指「诉讼案件」

kin: make the case that… / as is the case / in each case — 高频固定搭配：义项随搭配在「论点 / 情形 / 案例」之间切换，不可一律译成「案例」
note: 易误读警示 — 绝大多数学生把 a strong case 读成「一个有力的案例」，但此处 case ≈ argument / evidence，义为「论据、理由」，误读会把整个正确选项理解反。词形极常见，但这一抽象书面义属高阶用法，正是收词理由。

ex.src: 卷 2009 · Module M2 · Q9 · 正确选项 A
ex.en: Support can be found for a strong case that either Hamilton or Madison was the sole author of "The Senate."
ex.zh: 无论主张《参议院》的唯一作者是汉密尔顿还是麦迪逊，都能找到支持这一论点的有力论据。——正是双方各有强证据、彼此矛盾，才使作者归属难以定案。

ex.src: 卷 2023 · Module M1 · Q4 · 补充语境
ex.en: Economists have long observed that firms in related industries tend to cluster in the same area, as is the case in Leeds, UK, where many thread and yarn spinning firms as well as textile weaving firms are located.
ex.zh: 经济学家早就注意到，相关行业的企业往往聚集在同一地区——英国利兹就是如此：许多纱线纺织企业与织物织造企业都设在当地。

senses.text: （哲学 / 社会学核心义）自主行动、作出选择并影响结果的能力；真题常与 constrain / give / deny 搭配
政府部门或代理机构（Environmental Protection Agency）；SAT 常以此常见义作干扰项
by the agency of 借助……的力量；through human agency 通过人的作为

ex.en: Japa Pallikkathayil has advanced one answer by appealing to a duty to respect others’ agential interests: the possession of false beliefs constrains agency, and thus we ought not to impede the formation of true beliefs unless doing so prevents a greater constraint on someone’s agency or an otherwise impermissible end.
ex.zh: 贾帕·帕利卡泰尔提出了一种回答，诉诸「尊重他人能动性利益」的义务：持有虚假信念会限制能动性，因此我们不应阻碍真信念的形成，除非这样做能防止对他人能动性更大的限制，或本身就是不被允许的目的。

ex.src: 卷 2001 · Module M1 · Q8 · 补充语境
ex.en: But Nixon’s legacy is complex: he has been praised for his role in creating the Environmental Protection Agency, and he once made an attempt at reforming United States health care policy that is arguably a precursor to the Affordable Care Act, which became law during the Barack Obama administration.
ex.zh: 但尼克松的遗产是复杂的：他因在创建美国国家环境保护局（EPA）中扮演的角色而受到赞誉，而他当年对美国医疗政策的一次改革尝试，也可以说是《平价医疗法案》的先声——后者在奥巴马任内成为法律。

senses.text: 家族血统、祖先链条；可指贵族家系
生物学：maternal evolutionary lineage 母系演化支系
思想、技艺在师承或流派中的传递谱系

ex.en: Working with a large sample of honey bee specimens collected from most US states, the researchers determined that there are just three maternal evolutionary lineages in the populations: the North Mediterranean lineage, the West Mediterranean lineage, and the African lineage.
ex.mark: maternal evolutionary lineages in the populations:
ex.zh: 研究者对采集自美国大部分州的大量蜜蜂标本进行分析，确定这些种群中只有三个母系演化支系：北地中海支系、西地中海支系和非洲支系。

ex.src: 卷 2091 · Module M1 · Q8 · 补充语境
ex.en: In Rhythm Lineage, Maya Johnson, René Baptiste, and other dancers seamlessly interweave recent dance styles, including house and waacking, with elements of the Lindy Hop, a popular swing dance of the 1930s with roots in the Black American community of Harlem, New York.
ex.zh: 在《Rhythm Lineage》中，Maya Johnson、René Baptiste 等舞者将浩室舞、甩手舞等当代舞风，与林迪舞的元素无缝交织——林迪舞是 1930 年代流行的摇摆舞，植根于纽约哈莱姆的非裔美国人社区。

senses.text: 生物学：不同物种独立演化出相似性状（convergent evolution）
观点、趋势、数据逐渐走向一致；与 divergence 相对
数学：数列或级数趋近于某一极限值

ex.en: Meanwhile, Cynthia C. Steiner and colleagues have investigated how convergence occurs through different genetic mechanisms, but the relative prevalence of convergence through shared and different genetic processes is still poorly understood.
ex.mark: investigated how convergence occurs through different
ex.zh: 与此同时，Cynthia C. Steiner 及其同事研究了趋同现象如何通过不同的遗传机制发生，但经由共享遗传过程与不同遗传过程实现的趋同，其相对普遍程度仍不清楚。

ex.src: 卷 2612 · Module RW · Q11 · 补充语境
ex.en: Alvarez and colleagues have explored how convergent evolution—a phenomenon that occurs when the same trait evolves independently in two reproductively separate lineages—can result from a genetic mechanism shared by both lineages.

senses.text: 策划、组织（展览、活动）：为展览挑选并安排作品

curate ≠ create：curate 的核心是「从既有材料中挑选并编排」，不强调原创制作

ex.en: The Reckoning and Resilience (2022) exhibition at Duke University’s Nasher Museum of Art in Durham, North Carolina, was curated to feature the work of thirty North Carolina artists.
ex.zh: 在北卡罗来纳州达勒姆市杜克大学纳舍艺术博物馆举办的《清算与韧性》（2022）展览，其策展重点是呈现三十位北卡罗来纳州艺术家的作品。

ex.src: 卷 2027 · Module M2 · Q9 · 补充语境
ex.en: Such stylistic diversity is encouraged in part by the music-streaming app Spotify, whose curated playlist of hyperpop songs balances cohesion with variety.
ex.zh: 这种风格多样性部分得益于音乐流媒体应用 Spotify——它那精心编排的 hyperpop 歌单在凝聚力与多样性之间取得了平衡。

senses.text: manifest as / in 以……形式表现出来；症状、倾向的具体呈现
显而易见、无需推断的（manifest injustice 显失公平）
船舶或飞机的载货清单；与动词义区分

ex.en: Yes, the great cloud was ravelling, discovering here and there a pale and dying sky, and the sun, already down, was manifest in the livid tongues of fire darting towards the zenith, falling and darting again, ever more pale and languid, and doomed no sooner lit to be extinguished.
ex.zh: 是的，那大片云彩正在舒卷绽开，这里那里露出一角苍白垂死的天空；已沉落的太阳显形于冲天疾窜的青灰色火舌之中——落了又窜，愈发苍白无力，刚一闪亮便注定熄灭。

ex.src: 卷 2067 · Module M2 · Q12 · 补充语境
ex.en: Etta-Nkwelle posited that herding would manifest in regional peer countries converging on the same foreign currency accumulation rate regardless of each country’s observable circumstances.
ex.zh: Etta-Nkwelle 提出：「羊群效应」会表现为同一地区的伙伴国家不管各自可观察到的实际处境如何，都趋同于相同的外汇积累速率。

senses.text: （作家、艺术家）作品数量极多的
（生物）繁殖力强的； prolific 与 productive 的区别在于强调「量大且持续」

ex.en: But not all Highwaymen fully embraced this approach; for instance, though Willie Reagan was also prolific, his paintings were executed with greater attention to detail.
ex.zh: 「佛罗里达公路客」——20 世纪 50 至 60 年代活跃于佛州的一个松散而多产的风景画家群体——的作品，因反复采用同一类构图与题材（如月光下的水面、草丛密布的内陆河流）而极易辨认。

ex.src: 卷 2035 · Module M1 · Q6 · 补充语境
ex.en: Mexican architect Luis Barragan's prolific career, which spanned the 1920s to the 1980s, evolved through distinct phases.
ex.zh: 墨西哥建筑师路易斯·巴拉干多产的职业生涯横跨 1920 年代至 1980 年代，经历了若干截然不同的阶段。

senses.text: 差异；不一致；矛盾之处

kin: discrepant — adj. 有出入的；不一致的（真题：too sparse and discrepant）
discrepancy ≠ discredit — 形近异义：discredit 是「使受怀疑 / 败坏名声」

ex.en: This discrepancy is explicable in terms of OFT: the monkeys' greater reliance on vision means that higher lunar intensity benefits them more than it benefits the mice.
ex.mark: This discrepancy is explicable in terms of OFT
ex.zh: 这一差异可以用最优觅食理论（OFT）来解释：猴子对视觉的依赖更强，因此月光增强对它们的益处超过对鼠类的益处。

ex.src: 卷 2015 · Module M1 · Q5 · 补充语境
ex.en: Savoca and colleagues resolve this apparent discrepancy by pointing out that baleen whales cycle iron in the ocean, helping support phytoplankton populations, which, in turn, sustain krill populations.
ex.zh: Savoca 及同事通过指出须鲸在海洋中循环铁元素、帮助维持浮游植物种群——进而支撑磷虾种群——化解了这一明显的矛盾。

senses.text: 减轻（问题、风险、痛苦）的严重程度，mitigate a problem / risk
不是「消除」：真题里 mitigate these challenges 后仍说 success has been constrained，即只缓和未解决

ex.en: Ethicist Ingrid Robeyns argues in her work that taxes on the very wealthy should be increased so that governments will be enabled to solve problems of collective action, such as mitigating climate change.
ex.zh: 虽然缓解这些难题的新方案不断涌现——例如使用自动配送机器人——但成效仍受限制，因为会衍生出额外麻烦（如机器人须避让大量地面障碍，行进速度偏慢）。

ex.src: 卷 2022 · Module M2 · Q8 · 补充语境
ex.en: But they note that this damage can be mitigated: building vapor barriers between structural foundations and the soil can significantly reduce the effects of soil swelling and shrinking.
ex.zh: 但他们指出这种损害是可以缓解的：在地基与土壤之间修建隔汽层，能显著减轻土壤胀缩的影响。

senses.text: precursor to 某事物的雏形或早期形态
在事件发生前出现的信号（a precursor of change）
化学 / 生物：参与反应生成目标产物的起始物质

ex.en: But Nixon's legacy is complex;: he has been praised for his role in opening relations between the United States and China, and he once made an attempt at reforming United States health care policy that is arguably a precursor to the Affordable Care Act, which became law during the Barack Obama administration.
ex.mark: a precursor to the Affordable Care Act
ex.zh: 但尼克松的政治遗产是复杂的：他因推动美中关系正常化而受到赞誉，他还曾尝试改革美国医疗保障政策，那项尝试可以说是《平价医疗法案》的前身，该法案在巴拉克·奥巴马执政期间成为法律。

ex.src: 卷 2093 · Module M2 · Q21 · 补充语境
ex.en: Paris Opera Ballet dancer Marie Camargo introduced a seemingly simple innovation to the ballet world of the 1730s by removing the heels from her dance shoes, creating the precursor to today’s soft ballet slipper.
ex.zh: 巴黎歌剧院芭蕾舞者 Marie Camargo 给 1730 年代的芭蕾界带来了一项看似简单的革新——去掉舞鞋的鞋跟，由此成为今日软底芭蕾舞鞋的前身。

senses.text: 小说、戏剧中的中心人物；与 antagonist 相对
a protagonist of reform 改革的积极推动者
争议或运动中的核心人物

ex.en: Scott Fitzgerald's 1920 novel This Side of Paradise contains elements drawn from Fitzgerald's own life—there are many parallels between the experiences of the novel's protagonist, Amory Blaine, and those of Fitzgerald—and as a result This Side of Paradise is regularly described as an autobiographical novel.
ex.zh: 菲茨杰拉德 1920 年的小说《人间天堂》含有取材于他本人经历的元素——小说主人公艾默里·布莱恩的经历与菲茨杰拉德的经历有许多相似之处，因此《人间天堂》常被描述为一部自传体小说。

ex.src: 卷 2612 · Module RW · Q63 · 补充语境
ex.en: That characterization is apt—there are many parallels between the experiences of the novel’s protagonist, Jo March, and those of Alcott—but it should not be taken to mean that every person or event depicted in Little Women has a real-life analogue.

senses.text: 介导；作为…的中介而起传导 / 促成作用（X mediates Y：X 决定或传导 Y）——科研语境核心义
调解；斡旋（mediate between A and B）
构成复合形容词「X-mediated」（由 X 介导的）：microorganism-mediated cycling

kin: mediation / mediator — n. 中介作用 / 中介者（应备派生）
immediate — adj. 同根：im-（无）+ mediate，字面「无中介的」

ex.en: By persistently modifying the voice, hyperpop invites the listener to reflect on the extent to which digital technology mediates the human experience today.
ex.mark: digital technology mediates the human experience
ex.zh: 通过持续对人声进行改造，hyperpop 引导听者反思：数字技术在多大程度上中介着当今的人类经验。

ex.src: 卷 2036 · Module M2 · Q11 · 补充语境
ex.en: Subsequent investigation of potential selection mechanisms prompted the researchers to conclude that independent of avian order, the prevalence of the trait is mediated by environmental variations associated with the absolute latitude of brooding sites.
ex.zh: 对潜在选择机制的后续研究促使学者们得出结论：与鸟类目无关，该性状的普遍程度受繁殖地绝对纬度相关的环境差异所调节。

senses.text: sophisticated adj. 精密的；尖端的；老练的（真题唯一形态，29 次）
科技语境多指「精密的、技术含量高的」；形容人则指「老练的、有品味的」，均非贬义
使复杂化；使变得老练

kin: sophistication — n. 精密（程度）；老练
sophistication ≠ sophistry — 后者是「诡辩」，贬义，形近异义

ex.en: The British Bronze Age began when sophisticated techniques for making tools, weapons, and other objects from metal were introduced to the British Isles around 2500 BCE, and it lasted until around 700 BCE.
ex.zh: 英国青铜时代始于约公元前 2500 年——当时用金属制造工具、武器及其他器物的精密技术传入不列颠群岛——一直延续到约公元前 700 年。

ex.src: 卷 2064 · Module M2 · Q16 · 补充语境
ex.en: Studies conducted in individual Western societies have demonstrated associations between personality traits and five musical factors (mellowness, unpretentiousness, sophistication, intensity, and contemporariness) underlying individual preferences for styles of Western music.
ex.zh: 在西方单一社会中进行的研究已证明：人格特质与偏好西方音乐风格的个体差异背后的五个音乐因子（柔和、朴实、精致、强度、当代性）之间存在关联。

senses.text: 对进口商品征收的税，常与 quota 并考（impose tariffs, eliminate tariffs）
英式用法：旅馆、服务的收费表

ex.en: In a 2021 report, economist Jayson Beckman modeled global market prices of several agricultural commodities under both the TFA and an alternative trade-reform scenario: removal of agricultural tariffs (taxes on imports that generally increase prices on imported goods).
ex.zh: 经济学家 Jayson Beckman 在 2021 年的一份报告中建模比较了几种农产品的全球市场价格：一种情形是《贸易便利化协定》（TFA），另一种是替代性贸易改革方案——取消农业关税（关税即对进口商品征收的税，通常会抬高进口商品的价格）。

ex.src: 卷 2035 · Module M1 · Q12 · 补充语境
ex.en: To measure whether countries in free trade agreements (FTAs)—agreements among nations to reduce tariffs, duties, and other trade barriers—experience changes in total agricultural exports, economist Kayode Ajewole and colleagues calculated average export growth rates for several countries over the five years before and the five years after entering an FTA with the United States.
ex.zh: 为衡量签署自由贸易协定（FTA——国家间降低关税及其他贸易壁垒的协定）的国家农产品出口总额是否变化，经济学家 Kayode Ajewole 及同事计算了多个国家与美国签订 FTA 前后各五年的平均出口增长率。

senses.text: 生物 / 环境语境：某处栖息或含有大量物种、物质（harbors great biodiversity）

法律语境：为他人或违禁物提供藏身之处
harbor seal 港海豹

ex.en: With its distinct water chemistry, temperature, and life-forms, the HZ harbors great biodiversity, including microbes that play a key role in regulating trace element removal and other critical ecological processes.
ex.mark: the HZ harbors great biodiversity, including
ex.zh: 凭借独特的水化学、温度和生命形态，该热液区孕育着丰富的生物多样性，包括在调控微量元素去除等关键生态过程中发挥作用的微生物。

ex.src: 卷 2012 · Module M2 · Q9 · 补充语境
ex.en: In a paper for an art history class, a student claims that Agnes Martin's 1957 painting Harbor Number 1 marks a significant change in Martin's artistic development.
ex.zh: 在一篇艺术史课程论文中，一位学生主张：Agnes Martin 1957 年的画作《港口一号》标志着她艺术发展的重大转变。

senses.text: （金属器物、钱币的）窖藏；一批埋藏的珍宝
囤积；贮藏（hoard food / information）

kin: hoard ≠ horde — 同音异义经典陷阱：horde 是「一大群人 / 游牧部落」
a hoard of artifacts — 一批器物窖藏——真题搭配

ex.en: Collections of metal items (called hoards) from all periods of the Bronze Age have been found in Britain, including the Llanarmon-yn-lal hoard of artifacts from the 16th century BCE, unearthed around 1982, and the much later Horsehope Craig hoard of artifacts from the 7th century BCE, unearthed around 1865.
ex.zh: 在英国已发现各个时期青铜时代的金属器物收藏（称为「窖藏」），包括约 1982 年出土的公元前 16 世纪 Llanarmon-yn-lal 器物窖藏，以及年代晚得多、约 1865 年出土的公元前 7 世纪 Horsehope Craig 器物窖藏。

ex.src: 卷 2010 · Module M1 · Q15 · 补充语境
ex.en: For hoards discovered since the 1960s, such as the 1965 discovery of the Walderslade hoard, advancements like inexpensive metal detectors, ground penetrating radar, and aerial surveys have made it much easier for searchers to locate hoards before putting the first shovel in the ground.
ex.zh: 对 1960 年代以后发现的窖藏（如 1965 年发现的 Walderslade 窖藏）而言，廉价金属探测器、探地雷达与航空勘测等进步，使寻宝者在动第一铲之前就更容易定位窖藏。

ex.src: 卷 2038 · Module M2 · Q8 · 补充语境
ex.en: Note "putatively": as Gavin Kennedy has shown, Smith deploys this metaphor only once in his economic writings—to make a narrow point about the then-dominant economic theory of mercantilism—​​​​​​​and it was largely ignored until some twentieth-century economists eager to secure an intellectual pedigree for their views elevated it to a fully-fledged paradigm.
ex.zh: 注意「所谓」二字：正如 Gavin Kennedy 所证实的，斯密在其经济学著述中仅使用过这一隐喻一次——只为就当时占主导的重商主义理论提出一个狭隘论点——此后它基本无人问津，直到二十世纪一些急于为自己的观点寻找思想谱系的经济学家，才把它抬升为羽翼丰满的范式。

senses.text: 高于标准价的部分（pay a premium for organic produce）；品牌权益常表现为 price premium
保险语境：投保人按期缴纳的保费；policyholder 即投保人
作定语表示高端版本（premium version, premium service）
at a premium 稀缺而昂贵；put a premium on 重视

ex.en: Luis Aguiar studied the effect of the 2011 implementation of a restriction on the free version of the French streaming service Deezer: its unlimited usage was reduced to five hours a month, while the paid premium version’s usage remained unlimited.
ex.mark: the paid premium version’s usage remained
ex.zh: 路易斯·阿吉亚尔研究了 2011 年法国流媒体服务 Deezer 对免费版实施限制的效果：其无限使用时长被削减到每月五小时，而付费高级版的时长则保持不限。

ex.src: 卷 2056 · Module M1 · Q14 · 补充语境
ex.en: Mariana Lopes Barata and Pedro Simões Coelho collected data from 324 music-streaming service users to identify factors that influence users to opt for paid (premium) versions of music streaming services, like Apple Music.
ex.zh: Mariana Lopes Barata 与 Pedro Simões Coelho 收集了 324 名音乐流媒体服务用户的数据，以识别影响用户选择付费（premium）版本服务的因素。

senses.text: 阻碍；妨碍（进展、运动、视线）
im-（在内）+ ped（脚）→ 绊住脚

kin: impediment — n. 障碍；（言语）障碍、口吃
impede ≠ impel — 形近而方向相反：impel 是「推动、促使」

ex.en: Creeping dogwood (Cornus canadensis) plants are native to Alaska, where harsh conditions have historically impeded potential invasive species.
ex.mark: harsh conditions have historically impeded potential invasive species
ex.zh: 草茱萸（Cornus canadensis）原产于阿拉斯加，那里严酷的环境条件历来阻挡了潜在的入侵物种。

ex.src: 卷 2035 · Module M2 · Q15 · 补充语境
ex.en: The morphological novelty of echinoderms—marine invertebrates with radial symmetry, usually starlike, around a central point—impedes comparisons with most other animals, in which bilateral symmetry on an anterior-posterior (head to tail) axis through a trunk is typical.
ex.zh: 棘皮动物——具辐射对称（通常呈星形、围绕中心点）的海洋无脊椎动物——的形态学新奇性，妨碍了与多数其他动物的比较；后者典型特征是躯干沿前后（头到尾）轴的两侧对称。

senses.text: 可量化的可能性（a 99.7% probability that… 有 99.7% 的概率……；the probability of success 成功概率）——SAT 科学 / 统计类篇章高频
probable（很可能的）+ -ility；反义 improbability
probability 可量化（带百分比或 0–1 数值，真题 0.20 / 99.7% 皆如此）；possibility 只问「有没有可能」，不谈大小，真题多作 to test / evaluate this possibility（待检验的假设）。中文都可译「可能性」，但 probability 更近「概率、几率」

kin: possibility — 对照词 · 真题亦现 70+ 次（the possibility that… / to evaluate this possibility）——泛指可能性，不带数值
probabilities — 复数形态 · 真题 1 次（multiple probabilities 多种概率取值）

ex.en: if you flip a coin 1,000 times, there is a 99.7% probability that the coin will land heads side up between 450 and 550 times.
ex.zh: 抛一枚硬币 1000 次，正面朝上的次数落在 450 到 550 次之间的概率（probability）为 99.7%。

ex.src: 卷 2048 · Module M1 · Q14 · possibility 对照例句 · 补充语境
ex.en: It has been suggested that warming-induced delays in the onset of subfreezing temperatures in autumn can benefit invasives more than native species; to evaluate this possibility, biologists Christa Mulder and Katie Spellman tracked V. edule and P. aviculare, along with other native and invasive species, over several years, concluding that invasives are advantaged by delays in subfreezing temperature onset in Alaska.
ex.zh: 有观点认为，秋季零下温度来临的推迟对入侵物种的益处大于本地物种；为检验这一可能性（possibility），生物学家 Christa Mulder 与 Katie Spellman 连续多年追踪两种植物及其他本地、入侵物种，最终得出结论：在阿拉斯加，入侵物种确实因零下温度的推迟而获益。

senses.text: 把已有资源当作筹码来达成目的（leverage its brand recognition）
金融语境：以借贷放大收益（financial leverage, high leverage）
谈判或政治语境：可动用的支配力（political leverage）

ex.en: The Virgin Group's introduction of the Virgin Atlantic airline in 1984 is an instance of brand extension—the company leveraged its brand recognition as a music retailer to enter a product category where it had not previously competed.
ex.mark: extension—the company leveraged its brand recognition
ex.zh: 维珍集团 1984 年推出维珍大西洋航空，是品牌延伸的一例——公司利用其作为音乐零售商的品牌知名度，进入了一个此前并未参与的品类。

ex.src: 卷 2068 · Module M1 · Q21 · 补充语境
ex.en: In his 2023 collection The Diaspora Sonnets, Filipino American poet Oliver de la Paz leverages the sonnet form’s “diamond-like quality of precision,” as he describes it.
ex.zh: 在 2023 年的诗集《离散十四行诗》中，菲律宾裔美国诗人 Oliver de la Paz 借用了十四行诗体「钻石般的精准质地」（他自己的说法）。

senses.text: 对税款、罚款或费用强制收取（fines levied against offenders 对违法者课以罚款；a levy on imports 进口税）
拉丁 levare（举升）→ levy 征收 / 动员（levy troops 征兵）；→ lever 杠杆 → leverage 杠杆作用 / 借力利用（leveraged its brand recognition 借品牌认知度）；→ elevate 举升、提升——四词同根，义随词形分化
levy 强调「强制收取」；同根 leverage 强调「借力打力」，切勿因形近而混

kin: leveraged — 同根 leverage 的真题形态 · 7 次（the company leveraged its brand recognition——品牌延伸类篇章高频）
leverage — 同根词 · 真题另见 2 次（n./v. 借助、杠杆作用）——按老师规则并入本词条，不单独立条
levied — 本词真题形态 · 1 次（levied against high-profile offenders）

ex.en: Moreover, enforcement was generally limited to fines, which, when levied against high‑profile offenders, were widely announced.
ex.zh: 此外，执法通常仅限于罚款；而当罚款针对的是高知名度违法者时，往往会被广泛报道。

ex.src: 卷 2047 · Module M2 · Q9 · 补充语境
ex.en: The Lego Group's introduction of the Legoland theme park in 1968 is a quintessential instance of brand extension—the company leveraged its brand recognition as a toy manufacturer to enter a product category where it had not previously competed.
ex.zh: 乐高集团 1968 年推出乐高乐园主题公园，是品牌延伸的典型范例——公司借助（leveraged）其作为玩具制造商的品牌认知度，进入了此前从未涉足的产品类别。

senses.text: 经济语境：收入超过支出，或产量超过需求（budget surplus, surplus goods）
作定语：超出所需（surplus labor, surplus value）

ex.en: John Iliffe and other Africanist scholars have shown, however, that in parts of Africa, surplus capital accrual, the existence of salaried labor, and other features of capitalism predated colonization.
ex.zh: 然而，克里斯莱恩·阿尔法加利等非洲研究学者已经表明，在非洲部分地区，雇工竞争、为货币化销售而进行的剩余商品生产，以及资本主义的其他特征，都早于殖民时期就已存在。

ex.src: 卷 2109 · Module M1 · Q7 · 补充语境
ex.en: While people who pursue other art forms—sculpture, film, theater—require large blocks of uninterrupted time as well as money to complete their work, poets can write, as Lorde said, "between shifts, in the hospital pantry, on the subway, and on scraps of surplus paper."So poets can make worthwhile art even if they must earn their living in another way.
ex.zh: 从事其他艺术形式——雕塑、电影、戏剧——的人需要大段不被打断的时间和金钱才能完成作品，而诗人却可以像 Lorde 说的那样「在轮班之间、在医院配餐间、在地铁上、在多余的纸片上」写作。因此，即便诗人必须另谋生计，也能创作出有价值的艺术。

senses.text: 高度赞扬；推崇（常用被动 be acclaimed / widely acclaimed）
赞誉；喝彩（critical acclaim 评论界的赞誉）

kin: acclaimed — adj. 备受赞誉的——真题唯一形态，15 次
acclamation — n. 欢呼拥戴（一致口头通过）

ex.en: Her acclaimed 2019 young adult novel Ghost Bird is set in a Murri community in Queensland, Australia.
ex.zh: 她 2019 年广受好评的青少年小说《幽灵鸟》以澳大利亚昆士兰的一个 Murri 社群为背景。

ex.src: 卷 2071 · Module M1 · Q5 · 补充语境
ex.en: The Marsalis family is often referred to as "the first family of jazz. " Four of the children of celebrated pianist Ellis Marsalis Jr. went on to become performers who are also critically acclaimed: drummer Jason, trombonist Delfeayo, saxophonist Branford, and trumpeter Wynton.
ex.zh: Marsalis 一家常被称为「爵士乐第一家庭」：著名钢琴家 Ellis Marsalis Jr. 的四个孩子后来都成为广受好评的演奏家——鼓手 Jason、长号手 Delfeayo、萨克斯手 Branford 和小号手 Wynton。

senses.text: 类似的；可类比的（analogous to / with X）
同功的——功能相似但起源不同，与 homologous「同源的」相对

kin: analogy — n. 类比；by analogy with 依…类推
analogue — n. 类似物；adj. 模拟的（与 digital 相对）

ex.en: Probabilistic models generate predictions based on outcomes of analogous past events, but even as these models project likely outcomes, they implicitly acknowledge that lower-frequency events may occur instead.
ex.zh: 历史学家与传记作者所传达的那种知识，类似于我们借地图获得的对一个国家的认识——也许细致、准确，足以应付一切实际需要，但冰冷而干瘪，全然没有风景画所营造的那种摹仿性的魅力。

ex.src: 卷 2102 · Module M2 · Q5 · 补充语境
ex.en: Weitz assessed these trade-offs by comparing vascular function in the reticulate patterns of Alchornea ilicifolia (native holly) and other angiosperm leaf veins with that of analogous open-branching patterns.
ex.zh: Weitz 通过比较 Alchornea ilicifolia（冬青）等被子植物叶片网状脉序与类似的开放分支脉序的维管功能，来评估这些利弊权衡。

senses.text: 锻打金属用的砧台；亦指耳内听小骨之一（砧骨）
诗中 the lack of anvil and strife 以「无砧（无劳作、无争斗）」写心境之宁静，SAT 文学题常考具体名词的抽象转喻

ex.en: We trekked into a far country,My friend and I. Our deeper content was never spoken,But each knew all the other said. He told me how calm his soul was laidBy the lack of anvil and strife. “The wooing kestrel,” I said, “mutes his mating-noteTo please the harmony of this sweet silence.”
ex.zh: 我们跋涉进入一片遥远的乡野，我与我的友人。我们更深的心事从未说出口，但彼此都懂对方未言之意。他告诉我，因无砧无争，他的灵魂是何等安宁静穆。

ex.src: 卷 2063 · Module M1 · Q8 · 补充语境
ex.en: By using fixed stones as anvils, tool-using otters gained access to high-quality, hard-shelled prey (e.g., mussels and clams) that they could usually not access through biting alone.
ex.zh: 借助固定石块作砧，会使用工具的水獭得以获取通常无法单靠撕咬打开的优质硬壳猎物（如贻贝和蛤蜊）。

senses.text: 与档案、文献收藏有关的（archival information / records）
archive n. 档案 → archival adj.；注意与 archaeological（考古的）区分

ex.en: In her exhibition Strike Gulf, she interrogated the impact of the oil and gas industry on southern Louisiana (where she grew up), incorporating core samples from deep seabeds off the Louisiana coast, oil well data, archival information about oil boycotts, and video she took in New Orleans.
ex.mark: well data, archival information about oil
ex.zh: 在《Strike Gulf》展览中，她审视油气产业对南路易斯安那（她长大的地方）的影响，作品纳入了路易斯安那近海深部海床的岩芯样本、油井数据、关于石油抵制运动的档案资料，以及她在新奥尔良拍摄的影像。

ex.src: 卷 2022 · Module M2 · Q9 · 补充语境
ex.en: One reason for this discrepancy is that historians of capitalism tend to focus on longitudinal economic data drawn from archival records, which do not exist for much of precolonial Africa.
ex.zh: 造成这种差异的一个原因是：资本主义史学家倾向于关注取自档案记录的纵向经济数据，而前殖民时代的非洲大部分地区并不存在这类记录。

senses.text: 某一领域中被反复使用、带有预设的言说方式（paleontological discourse, public discourse）
语言学语境：大于句子的连贯语言单位（discourse analysis）
正式地论述（discourse on the nature of beauty）

ex.en: A debate in paleontological discourse focuses on whether ancient pandas first emerged in Asia before migrating to Europe, or vice versa.
ex.mark: in paleontological discourse focuses on whether
ex.zh: 古生物学界的一场争论聚焦于：古代熊猫究竟是先出现在亚洲再迁往欧洲，还是相反。

senses.text: 离群索居、独处修行的人
真题以 stripe-throated hermits 出现，指「隐蜂鸟」类 hummingbird；专名中的普通词常是 SAT 词义题考点

ex.en: High-reward flowers that produce nectar with relatively high sugar concentrations are thought to be especially attractive to stripe-throated hermits and other hummingbird species.
ex.mark: to stripe-throated hermits and other hummingbird
ex.zh: 糖分浓度较高的高回报花蜜型花朵，被认为对条纹喉隐蜂鸟及其他蜂鸟种类尤其具有吸引力。

ex.src: 卷 2084 · Module M1 · Q9 · 补充语境
ex.en: Biologists Louise Roberts and Mark Laidre noticed that hermit crabs sometimes vibrate their shells and wondered if they do this to scare away other crabs.
ex.zh: 生物学家 Louise Roberts 和 Mark Laidre 注意到寄居蟹有时会震动自己的壳，并猜想它们这样做是为了吓退其他螃蟹。

senses.text: 微生物（显微镜下才可见的生物体）
micro-（微小）+ organism（生物体）

kin: microbe — n. 微生物——同义，真题另现 10 次
microorganism-mediated — adj. 微生物介导的——真题复合形容词

ex.en: Microorganism-mediated nutrient cycling was accelerated in the transplanted cores; crucially, microorganism community composition was unchanged, allowing Kastovska et al. to attribute the acceleration to temperature-induced increases in microorganism activity.
ex.zh: 在被移植的土芯中，由微生物介导的养分循环被加快了；关键在于微生物群落构成并未改变，这使得 Kastovska 等人得以把这种加快归因于温度上升带来的微生物活性提高。

ex.src: 卷 2085 · Module M2 · Q13 · 补充语境
ex.en: Just like household dust on Earth, dust on the International Space Station (ISS) harbors hundreds of common microorganisms—Aspergillus hongkongensis and other fungi, along with bacteria, such as Staphylococcus pettenkoferi.
ex.zh: 正如地球上的家居灰尘一样，国际空间站（ISS）上的灰尘也藏有数百种常见微生物——包括 Aspergillus hongkongensis 等真菌，以及 Staphylococcus pettenkoferi 等细菌。

senses.text: （艺术、建筑）现代主义风格的；主张功能优先、拒绝传统装饰
modernist n. 现代主义者；与 functionalist 并置时强调「形式服从功能」

ex.en: As can be seen in the case of Others, a New York magazine published from July 1915 to July 1919, some small periodicals influential in the development of the modernist movement have been explored in depth by scholars.
ex.zh: 正如《Others》一例所见——这本纽约杂志从 1915 年 7 月出版至 1919 年 7 月——一些对现代主义运动的发展颇有影响的小型期刊，已得到学者们的深入探究。

ex.src: 卷 2029 · Module M1 · Q16 · 补充语境
ex.en: King were among the 300 artists who exhibited at the 1913 Armory Show, a groundbreaking New York City art exhibition that introduced modernism to American audiences.
ex.zh: King 等人均属于 1913 年军械库展的 300 位参展艺术家——这场开创性的纽约艺术展把现代主义介绍给了美国观众。

senses.text: （问卷、调查的）应答者；受访者
（上诉案件的）被上诉人

kin: respond / response — v. 回答 / n. 回应
respondent ≠ correspondent — 形近异义：correspondent 是「通讯员、记者」

ex.en: It may be tempting to assume the difference is due to different levels of access to parks; however, given that the percentage of Caracas respondents who reported living within a 10-minute walk of a park was much lower than that reported by Fortaleza respondents, greater proximity alone can’t explain the difference in park use.
ex.mark: Caracas respondents who reported living within a 10-minute walk
ex.zh: 人们很容易假定这一差异源于接触公园的机会不同；然而，鉴于加拉加斯报告「住在距公园步行 10 分钟范围内」的受访者比例远低于福塔莱萨的受访者，单靠「距离更近」是解释不通的。

ex.src: 卷 2083 · Module M2 · Q15 · 补充语境
ex.en: The statements are categorized as relevant to one of six topics—e.g., statement 37, "I like when packages delivered to me are tightly packed," is categorized as relevant to the topic of visual appeal—and respondents rate the importance of each statement to their experience.
ex.zh: 这些陈述被归入六个主题之一——例如第 37 条「我喜欢送到我手中的包裹被塞得紧紧实实」被归入「视觉吸引力」主题——受访者对每条陈述对其体验的重要程度打分。

senses.text: 政策与商业语境：受某项决定影响的个人或群体（stakeholders in urban agriculture）
金融语境：持有公司股份者；与 shareholder 常可互换

ex.en: Esther Sanye-Mengual, Kathrin Specht, and their team surveyed three groups of people in Bologna, Italy— leaders of urban agriculture projects, stakeholders in urban agriculture (e.g., food researchers and urban farming associations), and the general public—to compare their views about the extent to which urban agriculture contributes to 25 social or ecological services that the team identified.
ex.mark: agriculture projects, stakeholders in urban agriculture
ex.zh: 埃丝特·桑耶-门瓜尔、卡特琳·施佩希特及其团队调查了意大利博洛尼亚的三类人群——城市农业项目的负责人、城市农业的利益相关方（如食品研究者和城市农艺协会）以及普通公众——以比较他们对城市农业在多大程度上促成各项社会或生态服务的看法。

ex.src: 卷 2056 · Module M2 · Q9 · 补充语境
ex.en: Using only the rankings shown in the table, a city planner in Bologna who is promoting a new urban agriculture project concludes that advertisements aimed at stakeholders should emphasize the project's benefit to the enhancement of pollination.
ex.zh: 仅凭表中所示的排名，博洛尼亚一位正在推广新城市农业项目的城市规划者得出结论：面向利益相关方的宣传应强调该项目对促进授粉的益处。

senses.text: 方案、商业模式在现实中能运转（a viable alternative）
生物学：种子能发芽、胚胎能发育（viable seeds）
经济 / 生态：能自我维持、不依赖外部输血

ex.en: The technology, while generating lots of interest, is not yet commercially viable as a large-scale energy source.
ex.zh: 这项技术虽然备受关注，但作为大规模能源尚不具备商业可行性。

ex.src: 卷 2078 · Module M2 · Q6 · 补充语境
ex.en: In 2022, Guillermo Restrepo calculated the historical rates at which newly discovered compounds have entered the scientific literature, expanding the “chemical space.” Using a conservative estimate of the number of viable compounds and assuming a doubling of the historical pace of discovery, Restrepo found that under these hypothetical conditions, all potential compounds could be synthesized and documented by 2050.
ex.zh: 2022 年，Guillermo Restrepo 计算了新发现的化合物进入科学文献、从而拓展「化学空间」的历史速率。采用对可行化合物数量的保守估计，并假设发现速度翻倍，Restrepo 发现在这些假设条件下，所有潜在化合物都可在 2050 年前被合成并记录。

senses.text: （常用复数）生活便利设施；福利设施（neighborhood amenities）
舒适；宜人（the amenity of a place）

kin: amenities — n.（复数）便利设施——真题 18 次全为复数
amenity ≠ amnesty — 形近异义：amnesty 是「大赦」

ex.en: This approach has some limits—data from Places API tend to be restricted to places that are customer facing—but the data set nonetheless provides an extremely reliable source to study colocation patterns of neighborhood amenities.
ex.zh: 这一方法有某些局限——来自 Places API 的数据往往只覆盖面向顾客的场所——但该数据集仍不失为研究社区便利设施空间共置模式的极其可靠的来源。

ex.src: 卷 2048 · Module M1 · Q10 · 补充语境
ex.en: Vancouver has high pedestrian traffic, but other cities cannot increase their pedestrian traffic simply by replicating a single feature of Vancouver—e.g., its high number of pedestrian amenities—that is associated with walkability.
ex.zh: 温哥华行人流量很高，但其他城市无法仅靠复制温哥华的单一特征（如与步行友好性相关的密集步行设施）来提高自己的行人流量。

senses.text: 作者身份；（作品的）作者归属
写作（活动）；著述

kin: author — n. 作者 / v. 创作（真题也作动词：a study authored by…）
authorial — adj. 作者的（authorial intent 作者意图）

ex.en: Though the authorship of most of the individual essays is certain, that of a few is in question: for instance, while No. 37, "Concerning the Difficulties of the Convention in Devising a Proper Form of Government," was surely penned by Madison, No. 62, "The Senate," may have been written by either Hamilton or Madison.
ex.mark: the authorship of most of the individual essays is certain
ex.zh: 尽管大多数单篇文章的作者归属是确定的，仍有几篇存疑：例如，虽然第 37 篇《关于制宪会议设计恰当政府形式之困难》无疑出自麦迪逊之手，第 62 篇《参议院》则可能由汉密尔顿或麦迪逊所写。

ex.src: 卷 2017 · Module M2 · Q27 · 补充语境
ex.en: In a 1963 rebuttal, film critic Pauline Kael argued that film authorship should be shared among screenwriters, directors, and others involved in the filmmaking process..
ex.zh: 在 1963 年的一篇反驳文章中，影评人 Pauline Kael 主张：电影的作者身份应由编剧、导演及其他参与制片过程的人共享。

senses.text: 法律与监管语境：遵守规定、标准或法律（regulatory compliance testing）
心理与行为语境：按他人要求行事；与 conformity 近义，但更强调对规则的服从

ex.en: While bioaccumulation of manufactured nanoparticles may be inherently worrisome, it has been hypothesized that CeO2-NP bioaccumulation in invertebrates like D. polymorpha could serve as a valuable proxy, obviating the need for manufacturers to conduct costly and intrusive sampling of vertebrate species such as rainbow trout (Oncorhynchus mykiss), commonly used in regulatory compliance testing for manipulative bioaccumulation, as environmental protection laws currently require.
ex.zh: 虽然人造纳米颗粒的生物累积本身可能令人担忧，但有人假设，这类纳米颗粒在无脊椎动物体内的累积可以作为有价值的替代指标，使制造商无需再对虹鳟等脊椎动物进行昂贵而具侵入性的取样——这类取样常用于法规合规性检测中的操控性生物累积评估，因为环保法目前有此要求。

ex.src: 卷 2046 · Module M2 · Q12 · 补充语境
ex.en: … commonly used in regulatory compliance testing—for nanoparticle bioaccumulation, as environmental protection laws currently require.
ex.zh: ……常用于监管合规测试——用于纳米颗粒生物累积检测，正如现行环保法律所要求的那样。

senses.text: 彼此分离、各自独立的（discrete units / texts）
与 discreet（谨慎的）同音异义、极易混淆；也区别于 concrete（具体的）

ex.en: But other critics argue that the books should not be thought of as discrete texts with traditional beginnings and endings but as a single incredibly long work, similar to other multivolume stories, such as Anthony Powell's A Dance to the Music of Time.
ex.mark: of as discrete texts with traditional
ex.zh: 但另一些批评者主张，这些书不应被视为有传统开头与结尾的独立文本，而应看作一部极其漫长的整体作品，类似《随之起舞》这类多卷本小说。

senses.text: 散布；传播；分散（种子、个体、种群）
seed dispersal 种子传播——真题核心搭配

kin: disperse — v. 散布；消散（真题另现）
dispersion — n. 分散；离差（真题另现 6 次）

ex.en: Scientists have proposed several possible explanations: fewer species of soil fungi available at the northern edges of the trees’ habitat, physical barriers blocking seed dispersal, or deer overgrazing preventing new trees from establishing.
ex.zh: 科学家提出了几种可能的解释：树木栖息地北缘可利用的土壤真菌种类较少、物理屏障阻断了种子传播，或是鹿的过度啃食使新树无法成活。

ex.src: 卷 2099 · Module M2 · Q9 · 补充语境
ex.en: Fortes-Lima and colleagues hypothesized that the Bantu expansion—the dispersal starting 4,000–5,000 ya of Bantu-speaking peoples (BSP) from an ancestral homeland in West-Central Africa across sub-Saharan Africa—followed the same pattern.
ex.zh: Fortes-Lima 及同事假设：班图扩张——约四五千年前，讲班图语的民族从中西非的祖居地扩散至撒哈拉以南非洲——也遵循同样的模式。

senses.text: 可解释的；可说明的（able to be accounted for）
explicable in terms of X「可从 X 的角度加以解释」——真题 100% 落在这一个句型上

kin: inexplicable — adj. 无法解释的——反义派生，GRE / SAT 常考
explicable ≠ explicit — 形近异义：explicit 是「明确的」

ex.en: Joel Brown and colleagues showed that high moonlight intensity inhibits the activity of the Arizona pocket mouse (Perognathus amplus), a result explicable in terms of benefits and costs: greater lunar intensity may not enable the mice to increase foraging success enough to offset the higher chance of detection by predatory owls or hawks.
ex.zh: Joel Brown 及同事表明，月光强度高会抑制亚利桑那囊鼠（Perognathus amplus）的活动，这一结果可从收益与成本的角度解释：更强的月光未必能让囊鼠把觅食成功率提高到足以抵消被捕食性猫头鹰或鹰隼发现的更高风险。

ex.src: 卷 2612 · Module RW · Q36 · 补充语境
ex.en: This discrepancy is explicable in terms of OFT: the lemurs’ greater reliance on vision means that higher lunar intensity benefits them more than it benefits the jackrabbits.

senses.text: 纵向的；跨时段的（对同一对象长期追踪，longitudinal study / data）
经度的（与 latitudinal「纬度的」相对）

kin: longitude — n. 经度
longitudinal ≠ cross-sectional — 纵向研究 vs 横断面研究——社科阅读常见对照

ex.en: But it is much more expensive to conduct a longitudinal study like the Household, Income and Labour Dynamics in Australia Survey (HILDA), which looks at data for 25,000 people in Australia to find trends in economic well-being that can take a long time to develop.
ex.zh: 但开展像澳大利亚「家庭、收入与劳动力动态」调查（HILDA）这样的纵向研究要昂贵得多——该调查追踪澳大利亚 25,000 人的数据，用以发现需要很长时间才能显现的经济福祉趋势。

ex.src: 卷 2002 · Module M1 · Q10 · 补充语境
ex.en: As with most longitudinal studies, extensive funding support is needed for SAGE to collect the relevant data over timescales and at intervals that will support robust conclusions.
ex.zh: 与多数纵向研究一样，SAGE 需要大量的经费支持，才能在足以支撑可靠结论的时间尺度和时间间隔上收集相关数据。

senses.text: 软体动物（螺、贝、章鱼等）
moll-（软的）+ -usc

kin: molluscan — adj. 软体动物的
crustacean / arthropod — n. 甲壳类 / n. 节肢动物——真题并列类群词
ammonite — n. 菊石——真题与 mollusk 同现

ex.en: With a shell that measured 1.7 meters, the extinct mollusk Parapuzosia seppenradensis is the largest ammonite in the fossil record.
ex.zh: 壳长达1.7米的已灭绝软体动物 Parapuzosia seppenradensis，是化石记录中最大的菊石。

ex.src: 卷 2014 · Module M2 · Q11 · 补充语境
ex.en: Over time, marine mollusks called nautilids continually add segments to their shells, and the chemical composition of each segment is influenced by the available materials in the surrounding water when the segment forms.
ex.zh: 随着时间的推移，被称为鹦鹉螺类的海洋软体动物会不断向壳体添加新环节，而每一环节的化学组成都受该环节形成时周围水中可用物质的影响。

senses.text: 细微差别；微妙之处（意义、情感、色彩上的）
使有细微差别；细致地处理

kin: nuanced — adj. 有细微差别的；精细入微的——真题 4 次
nuance ≠ nuisance — 形近异义：nuisance 是「讨厌的人 / 麻烦事」

ex.en: The popularity of ningyo joruri was due to a puppetry method called sannin zukai, in which three puppeteers operated a single puppet that was large, detailed, and capable of extensive movement and nuanced emotional expression.
ex.mark: capable of extensive movement and nuanced emotional expression
ex.zh: 人偶净琉璃（ningyo joruri）之所以受欢迎，得益于一种名为「三人遣」（sannin zukai）的木偶操纵法：三名操纵者共同操控一个体积大、做工细的木偶，使其能做出大幅动作与细腻的情感表达。

ex.src: 卷 2075 · Module M1 · Q6 · 补充语境
ex.en: Moving beyond a simple “present or absent” designation, researchers created a new classification system that allows for a nuanced understanding of bioluminescence in marine organisms that was unavailable under binary classification systems.
ex.zh: 研究者超越了简单的「有 / 无」二分，建立了一套新的分类系统，从而对海洋生物的生物发光形成二元分类体系下不可能有的细腻理解。

senses.text: 提供推力、驱动向前的（propulsive beats 指节奏强劲、推着听者往前走）
propel v. 推进 → propulsive adj.；写作中可引申为「叙事推进感强」

ex.en: Many artists associated with hyperpop, a movement in electronic music that emerged in the 2010s, conform to the model perfected by American musician Laura Les: bold synthesizer arrangements, propulsive beats, and electronically manipulated vocals.
ex.mark: synthesizer arrangements, propulsive beats, and electronically
ex.zh: 与 2010 年代兴起的电子乐流派 hyperpop 相关的许多音乐人，都遵循美国音乐人 Laura Les 打磨成熟的范式：大胆的合成器编排、极具推进感的节拍，以及经电子处理的人声。

ex.src: 卷 2047 · Module M1 · Q5 · 补充语境
ex.en: Their combination of lush synthesizer arrangements and propulsive beats with vocals electronically shifted in pitch below their natural range exemplifies the hyperpop sound.
ex.zh: 他们把繁复的合成器编曲与强劲的节拍，与人声经电子变调至低于自然音域的处理相结合，正是超流行音乐的典型声效。

senses.text: 基于猜想而非确证（speculative counterfactuals, a speculative answer）
金融语境：为赚取价差而承担高风险（speculative investment）
文学类型术语：speculative fiction 推想小说，涵盖科幻、奇幻等

ex.en: In his introduction, Shurin defines cyberpunk as a subgenre of speculative fiction concerning “the influence of technology on the scale, the pace, or the pattern of human affairs”; however, some critics assert that Shurin’s definition is too broad to distinguish cyberpunk from science fiction more generally.
ex.zh: 舒林在导言中把赛博朋克界定为推想小说的一个亚类型，关注技术对人类事务的规模、节奏或模式的影响；然而一些批评者认为，舒林的定义过于宽泛，无法把赛博朋克与更广义的科幻小说区分开来。

ex.src: 卷 2084 · Module M2 · Q5 · 补充语境
ex.en: Speculative counterfactuals like these can be great fodder for stories, but they’re also commonly deployed by academic historians to better understand factors influencing historical events.
ex.zh: 这类思辨性的反事实设想可以成为绝好的故事素材，但学院派历史学家也常用它们来更好地理解影响历史事件的因素。

senses.text: 化学语境：常温下易蒸发（volatile metal mercury, volatile compounds）
金融 / 市场语境：价格或行情剧烈起伏；名词 volatility 波动率
形容情绪或局势（a volatile temperament, a volatile situation）

kin: volatility — 同词根构词变体，真题出现 3 次；已并入本词条

ex.en: Corrine Walsh and colleagues hypothesized that microbial communities could also affect plants’ flavor chemistry, including volatiles and secondary metabolites like glucosinolates.
ex.zh: 当亚库舍夫、伦斯等人研究 Fl 与金表面的相互作用时，他们发现 Fl 的反应活性低于易挥发的金属汞，但高于惰性气体氡。

ex.src: 卷 2612 · Module RW · Q92 · 补充语境
ex.en: Serrano and colleagues hypothesized that microbial communities could also affect plants’ flavor chemistry, including volatiles and secondary metabolites like glucosinolates.

senses.text: 装饰；装点（be adorned with：装饰着…）
使生色；为…增添光彩

kin: adornment — n. 装饰（品）
unadorned — adj. 未经装饰的——真题反义形式
adorn ≠ adore — 形近异义：后者是「崇拜、喜爱」

ex.en: In his Histories (circa 425 BCE), Herodotus writes of 3,000 chambers adorned with carved figures, a dozen courts flanked by white stone pillars, and many winding passages in the complex, characterizing it as a great labyrinth and “an unending marvel.”
ex.zh: 希罗多德在《历史》（约公元前425年）中写道，这座建筑群有3000间装饰着雕刻人像的厅室、十几个两侧立有白色石柱的庭院，以及许多曲折的通道，他将其形容为一座大迷宫、一处无穷的奇观。

ex.src: 卷 2035 · Module M1 · Q6 · 补充语境
ex.en: The project's unadorned geometric forms, typical of the modernist aesthetic, contrasted with the historically inspired architecture seen in his earlier projects in Guadalajara, such as the Cristo House.
ex.zh: 该项目不加修饰的几何形式是现代主义美学的典型，与他早年在瓜达拉哈拉的历史风格建筑（如 Cristo 住宅）形成对比。

senses.text: （手法、应对）机敏灵巧、老练的（an adroit blend / an adroit negotiator）
adroitly adv. 已并入本词条统一计数；反义 maladroit（笨拙的）

ex.en: In his afterword to Crowley’s book Little, Big, Bloom praises how the novel adroitly blends what playwright Friedrich Schiller termed the naive and sentimental modes—while Schiller thought works could be classified as either naive (seeking to describe reality) or sentimental (seeking to develop ideas), Little, Big fuses both modes of writing.
ex.zh: 在克劳利《小，大》的跋里，布鲁姆盛赞这部小说把席勒所谓「素朴」与「感伤」两种模式娴熟地融为一体——席勒认为作品只能归入其一，而《小，大》证明二者可以兼得。

ex.src: 卷 2035 · Module M2 · Q4 · 补充语境
ex.en: In his afterword to Crowley's book Little, Big, Bloom argues that the novel adroitly blends what playwright Friedrich Schiller termed the naive and sentimental modes—while Schiller thought works could be classified as either naive (seeking to describe reality) or sentimental (seeking to develop ideas), Little, Big fuses both modes of writing.
ex.zh: 在为 Crowley 的小说《Little, Big》所作的跋中，Bloom 论证这部小说巧妙地融合了剧作家席勒所称的「素朴」与「感伤」两种模式——席勒认为作品非素朴（力求描摹现实）即感伤（力求阐发观念），而《Little, Big》将两种写作模式熔于一炉。

senses.text: 因果关系；因果性（linear causality 线性因果）
causality ≠ correlation（相关性）——SAT 科学类文章核心对立

kin: causal / causally — adj. 因果的 / adv. 因果地——真题另现
cause — n. 原因

ex.en: Yuen Yuen Ang has recently argued that both positions presume linear causality in situations in which neither phenomenon is truly independent of the other.
ex.zh: 洪源远（Yuen Yuen Ang）最近指出，两种立场都预设了线性因果关系，而在这些情形中，两种现象其实都不真正独立于彼此。

ex.src: 卷 2014 · Module M2 · Q14 · 补充语境
ex.en: To carry out the necessary sampling of the population over many years, CLSA-ÉLCV needs extensive financial support, but this method provides valuable insights into causal relationships.
ex.zh: 要在多年间对人群进行必要的抽样，CLSA-ÉLCV 需要大量经费支持，但这一方法能为因果关系提供宝贵的洞见。

senses.text: 辅音（与 vowel「元音」相对）
一致的；符合的（consonant with，正式书面用法）

kin: vowel — n. 元音——真题对举（16 vowel and consonant sounds）
consonance / dissonance — n. 一致、和谐 / n. 不和谐（音乐术语亦用）

ex.en: The Arapaho language of the Plains region in the United States has 16 vowel and consonant sounds.
ex.zh: 美国大平原地区的阿拉帕霍语有 16 个元音与辅音音位。

ex.src: 卷 2003 · Module M1 · Q15 · 补充语境
ex.en: English dialects of the Upland South, a region stretching from Oklahoma to western Virginia, place similar emphasis on “r” at the ends of syllables and before other consonant sounds.
ex.zh: 上南方（从俄克拉何马绵延至弗吉尼亚西部的地区）的英语方言，在音节末尾及其他辅音前对 r 音的强调方式彼此相近。

senses.text: 抵消、对抗、中和：通过施加相反的作用使某事物的效果失效
抵制、消解（不良影响或趋势）
counter-（反）+ act（作用）→「反着作用」

kin: counteraction — n. 抵消、对抗
counterpart — n. 对应的人 / 物——同前缀 counter- 但词义不同，别混
counteracting — v-ing 抵消——文法题真题另现（作后置定语，如 a compensatory measure counteracting the decline）

ex.en: Such comparisons have engendered speculation that by diluting control over the economy, democratic institutions inhibit states' ability to counteract inflationary pressures.
ex.zh: 这样的对比引发了一种猜测：通过削弱国家对经济的控制，民主制度会抑制国家对抗通胀压力的能力。

ex.src: 卷 2100 · Module M1 · Q3 · 补充语境
ex.en: Single-celled foraminifera inhabiting estuarine waters experience significant environmental salinity changes during tidal cycles. How, then, do they ____ internal salt levels?
ex.zh: 栖息在河口水域的单细胞有孔虫，在潮汐周期中会经历显著的环境盐度变化。那么，它们如何______内部的盐分水平？（正确选项即 counteract「抵消、调节」）

senses.text: 扩散；散布；传播（光、热、气味、思想）
弥漫的；散开的；（文章）冗长散漫的

kin: diffusion — n. 扩散；传播（真题另现 6 次：cultural diffusion）
diffuse ≠ confuse — 形近异义：confuse 是「使困惑、混淆」

ex.en: The shift from a top-down model of authorship to a more diffuse, interactive one explicitly positioned readers as creators of meaning and implicitly acknowledged the broader social contexts around literary production.
ex.zh: 作者身份从自上而下的模式转向一种更为分散、更具互动性的模式，这一转变明确把读者定位为意义的创造者，也含蓄地承认了文学生产所处的更广阔的社会语境。

senses.text: 多样化；分化（物种、语言、经济、投资）
diverse（多样的）→ diversify（v.）→ diversification（n.）

kin: diversify / diversity — v. 使多样化 / n. 多样性
drive diversification — 推动分化——真题搭配

ex.en: Thus, the geographical circumstances that favor the development of isolates may also drive diversification within language families.
ex.zh: 因此，有利于孤立语发展的地理条件，也可能推动语系内部的分化。

ex.src: 卷 2084 · Module M2 · Q16 · 补充语境
ex.en: To study the joint environmental and economic effects of diversification practices (which can encompass improved soil and water management as well as increased variety in crops and livestock), Laura Vang Rasmussen and team analyzed data from 2,655 farms in eleven countries.
ex.zh: 为研究多样化实践（可包括更好的土壤与水管理，以及作物和牲畜种类的增加）对环境与经济的共同影响，Laura Vang Rasmussen 团队分析了来自 11 个国家 2,655 个农场的数据。

senses.text: 引出；诱出（反应、回答、兴趣、情感）
elicit a response / elicit interest 引发反应 / 激起兴趣

kin: elicit ≠ illicit — 形近异义经典陷阱：illicit 是「非法的」
elicit vs evoke — elicit 强调「把反应引出来」，evoke 强调「唤起记忆 / 情感」

ex.en: In their meta-analysis of research on advergames (video games developed to promote products or services), Zeph M. C. van Berlo et al. confirm that such games, though they can elicit player interest, may not facilitate subsequent recall of product and brand information.
ex.zh: 在关于 advergames（为推广产品或服务而开发的电子游戏）研究的元分析中，Zeph M.C. van Berlo 等人确认：这类游戏虽然能够激发玩家兴趣，却未必有助于玩家日后回忆产品与品牌信息。

ex.src: 卷 2066 · Module M2 · Q15 · 补充语境
ex.en: Subsequent to simulating an attack to elicit defense responses in three caterpillar species, ecologists placed a treatment group of those individuals in an enclosure where they were exposed to slight, harmless ambient electric field shifts like those created by common predatory wasps in flight.
ex.zh: 为诱发三种毛虫的防御反应，生态学家先模拟了一次攻击；随后把这些毛虫的处理组放入围栏，让它们暴露于轻微无害的环境电场变化中——类似常见捕食性胡蜂飞行时产生的电场扰动。

senses.text: 使成化石；变成化石
使僵化；使变得陈旧（fossilized ideas 僵化的观念）

kin: fossil — n. 化石；fossilization n. 石化（作用）
fossilized remains — 化石遗骸——真题搭配

ex.en: Scientists looking for signs of ancient life in Asia have found many examples of fossilized hominins, including in a geological formation at the Minatogawa Limestone Quarry.
ex.zh: 自从 1895 年该物种的化石遗骸被发现以来，科学家一直对它的体型感到困惑。

ex.src: 卷 2093 · Module M2 · Q27 · 补充语境
ex.en: In 1990, archaeologists in Lesotho, in southern Africa, discovered a fossilized phalanx of a Massospondylus carinatus dinosaur in a cave once inhabited by humans..
ex.zh: 1990 年，考古学家在南部非洲的莱索托一处曾有人类居住的洞穴中，发现了一块恐龙（Massospondylus carinatus）的指骨化石。

senses.text: 拾（收割后散落的谷穗）→ 一点一滴地搜集（信息、线索）
glean insights / trends：从数据或材料中逐步获取认识
拾食；啄食（bark gleaning / foliage gleaning 真题专业用法）

kin: gleaner — n. 拾穗者；搜集者
glean ≠ clean — 形近，勿在考场上看走眼

ex.en: The Canadian Longitudinal Study on Aging (CLSA-ÉLCV) is a longitudinal study surveying approximately 1,000 individuals in Canada to glean extended trends in aging.
ex.mark: to glean extended trends in aging
ex.zh: 加拿大老龄化纵向研究（CLSA-ÉLCV）是一项纵向研究，对加拿大约 1,000 名个体进行调查，以逐步摸清老龄化方面的长期趋势。

ex.src: 卷 2025 · Module M2 · Q10 · 补充语境
ex.en: Glyphorynchus spirurus (the wedge-billed woodcreeper), on the other hand, practices bark gleaning (picking insects of the bark of trees), substantially limiting the bird's field of vision while foraging.
ex.zh: 而楔嘴䴕雀则采取树皮拾取式觅食（从树皮上啄取昆虫），觅食时视野受到极大限制。

senses.text: 由不同成分组成的；异质的；混杂的
hetero-（异）+ gen（种类）+ -ous

kin: homogeneous — adj. 同质的；均匀的——反义词，常成对出现
heterogeneity — n. 异质性；heterogeneous ≠ heterogeneous 与 heterogeneous 同族

ex.en: Richard Hosier and Jeffrey Dowd's study of fuel use in Zimbabwe shows how reductive this model is, however: household fuel use was heterogeneous, flexible, and influenced by several factors, including the local prices of different fuel sources.
ex.mark: household fuel use was heterogeneous, flexible
ex.zh: 然而，Richard Hosier 与 Jeffrey Dowd 对津巴布韦燃料使用情况的研究表明，这一模型是何等简化：家庭燃料使用是混杂而灵活的，并受到包括不同燃料当地价格在内的多种因素影响。

ex.src: 卷 2611 · Module M2B · Q14 · 补充语境
ex.en: A illustrate through close attention to the riddles’ textual details that medieval attitudes toward the natural world were more heterogeneous than is commonly supposed.

senses.text: 作家成名前、青少年时期创作的作品，常作为研究其艺术成长的素材
统称供青少年阅读的作品，与 adult literature 对举
带贬义：风格不成熟的作品

ex.en: Scholarly interest in literary juvenilia—writings by children and teenagers—tends to focus on unpublished works by authors who became famous as adults, such as Charles Dickens’s poem “The Bill of Fare,” which he wrote around the ages of 18- 20, because they offer insights into their authors’ artistic development.
ex.zh: 学界对文学少年习作——儿童与青少年所写的作品——的兴趣，往往集中于那些后来成名的作家未发表的作品，例如查尔斯·狄更斯 18 至 20 岁左右所写的诗《菜单》，因为这些作品为了解作者的艺术成长提供了线索。

ex.src: 卷 2003 · Module M2 · Q6 · 补充语境
ex.en: But some scholars also argue that recovering juvenilia by lesser-known writers is essential to understanding literary history: Daisy Ashford's novels, which she published as a child, were widely read by contemporaries and are therefore deserving of closer attention.
ex.zh: 但也有学者主张，挖掘知名度较低作家的少年习作对理解文学史必不可少：Daisy Ashford 童年发表的小说曾广为同时代读者阅读，因此值得更密切的关注。

senses.text: 传播；扩散（波、声音、光、思想）
繁殖；增殖（propagate plants by cuttings）

kin: propagation — n. 传播；繁殖
propagate ≠ propagate to — 真题取「（波）传播」义，不是「宣传」
disseminate — v. 散布（信息）——近义

ex.en: Studies of ocean wave breaking have predominantly focused on traveling waves (those propagating along the horizontal plane), so Mark McAllister et al. utilized a circular wave tank to produce and study spike waves, axisymmetric standing waves that can erupt vertically when traveling waves propagating in opposing directions intersect.
ex.mark: those propagating along the horizontal plane
ex.zh: 对海浪破碎的研究主要关注的是行波（即沿水平面传播的波），因此 Mark McAllister 等人使用了圆形波槽来生成并研究尖峰波。

ex.src: 卷 2047 · Module M1 · Q14 · 补充语境
ex.en: High-entropy alloys (HEAs) have been observed to have greater fracture toughness—greater resistance to crack propagation—than conventional alloys.

senses.text: 讽刺的；含讽刺意味的（satirical portrayal / novel）
satirical 是形容词，satire 是名词「讽刺（作品）」，satirize 是动词

kin: satire / satirize — n. 讽刺（作品）/ v. 讽刺
satirical ≠ saturnine — 后者意为「阴沉的、忧郁的」，形近易混

ex.en: The Vortex is a 1924 satirical play by Noel Coward.
ex.zh: 《漩涡》（The Vortex）是诺埃尔·科沃德 1924 年的一部讽刺剧。

senses.text: 随处可见、普遍存在的
语气强于 common：真题用 is ubiquitous in domestic dog breeds 强调「几乎所有犬种都有」

ex.en: Ostrander et al. assert that this explanation is flawed, having discovered that a mutation responsible for variants of IGF1, a gene found in many mammals that regulates production of insulin-like growth factor 1, is ubiquitous in domestic dog breeds.
ex.zh: Ostrander 等人认为这一解释站不住脚：他们发现，一个导致 IGF1（一种存在于许多哺乳动物体内、调控胰岛素样生长因子 1 生成的基因）变异的突变，在家犬各品种中普遍存在。

ex.src: 卷 2010 · Module M2 · Q11 · 补充语境
ex.en: However, Nunez and colleagues claim that this tendency is not in fact ubiquitous.
ex.zh: 然而 Nunez 及同事声称，这一倾向实际上并非无处不在。

senses.text: 位于…之下；构成…的基础；是…的根本原因
几乎只用 underlying 这一形容词形态（真题 10 次）

kin: underlying — adj. 潜在的；根本的（the underlying pulse 潜在的基本律动）
underlie ≠ underline — 后者是「在…下划线；强调」

ex.en: This hypothesis was based on findings about a specific form of rhythmic complexity known as syncopation (when beats played in the rhythm deviate from the steady, underlying pulse of a song), which suggested that moderate syncopation was associated with the highest groove ratings.
ex.mark: the steady, underlying pulse of a song
ex.zh: 这一假说基于对一种特定节奏复杂形式——切分（即所奏节拍偏离歌曲稳定而潜在的基本律动）——的研究发现，该发现表明中等程度的切分与……相关。

ex.src: 卷 2068 · Module M2 · Q8 · 补充语境
ex.en: The CNN model's output aligned with results of prior studies by other researchers measuring muscle activity patterns directly—one of several indications, said Melis et al., that the model accurately represents important biomechanical processes underlying wing motion.
ex.zh: CNN 模型的输出与其他研究者直接测量肌肉活动模式的既有研究相符——Melis 等人称，这是该模型准确表征翅膀运动背后重要生物力学过程的诸多迹象之一。

senses.text: （因受力）轻微晃动、摆动
radial velocity method 通过恒星 tiny wobbles 推断绕行行星的引力拖拽

ex.en: The radial velocity method detects tiny wobbles in stars caused by orbiting planets pulling on them.
ex.mark: detects tiny wobbles in stars caused
ex.zh: 径向速度法通过探测恒星因绕行行星引力牵引而产生的微小摆动来发现行星。

ex.src: 卷 2063 · Module M1 · Q19 · 补充语境
ex.en: As the exoplanet 17 Scorpii b orbits a star 408 light-years from Earth, the gas giant’s gravity causes the star to wobble.
ex.zh: 当系外行星 17 Scorpii b 环绕一颗距地球 408 光年的恒星运行时，这颗气态巨行星的引力使恒星发生摆动。

senses.text: 认知与语言语境：知识、技能或记忆的获得过程（the acquisition of new memories, language acquisition）
商业语境：一家企业买下另一家企业（mergers and acquisitions）
博物馆或图书馆语境：新入藏的藏品

ex.en: A soil’s microbial community (the microbial taxa present in their relative abundances) is known to affect plants’ nutrient acquisition.
ex.zh: 该团队发现，扇形细胞——一种存在于大脑内侧颞叶的细胞——对于新联想记忆的习得是必要的。

ex.src: 卷 2066 · Module M2 · Q10 · 补充语境
ex.en: Cognitive scientists have noted, however, that existing domain knowledge facilitates the acquisition of new information in that domain.
ex.zh: 然而认知科学家指出，已有的领域知识会促进该领域新信息的获取。

senses.text: 可归因于…的（attributable to X）
solely / largely attributable to 完全 / 主要归因于

kin: attribute — v. 把…归因于（attribute X to Y）；n. 属性、特征
attribution — n. 归因；（作品）归属判定

ex.en: Finding that knockout mice with the gene Aasdh deactivated tended to develop cataracts more frequently than did wild-type mice, the students concluded that differences in cataract frequency among house mice in nature are solely attributable to variations in the level of expression of Aasdh.
ex.zh: 学生们发现，Aasdh 基因被敲除的小鼠比野生型小鼠更容易患白内障，由此得出结论：自然界中家鼠白内障发生频率的差异完全可归因于（基因的）变异。

senses.text: 被某一共同体公认具有权威性的作品序列（the modernist canon, the literary canon）
某一领域公认的标准（the canons of evidence）
宗教语境：教会确认的经典或法规

ex.en: For too long, scholars have focused on experimental versus conventional poetic forms, inhibiting inquiry into other points of stylistic correspondence among poems that would enrich our understanding of the modernist canon.
ex.zh: 长期以来，学者们专注于实验性诗体与传统诗体的对立，从而阻碍了对诗歌之间其他文体对应关系的探究——而这些探究本可丰富我们对现代主义正典的理解。

ex.src: 卷 2032 · Module M2 · Q26 · 补充语境
ex.en: His book The Canon of Medicine recorded the most advanced medical knowledge of his time..
ex.zh: 他的《医典》一书收录了当时最先进的医学知识。

senses.text: 迷住；使着迷；俘虏（人心）
capt-（抓、拿）+ -ivate → 把注意力抓住

kin: captivating — adj. 迷人的——真题 18 次全为此形
captive / capture — n. 俘虏、adj. 被囚禁的 / v. 捕获

ex.en: However, in other works, Villasana honors ordinary people, as she does in her captivating portrayal of a woman making tortillas.
ex.mark: her captivating portrayal of a woman making tortillas
ex.zh: 不过在其他作品中，Villasana 也致敬普通人，正如她在那幅令人着迷的画作中呈现的一位正在做玉米饼的女性。

senses.text: concurrent with 与……同时发生；两件事在时间上重叠
concurrent trends 并行出现的两种趋势，未必互相影响
法律语境：concurrent jurisdiction 并行管辖权，两个法院同时有权审理

ex.en: Cross-references of that information with both archaeological and paleoecological records have revealed significant increases in clam size and productivity concurrent with the most prevalent use of these clam gardens.
ex.mark: and productivity concurrent with the most
ex.zh: 将这些信息与考古记录、古生态记录交叉比对后发现，蛤蜊体型与生产力的显著上升，与这些蛤蜊养殖场使用最普遍的时期同时发生。

ex.src: 卷 2084 · Module M2 · Q16 · 补充语境
ex.en: They found that using multiple diversification practices concurrently had greater potential for improving both nonagricultural biodiversity and yields than using a single strategy did.
ex.zh: 他们发现，同时采用多种多样化实践，在改善非农业生物多样性和产量方面，比采用单一策略有更大的潜力。

senses.text: 同时期的；同时代的（contemporaneous with X）
contemporaneous 强调「两者时间重合」；contemporary 还可指「当代的」

kin: contemporary — adj./n. 当代的 / 同时代的人
contemporaneously — adv. 同一时期地

ex.en: Archaeologists have observed similarities in the tools, such as bidirectional blades, uncovered at the Neolithic-period Mesopotamian settlement of Çayönü Tepesi and those uncovered at roughly contemporaneous settlements elsewhere in Southwest Asia, including those in the South Levant, Central Anatolia, and Central Zagros.
ex.zh: 马耳他石器工艺相当原始，与之相似的是同一时期撒丁岛的技术，而非邻近西西里所记录到的那种精密的几何细石器传统。

senses.text: 错综复杂的；盘绕曲折的（情节、论证、结构）
盘绕的；回旋状的（convoluted shells）

kin: convolution — n. 盘绕；回旋（亦指脑回）
convoluted ≠ involved — involved 是「参与的；复杂的」，不要混写

ex.en: President Richard Nixon is most famous for his participation in the 1970s Watergate political scandal, a convoluted tale of criminality and eroded ethics involving a constellation of associates such as security operative Jack Caulfield and Attorney General John Mitchell.
ex.zh: 理查德·尼克松总统最为人所知的是他在 1970 年代水门政治丑闻中的角色——那是一个盘根错节的犯罪与道德沦丧的故事，牵涉到一整批相关人物。

ex.src: 卷 2611 · Module M1 · Q3 · 补充语境
ex.en: A convoluted B vague C condensed D simplistic It has plausibly been suggested that the widespread replacement of plants utilizing C3 carbon fixation by plants utilizing C4 carbon fixation 2.6 million years ago was due to increasing global aridity.

senses.text: 金融与法律核心义：未能按期偿付债务（debt defaults, default on a loan）
技术语境：未作选择时系统预设的状态（by default）
法律语境：未履行义务或未出庭（default judgment 缺席判决）

ex.en: Mauricio Drelichman and Hans-Joachim Voth's research into the debt defaults of Philip II (who ruled an empire including Spain and Milan from 1556 to 1598) relates to other work on European early modern state finance, including Eugene White's research on surpluses and state borrowing.
ex.mark: the debt defaults of Philip II
ex.zh: 毛里西奥·德雷利希曼与汉斯-约阿希姆·福斯对腓力二世债务违约的研究，与其他关于欧洲近代早期国家财政的著述相关联，其中包括约翰·布鲁尔关于税收与战争的研究。

ex.src: 卷 2612 · Module RW · Q129 · 补充语境
ex.en: For several centuries after the birth of opera in sixteenth-century Florence, Italian remained the default language in which most opera scores were written.

senses.text: 创业的；具有企业家精神的
entrepreneurial training / education 创业培训 / 创业教育

kin: entrepreneur / entrepreneurship — n. 创业者 / n. 创业精神、创业活动
entrepreneurial ≠ enterprising — 后者是「有进取心的」，近义但不完全等同

ex.en: For instance, a 1998 study by Ove Hansemark found benefits of entrepreneurial education for Swedish college students, but the study used a very small sample of only 19 students, making it difficult to say whether the training actually had an effect.
ex.zh: 例如，Ove Hansemark 在 1998 年的一项研究发现创业教育对瑞典大学生有益，但该研究样本极小，仅 19 名学生，因此很难断言这种培训是否真的产生了效果。

ex.src: 卷 2074 · Module M1 · Q7 · 补充语境
ex.en: In a study of business school graduates in Norway, researchers Lars Kolvereid and Øystein Moen addressed this question and convincingly demonstrated that participants showed strong intentions to become entrepreneurs as a result of receiving entrepreneurial training. Text 2While studies of entrepreneurial training typically report positive results, a close look at these studies reveals widespread methodological shortcomings.
ex.zh: 在一项针对挪威商学院毕业生的研究中，Lars Kolvereid 与 Øystein Moen 令人信服地证明：接受创业培训的参与者表现出强烈的创业意向。——然而，尽管创业培训研究通常报告积极结果，细察之下这些研究普遍存在方法论缺陷。

senses.text: 侵蚀；腐蚀（水、风对土壤岩石的侵蚀）
逐渐削弱、损害（权力、信任、道德、支持率）

kin: erosion — n. 侵蚀；削弱（真题高频）
eroded ethics — 道德沦丧——真题搭配

ex.en: Ameander forms when water erodes sediment from one side of the riverbank and redeposits that sediment on the opposite side. .
ex.zh: 理查德·尼克松总统最为人所知的是他在 1970 年代水门政治丑闻中的角色——那是一个盘根错节的犯罪与道德沦丧的故事。

senses.text: （文本、物种、作品等）现存的；尚存的
extinct 已灭绝的 / 已失传的——extant 最直接的反义词
extant ≠ extent（程度 / 范围），SAT 经典拼写陷阱

kin: extinct / extirpate — adj. 灭绝的 / v. 根除、使（种群）灭绝
surviving — adj. 现存的——同义替换，常作正确选项的等价表达

ex.en: Most of the island’s extant biota belong to clades with younger crown ages, however: Jérôme Murienne et al. found that the crown age of Grande Terre’s clade of cockroaches is 2.7 million years, for example.
ex.zh: 不过，该岛现存生物区系大多属于冠群年龄较年轻的支系：例如 Jérôme Murienne 等人发现，格朗德特尔岛蟑螂支系的冠群年龄只有 270 万年。

ex.src: 卷 2046 · Module M2 · Q18 · 补充语境
ex.en: The Roman historian Suetonius's De vita caesarum, a biography of the Roman Empire's first leaders, is an extant work: it can still be read.
ex.zh: 罗马历史学家苏维托尼乌斯的《十二凯撒传》是罗马帝国首批统治者的传记，是一部 extant（存世）作品：至今仍可阅读。

senses.text: 比喻的；修辞的（figurative language 比喻性语言）
具象的、写实的（与 abstract「抽象的」相对）

kin: figuratively — adv. 比喻地；figurative ≠ literal（字面的）
figure of speech — 修辞手法

ex.en: In one portion of the novel, Toomer uses figurative language to connect the narrator's urban environment of Washington.
ex.zh: 在小说的某一段落中，Toomer 运用比喻性语言把叙述者所处的华盛顿城市环境串联起来。

senses.text: 荧光（solar-induced chlorophyll fluorescence, SIF 日光诱导叶绿素荧光）
fluor-（氟 / 荧光）+ -escence（开始…的状态）

kin: fluorescent / fluoresce — adj. 发荧光的 / v. 发荧光
fluorescence ≠ fluorescence microscopy — 后者是「荧光显微术」
GPP / proxy — 总初级生产力 / n. 替代指标——真题同现

ex.en: But as flux towers aren’t evenly distributed globally, alternate proxies for GPP obtained remotely from satellite sensors, including solar-induced chlorophyll fluorescence (SIF) emitted by plants during photosynthesis, are being investigated.
ex.zh: 植物吸收的一部分太阳辐射会以日光诱导叶绿素荧光（SIF）的形式重新发射出来，这可通过卫星观测，并可作为光合作用的替代指标。

ex.src: 卷 2010 · Module M1 · Q11 · 补充语境
ex.en: Some transgenic fish have genes from jellyfish that result in fluorescence (that is, they glow in the dark.) Although these fish were initially engineered for research purposes in the 1990s, they were sold as pets in the 2000s and can now be found in the wild in creeks in Brazil.
ex.zh: 一些转基因鱼携带来自水母的基因，因而能发光（即在黑暗中荧光闪烁）。这些鱼在 1990 年代最初为科研目的而培育，2000 年代被当作宠物出售，如今在巴西的溪流中已能发现野生个体。

senses.text: 摄入；吞下（食物、药物、物质）
ingest 是「吃进体内」，digest 是「消化」——先后两步

kin: ingestion — n. 摄入——真题另现 11 次
ingested / ingesting — 过去式 / 现在分词

ex.en: CLPs are transmitted when an infected host is ingested by an individual of another species, typically shielding CLPs from the external environment, whereas directly transmitted parasites are exposed to external conditions during transmission.
ex.mark: when an infected host is ingested
ex.zh: 当受感染的宿主被另一物种的个体吞食时，CLP 便得以传播——这种方式通常使 CLP 与外部隔绝；而直接传播的寄生虫在传播过程中则暴露于外部环境条件之下。

ex.src: 卷 2015 · Module M1 · Q5 · 补充语境
ex.en: So in one day, a humpback whale weighing 30,000 kg could eat 9,000 kg, while a northern right whale weighing 80,000 kg could ingest a whopping 24,000 kg.
ex.zh: 因此一天之内，一头重 3 万公斤的座头鲸可吃掉 9000 公斤食物，而一头重 8 万公斤的北大西洋露脊鲸可吞下高达 2.4 万公斤。

senses.text: 激起…的兴趣；使好奇、着迷
阴谋；密谋（political intrigue）

kin: intriguing — adj. 引人入胜的；耐人寻味的——真题 4 次
intrigue ≠ intricate — 后者是「错综复杂的」，形近异义

ex.en: Tomi Adeyemi's first published work, the inventive West African-inspired fantasy novel Children of Blood and Bone, has intriguing things to say about the relationship between identity and power.
ex.zh: Tomi Adeyemi 首部出版的作品——构思新颖、以西非为灵感的奇幻小说《Children of Blood and Bone》——对身份与权力之间的关系道出了颇为耐人寻味的见解。

ex.src: 卷 2001 · Module M2 · Q13 · 补充语境
ex.en: While studying the distribution of a particular cactus species, Echinocactus grusonii, researchers have come to intriguing observations.
ex.zh: 在研究金琥（Echinocactus grusonii）这一仙人掌物种的分布时，研究者得出了一些耐人寻味的观察。

senses.text: 滤出；渗滤（leach into waterways / soils）
（从…中）榨取；逐渐抽走（leach nutrients from soil）

kin: leaching — n. 淋溶（作用）
leach ≠ leech — 同音异形，后者是「水蛭；寄生虫」
leachate — n. 渗滤液——环保工程术语

ex.en: Some toothpastes contain titanium dioxide nanoparticles (TiO₂-NPs), which can leach into waterways and soils via wastewater.
ex.mark: can leach into waterways and soils via wastewater
ex.zh: 某些牙膏含有二氧化钛纳米颗粒（TiO₂-NPs），它们会经由废水渗入水道与土壤。

senses.text: 发光的；明亮的（luminous galactic nuclei / relatives）
（文风、色彩）明澈通透的

kin: luminosity — n. 光度；亮度——天文类术语
luminous ≠ luminescent — 后者指「发冷光的（生物 / 化学）」，真题亦现
illuminate / luminous — v. 照亮 / adj. 发光的——同根

ex.en: Quasars--such as APM 08279+5255, located in the Lynx constellation--are extremely luminous galactic nuclei powered by supermassive black holes, some of which are known to have developed within the first billion years of the formation of the universe.
ex.zh: 类星体——例如位于天猫座的 APM 08279+5255——是由超大质量黑洞驱动的、光度极高的星系核，其中一些已知形成于宇宙诞生后的第一个十亿年内。

senses.text: 讲述（故事、事件），narrate a portion of text
narration n. 叙述；narrator n. 叙述者；与 recount 相比更强调「以某一视角讲出来」

ex.en: Victor Frankenstein, who narrates this portion of text, describes the state of scientific knowledge as he began his own study of the natural world.
ex.zh: 维克多·弗兰肯斯坦正在叙述这段文字，他描述了自己开始研究自然界时科学知识的状况。

ex.src: 卷 2102 · Module M2 · Q7 · 补充语境
ex.en: The Iowa Writers’ Workshop, an influential graduate program in creative writing, has been criticized for almost exclusively promoting fiction that is conventional in its narrative structure.
ex.zh: 爱荷华作家工作坊这一极具影响力的创意写作研究生项目，一直因几乎只推崇叙事结构因循传统的小说而受到批评。

senses.text: 渗透；弥漫于（be permeated with）
（气息、情绪）充满、浸透

kin: permeation / permeable — n. 渗透 / adj. 可渗透的——真题亦现
permeate ≠ permeated with — 真题作 be permeated with 浸透着
suffuse / imbue — v. 弥漫于 / v. 使充满——近义，真题亦现
permeability — 同词根构词变体，真题出现 7 次；已并入本词条统一计数

ex.en: However, any barrier used must allow the thread-like hyphae of a CMN to pass through, and this permeability would also allow liquids through.
ex.zh: 然而，所使用的任何屏障都必须能让 CMN 的丝状菌丝通过，而这种可渗透性同样会让液体通过。

ex.src: 卷 2030 · Module M2 · Q13 · 补充语境
ex.en: As the process continues, water from the food's center moves to the crust as long as the crust remains permeable.
ex.zh: 只要外皮保持可渗透，食物中心的水分就会持续向外皮迁移。

senses.text: （法律、规则）允许的、不算违规的
真题 though legally permissible, nonetheless… 是典型让步结构：合法 ≠ 正当；反义 impermissible

ex.en: Philosopher Ingrid Robeyns disapproves of the use of tax havens as a method of tax avoidance that, though legally permissible, nonetheless helps investors to sidestep payment toward government upkeep.
ex.zh: 哲学家 Ingrid Robeyns 不认可把利用避税港作为避税手段：这种做法虽在法律上被允许，却仍帮助投资者规避了本应负担的政府开支。

ex.src: 卷 2059 · Module M2 · Q9 · 补充语境
ex.en: Philosophers note that many people have an intuitive sense that while we ought not to lie, there may be circumstances in which lying is permissible.
ex.zh: 哲学家们指出，许多人都凭直觉感到：我们固然不应当说谎，但某些情形下说谎或许是可容许的。

senses.text: 预防措施、防范手段：为免出现坏结果而事先做的事
预防、防备（as a precaution 以防万一）
take the precaution of doing sth 采取……的预防措施；as a precaution 作为预防

kin: precautionary — adj. 预防性的（precautionary measures 预防措施）

ex.en: Meng and colleagues took the necessary precaution of separating the plants’ root systems (thereby excluding root-to-root transmission).
ex.zh: Meng 及其同事采取了必要的预防措施——把植物的根系分隔开（从而排除根与根之间的传递）。

senses.text: 落水洞；溶洞、塌陷坑（blue holes 蓝洞即大型海水 sinkholes）
sink（下沉）+ hole（洞）

kin: blue hole — 蓝洞——真题与之同现
subterranean — adj. 地下的——真题另现
sinkhole ≠ sinkhole of — 真题作 large seawater sinkholes

ex.en: Blue holes, such as the Far Side Blue Hole in the Abaco Islands, are large seawater sinkholes that tend to have varying water density and irregularities in their steep walls.
ex.zh: 蓝洞（如阿巴科群岛的 Far Side 蓝洞）是大型海水落水洞，其水体密度往往层层不同，陡壁上也常见不规则的凹凸。

ex.src: 卷 2102 · Module M2 · Q8 · 补充语境
ex.en: With examples ranging from Dean’s Blue Hole in the Bahamas to Nancy’s Blue Hole in the Abaco Islands, blue holes are large underwater sinkholes: pits filled with dark blue water that contrasts with lighter blue shallower waters surrounding them.
ex.zh: 从巴哈马的迪恩蓝洞到阿巴科群岛的南希蓝洞，蓝洞是巨大的水下天坑：坑中充满深蓝色的水，与周围较浅的浅蓝色海水形成鲜明反差。

senses.text: 使位于；把…置于（某语境、背景、位置中）——常用被动 be situated
situating X in a larger context 把 X 置于更大的语境中

kin: situated — adj. 位于…的；处于…境地的——真题主要形态
situation — n. 处境；形势；地理位置

ex.en: Some finches nests were situated close to the new road and others were deeper in the woodland.
ex.mark: were situated close to the new road
ex.zh: 有些雀鸟的巢筑在紧邻新修道路的地方，另一些则位于林地更深处。

ex.src: 卷 2005 · Module M2 · Q12 · 补充语境
ex.en: A student is writing a research paper on the history of irrigation in the southwestern United State, situating the development of Lake Sabrina (a man-made body of water created in Inyo County.
ex.zh: 一位学生正在撰写关于美国西南部灌溉史的论文，将萨布丽娜湖（因约县人工修建的水体）的发展置于更大的历史脉络中考察。

senses.text: （书面、带道德意味）怠惰、懒散，七宗罪之一
树懒（three-toed sloths）；真题以动物名出现，两义并考是常见手法

ex.en: Bentley examined research on brown-throated three-toed sloths and canaries to see whether results from studies in the wild were consistent with the results of studies in the laboratory.
ex.mark: brown-throated three-toed sloths and canaries to
ex.zh: Bentley 查阅了关于褐喉三趾树懒与金丝雀的研究，以检验野外实验的结果是否与实验室结果一致。

ex.src: 卷 2046 · Module M2 · Q1 · 补充语境
ex.en: The factors that contributed to the extinction of the Caribbean ground sloth around 3000 BCE, for example, may be applicable to endangered species today.
ex.zh: 例如，导致加勒比地懒约公元前 3000 年灭绝的因素，或许同样适用于今天的濒危物种。

senses.text: 挖掘出；掘出（埋藏的器物、遗骸）
发现；揭露（事实、真相、证据）

kin: unearth ≠ disinter — 后者专指「掘出（尸体）」，语域更窄
dig up — 短语动词「挖出；查出」，同义替换

ex.en: Some stayed buried for many centuries, such as the Parc-y-Meirch hoard, which was unearthed around 1868, and the Fittleworth hoard, discovered in 1995.
ex.zh: 有些窖藏在地下埋藏了许多个世纪，例如约 1868 年出土的 Parc-y-Meirch 窖藏，以及 1995 年发现的 Fittleworth 窖藏。

ex.src: 卷 2064 · Module M1 · Q8 · 补充语境
ex.en: Deposits of valuable objects, or hoards, have been unearthed in many different parts of Ireland and Northern Ireland.
ex.zh: 珍贵物品的埋藏堆，即窖藏，已在爱尔兰和北爱尔兰的许多不同地区出土。

senses.text: 抽象；抽象概念
抽象手法；抽象艺术（a mode of abstraction 一种抽象方式）

kin: abstract — adj. 抽象的 / n. 摘要 / v. 提取
abstract art / abstractionism — 抽象艺术 / 抽象主义

ex.en: Many contemporary Indigenous painters practice a specifically indigenous mode of abstraction; for example, Linda Lomahaftewa often assembles compositions out of motifs common in the ceramics and other traditional arts of the Hopi Tribe.
ex.mark: a specifically indigenous mode of abstraction
ex.zh: 许多当代原住民画家践行一种特有的原住民式抽象：例如，Linda Lomahaftewa 常以霍皮族陶器及其他传统艺术中常见的母题来组织画面。

ex.src: 卷 2053 · Module M2 · Q15 · 补充语境
ex.en: In this respect, the work typifies Indigenous painters’ forays into abstraction during the period.
ex.zh: 在这一方面，该作品是那一时期原住民画家探索抽象艺术的典型代表。

senses.text: 轶事；趣闻（偏个人经历、非正式叙述）
anecdote（个案轶事）≠ data / evidence（系统证据）——SAT 最爱在此设「以个例当证据」的论证陷阱

kin: anecdotal — adj. 轶事的；anecdotal evidence 传闻证据（带贬义）
anecdotally — adv. 据传闻

ex.en: The narrator is traveling by boat with Harris and another friend. (Harris) told us anecdotes of how he had gone across the (English) Channel when it was so rough that the passengers had to be tied into their (beds), and he and the captain were the only two living souls on board who were not ill.
ex.zh: 她的脑子里装满了无伤大雅的轶事，任何关于熟人的问题都能引出一整卷细节；可一谈到伊桑·弗洛姆，我却发现她出奇地缄默。

ex.src: 卷 2081 · Module M2 · Q13 · 补充语境
ex.en: Research into the effectiveness of arts programs for medical students by Neha Mukunda and her colleagues found that evidence is largely anecdotal and based on studies that were short in duration, limited to single institutions, or restricted to small numbers of students.

senses.text: 群岛；列岛（含其间的海域）
archipelago 是一组岛，island 是单个岛

kin: the Hawaiian archipelago — 夏威夷群岛——真题搭配
island chain — 岛链——同义表达

ex.en: Like many other bird species that live only on the Hawaiian archipelago, the Kaua‘i ‘amakihi has adapted to life in a well-defined habitat, resulting in highly specialized physical and behavioral characteristics that aid the species in survival.
ex.zh: 与许多只生活在夏威夷群岛的鸟类一样，考岛绿雀（Kauaʻi ʻamakihi）已适应了界限分明的栖息地生活，由此演化出高度特化的生理与行为特征，有助于该物种存活。

ex.src: 卷 2053 · Module M1 · Q8 · 补充语境
ex.en: The Hawaiian archipelago is home to the kiwikiu (Pseudonestor xanthophrys), one of several bird species that can only be found on the islands.
ex.zh: 夏威夷群岛是 kiwikiu（毛岛雀）的家园——这是只能在夏威夷诸岛找到的鸟类物种之一。

senses.text: 工匠；手艺人（凭手工技艺制作者）
artisan 强调手工技艺，artist 强调艺术创作

kin: artisanal — adj. 手工制作的（artisanal cheese / bread）
craftsmanship / craftsperson — n. 手艺 / n. 手艺人

ex.en: This sped up the process of making clothing and, by freeing them from the need to push cord through holes manually, allowed artisans to make smaller holes and thus finer seams.
ex.mark: allowed artisans to make smaller holes
ex.zh: 这加快了制衣流程，而且由于不必再手工把线绳穿过孔洞，工匠得以打出更小的孔，从而做出更细密的接缝。

ex.src: 卷 2081 · Module M1 · Q12 · 补充语境
ex.en: And once the needle was invented, artisans could use finer cord and smaller holes, resulting in tighter, more thermally efficient seams in their clothing.
ex.zh: 而一旦发明了针，工匠便能使用更细的线和更小的孔，使衣物的接缝更紧密、保暖效率更高。

senses.text: 集合；组合；聚集物
器物组合——同一地点 / 层位出土的一批遗物（真题用法）

kin: assemble — v. 聚集；装配、组装
assemblage ≠ assembly — 后者多指「装配；集会；（机械）组件」

ex.en: The 6.5-million-year gap between these fossil assemblages occurs in the context of considerable evidence of concurrent African-Eurasian faunal exchange.
ex.zh: 在非洲与欧亚大陆动物群交流证据相当充分的背景下，这两组化石组合之间隔着 650 万年的空档。

ex.src: 卷 2086 · Module M1 · Q11 · 补充语境
ex.en: Maltese lithic (stone implement) assemblages from the sixth and seventh millennia BCE exhibit notable characteristics.
ex.zh: 马耳他公元前六七千年的石制品组合展现出引人注目的特征。

senses.text: 厌恶；反感（aversion to / toward X）
loss aversion 损失厌恶——行为经济学核心概念

kin: averse — adj. 不愿意的、厌恶的（averse to risk 厌恶风险）
aversion ≠ avert — avert 是动词「避免；转移（目光）」，同根不同词性

ex.en: The finding that a loss is felt more keenly than is a gain of the same value led the researchers to formulate the concept of loss aversion, which has since informed research in fields ranging from behavioral economics to medicine.
ex.zh: 「同等价值的损失比收益让人感受更强烈」这一发现，促使研究者提出了「损失厌恶」的概念；此后这一概念影响了从行为经济学到医学等多个领域的研究。

ex.src: 卷 2087 · Module M2 · Q14 · 补充语境
ex.en: They noted that it becomes more difficult for consumers to evaluate brand quality as line length increases and that consumers show high risk aversion during economic downturns.
ex.zh: 他们指出，产品线越长，消费者越难评估品牌质量；且消费者在经济下行期表现出高度的风险规避。

senses.text: 美丽的——beautiful 的古体 / 诗体写法
多见于莎士比亚及后世仿古文体，现代英语已罕用，但 SAT 常考这类「古语色彩词」

kin: beauty / beauteous — n. 美 / adj. 美丽的（诗体）
fair / comely — adj. 美丽的——同为古语 / 文学色彩用词

ex.en: There is a fair behaviour in thee, Captain; And though that nature with a beauteous wall Doth oft close in pollution, yet of thee I will believe thou hast a mind that suits With this thy fair and outward character.
ex.zh: 薇奥拉正在对一位出手相助的船长说话：船长，你身上有一种美好的举止；虽然造化常以美丽的外墙把污秽包藏其中，但我仍愿相信你有一颗与这美好外表相匹配的心。

senses.text: common carp 鲤鱼；真题中作实验对象
carp at / about 吹毛求疵、挑剔抱怨（书面义，与名词同形异义）

ex.en: Prolonged exposure to anthropogenic noise (sounds from human sources like traffic or mining) can affect animals, as Lidia Eva Wysocki and colleagues found in a 2006 study of common carp.
ex.zh: 长期暴露于人为噪声（交通、采矿等人类来源的声音）会影响动物——Lidia Eva Wysocki 等人在 2006 年对鲤鱼的研究中便发现了这一点。

ex.src: 卷 2021 · Module M2 · Q13 · 补充语境
ex.en: While bioaccumulation of manufactured nanoparticles may be inherently worrisome, it has been hypothesized that TiO₂-NP bioaccumulation in invertebrates like D. polymorpha could serve a valuable proxy role, obviating the need for manufacturers to conduct costly and intrusive sampling of vertebrate species—such as common carp (Cyprinus carpio), commonly used in regulatory compliance testing—for nanoparticle bioaccumulation, as environmental protection laws currently require.
ex.zh: 虽然人造纳米颗粒的生物累积本身可能令人担忧，但已有假设提出：斑马贝等无脊椎动物体内 TiO₂ 纳米颗粒的生物累积可发挥宝贵的指示作用，免去制造商对脊椎动物（如合规测试常用的鲤鱼）进行昂贵且具侵入性的采样——现行环保法律正要求此类检测。

senses.text: 经典的、被奉为正典的：被某个共同体公认为标准作品或标准版本
（学科内）权威的、标准的（the canonical account 标准叙述）
canonical ≠ classical：classical 指古希腊罗马或「古典」时期；canonical 指被后世奉入「正典」

kin: canon — n. 正典；经典作品总目（the modernist canon 现代主义正典）
canonize — v. 把……奉为经典；（宗教）封圣

ex.en: The fact that there is no contemporary evidence that the first audience of Arrival of the Train was alarmed has not stopped the story from becoming canonical, even among film historians.
ex.zh: 尽管没有当时的证据表明《火车进站》的首批观众曾被吓到，这并没有妨碍这个故事成为「正典」——即使在电影史学者中间也是如此。

ex.src: 卷 2013 · Module M1 · Q20 · 补充语境
ex.en: Though now canonical, many works featured in the show—particularly one abstract cubist painting by Marcel Duchamp— ______ considered shocking at the time.
ex.zh: 尽管如今已被奉为经典，展览中的许多作品——尤其是杜尚的一幅抽象立体主义绘画——在当时却曾被认为惊世骇俗。

senses.text: 双手交握、紧握；n. 扣子、搭扣
hands clasped behind one's back 双手背在身后，是人物沉思 / 克制的经典体态描写

ex.en: Don Mariano Alamar was silently walking up and down the front piazza of his house at the rancho; his hands listlessly clasped behind and his head slightly bent forward in deep thought.
ex.zh: 唐·马里亚诺·阿拉马尔在牧场宅邸前的门廊上默默来回踱步，双手无精打采地背扣在身后，头微微前倾，陷入沉思。

senses.text: 昼行性的、白天活动的（diurnal pollinators 白天活动的传粉昆虫）
白天的、日间的（diurnal temperature range 日间温度变化）
diurnal ↔ nocturnal：真题常成对出现，一个「白天活动」，一个「夜间活动」

kin: nocturnal — adj. 夜行性的——与 diurnal 对照出题
diurnally — adv. 在白天

ex.en: Researchers' focus on diurnal invertebrate pollinators has resulted in a decided lack of data on moth pollination, but using infrared detection equipment, Max Anderson et al. assessed how diurnal and nocturnal insects separately contribute to R. fruticosus pollination.
ex.zh: 研究者对白天活动的无脊椎传粉者的关注，导致蛾类传粉的数据明显缺乏；但 Max Anderson 等人利用红外探测设备，评估了昼行与夜行昆虫分别对 R. fruticosus 传粉的贡献。

ex.src: 卷 2053 · Module M2 · Q4 · 补充语境
ex.en: Difficulties of documenting nocturnal pollinator visits and a general focus on diurnal invertebrate pollinators, such as Volucella bombylans, have resulted in ____ of information on nocturnal moth pollination of plants such as Rubus fruticosus L.
ex.zh: 记录夜间传粉者造访的困难，加上学界普遍聚焦于白天活动的无脊椎传粉者（如 Volucella bombylans），造成关于蛾类为 Rubus fruticosus L. 等植物夜间传粉的信息____。

senses.text: 迫使；强迫（compel sb to do sth）
使不得不信服；引起（注意、兴趣）

kin: compelling — adj. 引人入胜的；令人信服的——真题 18 次全为此形
compulsion / compulsory — n. 强制 / adj. 强制的、义务的

ex.en: Since NEC’s founding in 1967, its workshops and performances have given Black playwrights, including Walker, a forum for their compelling stories.
ex.mark: a forum for their compelling stories
ex.zh: 自 1967 年 NEC 成立以来，其工作坊与演出为包括 Walker 在内的黑人剧作家提供了发表自己那些引人入胜的故事的平台。

ex.src: 卷 2054 · Module M1 · Q10 · 补充语境
ex.en: The narrator and Schmidt are both art critics. When my first wife admitted to Schmidt over dinner that she didn’t find art, painting in particular, especially compelling, Schmidt winced, set down his fork, and sighed dramatically; he then excused himself, explaining an appointment he’d forgotten about had suddenly and inexplicably been remembered, while making it abundantly clear there was no appointment at all.
ex.zh: 叙述者和 Schmidt 都是艺术评论家。当我的第一任妻子在晚餐时向 Schmidt 承认，她并不觉得艺术——尤其是绘画——有多大的吸引力时，Schmidt 皱起眉头、放下叉子、夸张地叹了口气；随后借口突然想起一个早已忘掉的约会离席而去，同时又让人一清二楚地看出根本没有那个约会。

senses.text: 复杂化；使情况变复杂的事物；难题
并发症

kin: complicate / complicated — v. 使复杂化 / adj. 复杂的

ex.en: While innovations to mitigate these challenges have been emerging—the use of autonomous delivery robots, for instance—success has been constrained due to the additional complications that arise (e.g., robots travel relatively slowly since they must navigate many ground-level obstacles).
ex.zh: 虽然缓解这些挑战的创新不断涌现——例如使用无人机——成效却因随之而来的额外难题（如居民区缺少合适的无人机起降点）而受限。

ex.src: 卷 2020 · Module M2 · Q12 · 补充语境
ex.en: While innovations to mitigate these challenges have been emerging—the use of cargo bikes, for instance —success has been constrained due to the additional complications that arise (e.g., cargo bikes must frequently return to depots to pick up new parcels).
ex.zh: 尽管应对这些挑战的创新不断涌现——例如货运自行车的使用——但由于随之而来的额外复杂性（如货运自行车必须频繁返回仓库取新包裹），成效仍然受限。

senses.text: 同心的；同轴的（concentric circles / rings）
con-（共同）+ center（中心）+ -ic

kin: concentric ≠ eccentric — 后者是「古怪的；偏心的」——经典反义对照
concentric circles — 同心圆——社科与艺术史常出现的空间模型

ex.en: For example, in his 1968 work Annual Rings, Dennis Oppenheim fashioned concentric lines that look like tree rings into the ice that covered a waterway.
ex.zh: 例如，Dennis Oppenheim 在他 1968 年的作品《年轮》（Annual Rings）中，在被水道覆盖的冰面上刻出状如树木年轮的同心线。

ex.src: 卷 2053 · Module M2 · Q8 · 补充语境
ex.en: Greater positive effect was reported by participants in their study who warmly thanked a shuttle driver than by those who didn't speak to the driver. Text 2Social relations research commonly draws on a model that centers an individual within three concentric circles.
ex.zh: 研究中热情感谢班车司机的参与者报告的积极情绪，高于不和司机交谈的参与者。——社会关系研究通常采用一个以个体为圆心、三个同心圆为框架的模型。

kin: conference — n. 会议；conferral n. 授予

ex.en: In a discussion of the study, a student hypothesizes that small breeds of dogs (for example, bulldogs) must share a version that represses IGF-1 production that would otherwise confer larger body size.
ex.zh: 在对这项研究的讨论中，一名学生提出假说：小型犬（如斗牛犬）必定共有某个抑制 IGF-1 生成的基因版本——若非如此，该基因本会赋予它们更大的体型。

ex.src: 卷 2041 · Module M1 · Q11 · 补充语境
ex.en: Based on observations made over three years, scientists concluded that temperatures at the site likely confer reproductive benefits and that the site is used exclusively for reproduction—6,000 M. robustus adults, hatchlings, and eggs were observed at the garden, but no juveniles were present.
ex.zh: 基于三年的观察，科学家们得出结论：该地点的温度很可能带来繁殖上的益处，且该地点专用于繁殖——在园地观察到 6000 只 M. robustus 成体、幼体和卵，但未发现亚成体。

de-（离开）+ via（路）→ 离开正路

deviant / deviancy — adj. 偏离常态的 / n. 越轨
