ex.en: When Chen Zhao et al.analyzed U-238 concentrations and U-234/U-238 AR across vertical and horizontal gradients in Gahai Lake and Tuosu Lake in China, however, they found no significant deviation in values within the same lake.
ex.zh: 然而，当 Chen Zhao 等人分析中国尕海湖与托素湖在垂直和水平梯度上的 U-238 浓度与 U-234/U-238 活度比时，他们发现同一湖内的数值并无显著偏离。

ex.src: 卷 2065 · Module M1 · Q12 · 补充语境
ex.en: The table shows the average Mb levels and their standard deviations (indicating how dispersed the Mb levels of individual fish are in relation to the average) of three teleost fish species, as calculated by Daniel J.
ex.zh: 表中展示了 Daniel J. 等人计算的三种硬骨鱼的平均肌红蛋白水平及其标准差（反映各条鱼的数值相对平均值的离散程度）。

senses.text: 扭曲；使变形；歪曲（事实、声音、图像）
dis-（离、坏）+ tort（扭）→ 扭得走了形

kin: distortion — n. 扭曲；失真（真题高频）
distort ≠ contort — 后者侧重「（身体）扭曲」，前者可用于抽象事物

ex.en: And even the hyperpop artists who don't rely on pitch-shifting, such as Shygirl, often distort their vocals using digital tools.
ex.zh: 即便是那些不依赖变调的 hyperpop 艺人（如 Shygirl），也常借助数字工具对人声进行失真处理。

ex.src: 卷 2060 · Module M1 · Q15 · 补充语境
ex.en: Dermatological researchers and geneticists make regular use of representative cross-sections of hair fibers, but such a cross-section can be obtained only if the strand can be cut perpendicular to its length without distorting the cross-sectional shape, which necessitates embedding the hair in a stabilizing medium, often resin, before sectioning it.
ex.zh: 皮肤病学研究者与遗传学家经常使用毛发的代表性横截面，但只有当毛干能被垂直于其长度切断而不使横截面形状变形时，才能获得这种截面——因此切片前需要把毛发包埋在树脂等稳定介质中。

senses.text: 驯化（野生动物）；栽培（野生植物）
使适应家庭生活；使变得家居化

kin: domestic / domestication — adj. 家庭的；驯养的 / n. 驯化
domesticated animals — 驯养动物——真题搭配

ex.en: Dogs and modern gray wolves share a recent wolf ancestor from which dogs were domesticated.
ex.zh: 狗与现代灰狼共有近代的一个狼祖先，狗正是由此驯化而来的。

ex.src: 卷 2097 · Module M2 · Q14 · 补充语境
ex.en: A research team led by Ruiwen Fan may have solved the mystery, concluding that the alpaca is the domesticated form of the vicuña but that the modern alpaca gets only 64 percent of its genetic material from its wild ancestor.
ex.zh: Ruiwen Fan 领导的研究团队或许解开了这个谜团：羊驼是小羊驼的驯化形态，但现代羊驼的遗传物质仅有 64% 来自其野生祖先。

senses.text: 把…嵌入；使埋入、使植入（embedded in / with）
使（观念、态度）深植、根深蒂固

kin: embedded — adj. 嵌入的——真题主要形态
embed ≠ imbed — 后者为异体拼写，现代英语以 embed 为准

ex.en: Walker and colleagues worked to modify Komagataeibacter rhaeticus bacteria to produce a pellicle with embedded pigmentation cells, thereby allowing the pellicle to "dye" itself from the inside.
ex.zh: Walker 及其同事对木葡糖酸醋杆菌（Komagataeibacter rhaeticus）进行改造，使其产出的菌膜中含有嵌入的色素细胞，从而让菌膜能从内部「染上」颜色。

ex.src: 卷 2084 · Module M2 · Q13 · 补充语境
ex.en: Within selected summaries, researchers embedded markers of attentive listening (e.g., references to specific details), hypothesizing that such indications would positively influence perceptions of listening skill even in the context of disagreement.
ex.zh: 在经过筛选的概述中，研究者植入了专注倾听的标记（如对具体细节的呼应），并假设即便在存在分歧的语境下，这类迹象也会提升人们对倾听技巧的感知。

senses.text: 编码；把…译成代码
对（信息）进行编码以便记忆与存储

kin: decode — v. 解码——真题另现 7 次，与 encode 成对
encoding / code — n. 编码 / n. 代码；密码

ex.en: Only recently, however, have ethnographers started to recognize that many Indigenous songs encode and transmit valuable ecological knowledge—citing, for instance, songs of the Kwakwaka’wakw people in British Columbia, Canada, that share vital information about clam gardens, and those of the Kazakh people in Bayan-Ölgii, Mongolia, that explain the quality of foraging and water in different locations.
ex.zh: 直到最近，民族志学者才开始认识到：许多原住民歌曲承载并传递着宝贵的生态知识——例如加拿大不列颠哥伦比亚省夸夸嘉夸人的歌曲分享关于蛤蜊养殖园的重要信息，蒙古国巴彦乌列盖的哈萨克人歌曲则讲述不同地点的草料与水质。

ex.src: 卷 2032 · Module M2 · Q11 · 补充语境
ex.en: In a study of the evolution of DptA and DptB—Diptericin genes encoding antimicrobial peptides that combat pathogens and foster beneficial microbes in fruit flies (Drosophila)—researchers assessed Drosophila melanogaster resistance to pathogenic infections by Providencia rettgeri and Acetobacter sicerae, bacteria common in the flies' environments.
ex.zh: 在一项关于 DptA 与 DptB 演化的研究中——这两个 Diptericin 基因编码的抗菌肽能对抗病原体、并帮助果蝇（Drosophila）体内的有益微生物——研究者评估了黑腹果蝇对 Providencia rettgeri 与 Acetobacter sicerae 这类常见于其环境中的细菌所引发的病原感染的抵抗力。

senses.text: 造成；引发；使产生（情感、变化、结果）
en-（使）+ gender（产生）→ 使之生成

kin: engendered — adj./v. 被引发的——真题主要形态
engender ≠ endanger — 后者是「危及」，形近异义

ex.en: By the mid 1980s, however, increased public awareness and environmental reforms, along with a decline in meat prices, engendered a natural forest regrowth, as evident by the .
ex.zh: 然而到了 20 世纪 80 年代中期，公众环保意识的提高与环境改革，加上肉价下跌，共同促成了森林的自然再生。

ex.src: 卷 2082 · Module M2 · Q5 · 补充语境
ex.en: Citing the uniquely absorbing nature of motion pictures, he contended that US propaganda should equal popular films in its appeal, entertaining audiences while engendering views of the nation as an ally.
ex.zh: 他援引电影无与伦比的感染力，主张美国的宣传应与商业大片同样具有吸引力——在娱乐观众的同时，塑造美国作为盟友的形象。

senses.text: （事物的）方面；侧面（a facet of history / his views）
（宝石的）琢面、小平面

kin: multifaceted — adj. 多面的——真题另现
facet ≠ face it — 拼写相近，注意区分
aspect / dimension — n. 方面 / n. 维度——近义

ex.en: This depiction of Hamilton establishes him as a compelling and well-defined protagonist but obscures other facets of the historical person’s views, namely his elitism and mistrust of the democratic politics of some of his contemporaries.
ex.zh: 这一刻画把 Hamilton 塑造成一个引人入胜、性格鲜明的主角，却遮蔽了这位历史人物观点的其他侧面——即他的精英主义立场，以及他对同时代某些人的民主政治的不信任。

ex.src: 卷 2030 · Module M1 · Q25 · 补充语境
ex.en: The book provides a multifaceted exploration of the concept of nostalgia..
ex.zh: 这本书对「怀旧」这一概念进行了多层面的探索。

senses.text: （拳击、军事）虚晃一招以迷惑对手，feint and dodge
与 faint（昏厥 / 微弱）同音异义；真题 feinting and dodging like a boxer 是明喻信号

ex.en: He was not running, he merely moved with a light-poised and watchful celerity, weaving among the calico rushes of the animals, feinting and dodging like a boxer until he reached the gate and crossed the yard.
ex.mark: the animals, feinting and dodging like
ex.zh: 他并非在奔跑，只是以一种轻盈警觉的敏捷移动，在花斑动物之间穿行，像拳击手那样虚晃、闪躲，直到抵达大门、穿过院落。

senses.text: 波动；起伏；变动（数量、水平、情绪）
seasonal fluctuations 季节性波动——真题搭配

kin: fluctuate — v. 波动——真题另现 7 次
fluctuation ≠ flux — flux 强调「持续不断的变化状态」

ex.en: Drosophila (fruit flies) have generation times of 10-12 days, so seasonal changes in humidity and other environmental conditions can drive seasonal fluctuations in chromosome rearrangements in species such as D. persimilis and D. subobscura.
ex.zh: 果蝇（Drosophila）的世代周期只有 10—12 天，因此湿度等环境条件的季节变化会驱动 D. persimilis 与 D. subobscura 等物种染色体倒位的季节性波动。

ex.src: 卷 2032 · Module M2 · Q10 · 补充语境
ex.en: A second research team has therefore hypothesized that in low visibility, a fish will be more likely to avoid an obstruction when the associated pressure fluctuations at the fish's snout are greater.
ex.zh: 因此，第二支研究团队提出假设：在低能见度下，与障碍物相关的鱼吻压力波动越大，鱼越可能避开障碍物。

senses.text: 使突出；使成为焦点、置于显著位置
（画面的）前景；（讨论的）核心位置

background — n. 背景——反义对照

ex.en: So George Inness’s decision to foreground a railroad in his 1855 painting The Lackawanna Valley is notable, since images of railroads often alluded to the destruction of wilderness in the name of progress.
ex.zh: 因此，乔治·英尼斯 1855 年在画作《拉克瓦纳山谷》中把一条铁路置于前景，这一点颇为引人注目——因为铁路形象在当时往往暗指以进步之名对荒野的破坏。

ex.src: 卷 2050 · Module M2 · Q26 · 补充语境
ex.en: Such an analysis of Anne Vallaye-Coster's Still Life with Lobster might consider how the painting's sharply contrasting colors place primary emphasis on the lobster in the foreground. .
ex.zh: 对 Anne Vallaye-Coster《龙虾静物画》的这种分析，或可考察画中强烈的色彩对比如何把主要重心放在前景的龙虾上。

senses.text: （种子）发芽；萌发
（想法、情感）开始发展；萌芽

kin: germination — n. 发芽（真题另现 11 次）
germ — n. 胚芽；病菌（同根异义）

ex.en: You might think the answer to these questions is obviously no, but researchers in the Netherlands recently showed that the seeds of many common plant species can germinate in soil designed to simulate Martian conditions, as long as water is supplied.
ex.mark: can germinate in soil designed to simulate Martian conditions
ex.zh: 你也许以为这些问题的答案显然是否定的，但荷兰的研究者最近证明：只要供水充足，许多常见植物的种子能够在模拟火星环境的土壤中发芽。

ex.src: 卷 2058 · Module M1 · Q27 · 补充语境
ex.en: Of these, 180 seeds (60%) germinated. .
ex.zh: 其中 180 粒种子（60%）发了芽。

ex.en: Humans are overwhelmingly right‑hand dominant (85‑90%) and can thus be said to exhibit strong population‑level right handedness (PLRH).
ex.zh: 人类绝大多数惯用右手（85–90%），因此可以说表现出很强的群体层面右利手偏向（PLRH）。

ex.src: 卷 2065 · Module M1 · Q13 · 补充语境
ex.en: However, the latter study included only 14 individuals, and a meta-analysis of primate-laterality studies demonstrated that a minimum sample size of 176 individuals is required to be confident that a finding of population-level handedness is not mere statistical noise.
ex.zh: 然而后者只纳入了 14 个个体；而对灵长类偏侧性研究的元分析表明，要确信「种群级别的利手偏好」并非统计噪声，至少需要 176 个个体的样本。

senses.text: 迄今；在此之前（正式 / 法律语体，相当于 until now）
多见于学术与法律文本，日常英语改用 until now / previously

kin: henceforth — adv. 从此以后——方向相反，真题另现
theretofore — adv. 直到那时

ex.en: Distant reading, or computer-assisted quantitative analysis of massive collections of digitized texts, can reveal stylistic elements that have heretofore escaped notice, despite being shared by numerous texts from the modernist period.
ex.zh: 远读（即借助计算机对海量数字化文本进行量化分析）能够揭示出迄今为止一直被忽视的风格要素——尽管现代主义时期的众多文本其实共享这些要素。

ex.en: Today's theater stages are frequently filled with props and scenery to immerse the audience in a play's world.
ex.zh: 如今的戏剧舞台常常摆满道具与布景，让观众沉浸于剧作的世界。

ex.src: 卷 2041 · Module M1 · Q9 · 补充语境
ex.en: After traveling to the United States and Europe in the early 1930s and immersing himself in an international architectural discourse, Barragán began incorporating principles derived from functionalism and modernism in his work, as seen in the apartment building for José Mojica, whose unadorned geometric forms contrast with the historically inspired architecture found in the Harper de Garibi House, one of Barragán's early projects in Guadalajara.
ex.zh: 1930 年代初游历美国与欧洲、并沉浸于国际建筑话语之后，巴拉干开始把源自功能主义与现代主义的原则纳入自己的作品，这可见于为何塞·莫希卡设计的公寓楼——其不加修饰的几何形式，与瓜达拉哈拉早期项目 Harper de Garibi 住宅的历史风格建筑形成对比。

ex.en: Thomas Piketty and other historians of capitalism rarely discuss domestic capitalism in Africa before the period of European colonization, implicitly presenting capitalism as external to and imposed on Africa.
ex.mark: implicitly presenting capitalism as external to
ex.zh: 托马斯·皮凯蒂等资本主义史学家很少讨论欧洲殖民时期之前非洲本土的资本主义，这就含蓄地把资本主义呈现为外在于非洲、并被强加于非洲的东西。

ex.en: • It implicitly criticizes the immense popularity of Pamela by satirizing the earlier novel’s subject matter and style.

ex.zh: 奇里巴亚犬（Chiribaya dog）在欧洲人殖民秘鲁之前就已存在，后来因与欧洲人带来的狗杂交而消失。

ex.src: 卷 2045 · Module M1 · Q9 · 补充语境
ex.en: But petroleum extraction is a very carbon-intensive industry, so as social attitudes increasingly favor using less carbon-intensive sources of energy, demand for petroleum falls and the drilling equipment will eventually, or even suddenly, become a liability as reduced petroleum prices make it more difficult to recover the expense of maintaining such equipment.
ex.zh: 但石油开采是高度碳密集型产业，随着社会态度日益青睐低碳能源，石油需求下降，钻井设备终将——甚至可能突然——沦为负资产：油价走低使收回设备维护成本愈发困难。

ex.zh: 研究者长期以来假设：北美的长毛猛犸象是被使用带槽矛尖（即克洛维斯矛尖）的人类猎杀至灭绝的。

ex.src: 卷 2093 · Module M2 · Q15 · 补充语境
ex.en: In 2014, Marianne Dehasque et al. challenged earlier theories on causes of woolly mammoth extinction that emphasized isolation and inbreeding and a resulting increase in genetic variation and increase in chances of harmful genetic mutations.
ex.zh: 2014 年，Marianne Dehasque 等人向先前强调「隔离与近交、遗传变异增加及有害突变概率上升」的长毛猛犸象灭绝理论发起了挑战。

senses.text: 忧郁；愁绪；伤感
忧郁的；令人伤感的（a melancholy tune）

kin: melancholic — adj. 忧郁的；melancholia n. 忧郁症
melancholy ≠ memory — 仅形近，无词源关系，勿联想

ex.en: He surveyed the fence, and all gladness left him and a deep melancholy settled down upon his spirit.
ex.mark: a deep melancholy settled down upon his spirit
ex.zh: 他打量着那道栅栏，所有的欢愉都离他而去，一种深沉的忧郁沉沉地压上他的心头。

senses.text: （使）混合；交融（mingle with）
与人交往、应酬（mingle with the guests）

kin: intermingle — v. 相互混合——同义，语气更强
mingle ≠ mangle — 后者是「撕裂、严重损坏」，形近异义

ex.en: My spirit swoons, and all my senses cryFor Ocean's breast and covering of the sky. Rock me to sleep, ye waves, and outward bound,Just let me drift far out from toil and care,Where lapping of the waves shall be the sound,Which mingled with the winds that gently bearMe on between a peaceful sea and sky,To make my soothing slumberous lullaby.
ex.zh: 我的神魂昏沉，百骸齐呼，要大海的胸膛与天空的覆被。摇我入眠吧，浪涛，任我向外漂去，远远离开劳苦与忧烦；拍岸的浪声与轻拂的风交融在一起，载我行于平静的海天之间，织成一支抚人入眠的催眠曲。

ex.src: 卷 2029 · Module M1 · Q5 · 补充语境
ex.en: Brown with a mingled feeling of respect and admiration.
ex.zh: Brown 心中交织着敬意与钦佩。

senses.text: 极简主义者（的）；极简主义的（艺术、音乐、设计）
minimalist 是一种风格派别，minimal 只是「最少的」

kin: minimalism — n. 极简主义；minimal adj. 最小的
the minimalist movement — 极简主义运动——真题搭配

ex.en: Belonging to neither the minimalist nor the abstract art movements but heavily influencing both, Constantin Brâncuși spent his sculpting career returning to the same few themes—a kiss, a sleeping head, and a bird in flight—each rendered in pristine, simple, almost abstract forms.
ex.mark: neither the minimalist nor the abstract art movements
ex.zh: 康斯坦丁·布朗库西既不属于极简主义也不属于抽象艺术运动，却对两者影响深远；他的雕塑生涯不断回到同样的几个主题——一个吻、一颗沉睡的头颅、一只飞翔的鸟——每一个都以纯净、[洗练的形态呈现]。

ex.src: 卷 2027 · Module M2 · Q8 · 补充语境
ex.en: Thus his minimalist style is central to his storytelling.
ex.zh: 因此，他的极简主义风格正是其叙事的核心。

senses.text: 爱恶作剧、淘气的（mischievous jokes）
（后果）恶意的、惹麻烦的；重音在第一音节，注意拼写 mis-chie-vous

ex.en: Davis focuses on how Rainey and Smith improvised the lyrics — replacing the original lines with mischievous jokes and wordplay.
ex.mark: lines with mischievous jokes and wordplay.
ex.zh: Davis 重点分析 Rainey 与 Smith 如何即兴改词——把原词换成调皮的玩笑和文字游戏。

ex.src: 卷 2092 · Module M1 · Q1 · 补充语境
ex.en: Aunt Polly is having dinner with Tom, her mischievous young nephew.
ex.zh: 波莉姨妈正和她顽皮的小侄子汤姆一起吃晚饭。

senses.text: 中篇小说（篇幅长于短篇、短于长篇）
novel 长篇小说；novelette 中短篇小说（有时含贬义）

kin: novel — n. 长篇小说；adj. 新奇的——同一拼写两义
novella ≠ novella 与 nova — 后者是天文学「新星」

ex.en: By featuring main characters who are Blackfeet, like Jones himself, the novella also helped to ensure that Indigenous people have a place within the horror genre.
ex.mark: the novella also helped to ensure
ex.zh: 由于主角是与琼斯本人同属黑脚族的原住民，这部中篇小说也有助于确保原住民在恐怖小说这一类型中占有一席之地。

ex.src: 卷 2027 · Module M1 · Q5 · 补充语境
ex.en: His acclaimed 2013 novella Him Standing is set in an urban Indigenous community in Canada.
ex.zh: 他广受好评的 2013 年中篇小说 Him Standing 以加拿大的一个城市原住民社区为背景。

senses.text: 有毒的；有害的（气体、物质、环境）
令人厌恶的；道德上有害的

kin: noxious ≠ obnoxious — 后者是「惹人讨厌的」，形近异义
toxic / poisonous — adj. 有毒的——近义替换

ex.en: Some scientists have hypothesized that this capability evolved because it imposes a lower metabolic cost than does the alternative mechanism of producing chemicals that render moths noxious to bats.
ex.zh: 一些科学家假设，这一能力之所以演化出来，是因为它比另一种机制——制造化学物质使蛾子对蝙蝠而言变得难吃——所需的代谢成本更低。

ex.src: 卷 2111 · Module M2 · Q15 · 补充语境
ex.en: Kendall et al.found that Yponomeuta padella, a species of small-bodied moths that produces noxious substances, emits ultrasonic pulses that closely resemble the acoustic aposematic signals of Arctia villica, a noxious moth species in the large-bodied Arctiinae family whose distribution overlaps with that of Y.padella.
ex.zh: Kendall 等人发现：不产生有毒物质的小型蛾类 Yponomeuta padella 发出的超声波脉冲，与灯蛾科大型有毒蛾类 Arctia villica 的声音警戒信号十分相似——后者的分布区与前者重叠。

senses.text: 观察力敏锐的；留心的（become more observant）
observant（善于观察）≠ observational（观察性的，形容研究）

kin: observe / observation / observational — v. 观察 / n. 观察 / adj. 观察性的——真题三形皆现
observant ≠ observance — 后者是「遵守；仪式」
perceptive / attentive — adj. 有洞察力的 / adj. 专心的——近义

ex.en: They concluded that the mating environment hypothesis is not well supported by their observational data.
ex.zh: 他们得出结论：交配环境假说并未得到其观察数据的有力支持。

senses.text: 在…上打孔；使穿孔
perforated adj. 带孔的、穿孔的

kin: perforation — n. 孔眼；穿孔（亦指邮票齿孔）
perforate ≠ perforate 与 penetrate — 后者是「穿透」，不必留下孔洞

ex.en: Eventually, as evidenced by artifacts at Xiaogushan in East Asia, someone perforated the end of a bone awl to make an eye (hole) to hold the cord, thereby creating a sewing needle with which both steps could be performed in a single motion.
ex.mark: perforated the end of a bone awl
ex.zh: 最终，正如东亚小孤山出土器物所显示的那样，有人在骨锥的末端钻出一个孔（眼）来穿线，由此造出了缝衣针——有了它，两道工序可以一气呵成。

ex.src: 卷 2081 · Module M1 · Q12 · 补充语境
ex.en: Eventually, people made needles by perforating the end of a bone awl with an eye (hole) to hold the cord, thereby enabling the simultaneous performance of the previously separate actions of puncturing and threading.
ex.zh: 最终，人们通过在骨锥末端钻出一个孔（眼）来穿线，制成缝衣针，从而使原本分开的「刺穿」与「穿线」两道工序可以同时完成。

senses.text: 期刊；定期出版物（报纸与杂志的统称）
定期的；周期的

kin: periodic / periodically — adj. 周期的 / adv. 定期地
periodical ≠ period — period 是「时期」，periodical 是「期刊」

ex.en: Gustav Frank and Madleen Podewski have observed that although serialized publication and a commercial focus mark periodicals as quite distinct from other objects of literary analysis, the periodical is insufficiently theorized as a unique form, leaving scholars heavily reliant on methods of literary criticism developed for analyzing other types of texts, as well as methods arising from other fields entirely, such as visual studies.
ex.zh: Gustav Frank 与 Madleen Podewski 观察到：尽管连载出版与商业导向使期刊明显区别于文学分析的其他对象，但期刊作为一种独特形式仍未得到充分的理论化，致使学者严重依赖为分析其他类型文本而发展出的文学批评方法，乃至来自视觉研究等完全其他领域的方法。

ex.src: 卷 2612 · Module RW · Q102 · 补充语境
ex.en: As can be seen in the case of The Egoist, a London magazine published from January 1914 to December 1919, some small periodicals influential in the development of the modernist movement have been explored in depth by scholars.
ex.zh: 从 1914 年 1 月至 1919 年 12 月在伦敦出版的杂志《利己主义者》（The Egoist）一例可以看出，一些对现代主义运动发展颇具影响力的小型期刊已被学者深入研究。

senses.text: 平静的；宁静的（水面、景色）
温和的；不易动怒的（a placid temperament）

kin: placidity — n. 平静；placidly adv. 平静地
placid 与 placate — 同根（plac- 取悦、安抚）：placate 是「安抚」

ex.en: Some art historians suggest that Highwaymen paintings played a role in shaping popular perceptions of the state that persist today: the natural iconography that McLendon and colleagues constantly revisited—placid inland rivers, windswept palm trees—is now seen as classically Floridian.
ex.zh: 「公路画家」（the Highwaymen）的画作因预见并放大了后来广植于公众意识的佛罗里达印象而引人注目，其作品极易辨识——靠的是那些自然意象：平静的内陆河流、迎风的棕榈……

ex.src: 卷 2003 · Module M2 · Q26 · 补充语境
ex.en: The mood in the paintings is placid.
ex.zh: 这些画作的情绪基调是宁静的。

senses.text: 由 prior（院长）主持、附属于大修道院的小型宗教团体及其院舍
小于 abbey（大修道院）；真题中 Sempringham Priory 是产权纠纷的一方，属机构名词

ex.en: But his conflict with Sempringham Priory must be seen as an indirect result of a property dispute involving land on which his manor sat: he was taking property to which he thought he had a right.
ex.mark: with Sempringham Priory must be seen
ex.zh: 但他与 Sempringham 小修道院的冲突，应视为一场法律上权属含糊的地产纠纷的间接结果——他取走的，似乎是他真诚相信本就属于自己的财产。

senses.text: 支持者；倡导者（a proponent of X）
pro-（赞成、向前）+ pon（放置）+ -ent（人）

kin: opponent — n. 对手；反对者——反义，形近
advocate / supporter — n. 倡导者 / 支持者——近义替换

ex.en: Some proponents of the hypothesis argue that iron production technologies first arrived in North Africa through Carthage, where the earliest evidence of ironworking dates to approximately 800–600 BCE, before these technologies spread to sub-Saharan Africa over the following centuries.
ex.mark: Some proponents of the hypothesis argue
ex.zh: 该假说的一些支持者主张，冶铁技术最初是经由迦太基传入北非的——那里最早的冶铁证据可追溯到约公元前 800 至 600 年——之后这些技术才传播到撒哈拉以南非洲。

senses.text: 得体；适当；规矩（propriety of demeanour 举止得体）
proprieties n.（社交）礼节、规矩

kin: proper / properly — adj. 适当的 / adv. 适当地
propriety ≠ property — 后者是「财产；属性」，形近异义

ex.en: Comfortable they certainly were, but neither gorgeous nor even grand; indeed, considering the money that had been spent there, the eye and taste might have been better served; there was an air of heaviness about the rooms which might have been avoided without any sacrifice of propriety; colours might have been better chosen and lights more perfectly diffused; but perhaps in doing so the thorough clerical aspect of the whole might have been somewhat marred.
ex.zh: 他没有弟弟们那样的杰出才华，但在判断力与举止得体方面胜过他们；如果说他有缺点，那便是对措辞的关注超过了对实质内容的关注；他身上有太多机巧，而且……

senses.text: 类星体（极其明亮、极为遥远的天体）
quasar ← quasi-stellar radio source（类星射电源）

kin: quasi- 前缀 — 表「类似、准」：quasi-scientific 准科学的
quasar ≠ quasar 与 quiver — 无词源关系，勿联想

ex.en: Quasars range in age, with approximately 200 of them known to have developed within the first billion years of the formation of the universe.
ex.zh: 类星体的年龄各不相同，已知约有 200 个是在宇宙形成后的最初十亿年内出现的。

ex.src: 卷 2042 · Module M1 · Q15 · 补充语境
ex.en: Quasars—such as QSO J0005-0006, located in the Pisces constellation—are extremely luminous galactic nuclei powered by supermassive black holes.
ex.zh: 类星体——如位于双鱼座方向的 QSO J0005-0006——是极其明亮的星系核，由超大质量黑洞供能。

senses.text: 正式批准；使（条约、宪法、协议）生效
ratify 强调「有权机构正式批准」，approve 只是「同意」

kin: ratification — n. 正式批准
ratify ≠ rectify — 后者是「纠正、矫正」，形近异义

ex.en: They were published pseudonymously in the Independent Journal and other New York newspapers in 1787-88 and argue that New Yorkers should vote to ratify the proposed United States Constitution.
ex.mark: vote to ratify the proposed United States Constitution
ex.zh: 这些文章于 1787—1788 年以笔名发表在《独立日报》及其他纽约报纸上，主张纽约人应当投票批准拟议中的美国宪法。

ex.src: 卷 2062 · Module M1 · Q10 · 补充语境
ex.en: Ratified in 2017 by two-thirds of World Trade Organization member nations, the Trade Facilitation Agreement (TFA) is a trade-reform measure that aims to reduce redundant customs procedures and other costly aspects of international trade.
ex.zh: 《贸易便利化协定》（TFA）于 2017 年获世界贸易组织三分之二成员国批准，是一项贸易改革措施，旨在精简冗余的海关程序并降低国际贸易的其他成本。

senses.text: 现实主义者；[艺术] 现实主义作家 / 画家
magical realist novels 魔幻现实主义小说（真题高频）

kin: realism / realistic — n. 现实主义 / adj. 现实主义的；务实的
realist ≠ realist 与 royalist — 后者是「保王党人」，形近

ex.en: This style has exerted a decisive influence on authors around the world, including Keri Hulme, whose 1984 novel The Bone People resembles classic magical realist novels in its juxtaposition of literary realism with cultural traditions—namely, those of the Maori, the Indigenous people of New Zealand.
ex.zh: 这一风格对世界各地的作家产生了决定性影响，其中包括 Keri Hulme：她 1984 年的小说《骨中人》（The Bone People）把文学现实主义与毛利人（新西兰原住民）的文化传统并置，酷似经典的魔幻现实主义小说。

ex.src: 卷 2075 · Module M2 · Q11 · 补充语境
ex.en: This style has exerted a decisive influence on authors in the United States, including Toni Morrison, whose 1987 novel Beloved resembles classic magical realist novels in its juxtaposition of literary realism with long-established cultural traditions—namely, those of the Black American community.
ex.zh: 这一风格对美国作家产生了决定性影响，其中包括托妮·莫里森——她 1987 年的小说《宠儿》将文学现实主义与源远流长的文化传统（即非裔美国人社区的传统）并置，酷似经典的魔幻现实主义小说。

senses.text: 残余；剩余部分；遗迹（remnants of X）
remnant 强调「大块消失后剩下的小块」，remainder 是数学上的「余数」

kin: remain / remainder — v. 剩余 / n. 余数；剩余物
remnants of a supercontinent — 超大陆的残余部分——真题搭配

ex.en: Some researchers posit that the species inhabiting the South Pacific island of Grande Terre belong to clades that predate the island’s split from remnants of the former supercontinent Gondwana around 80 million years ago.
ex.mark: remnants of the former supercontinent Gondwana
ex.zh: 一些研究者假定，栖息于南太平洋格朗德特尔岛的物种所属的演化支，其出现时间早于该岛约 8000 万年前从前超大陆冈瓦纳的残余部分分裂出去的时间。

ex.src: 卷 2082 · Module M2 · Q9 · 补充语境
ex.en: Wang and colleagues recovered microscopic remnants of turmeric and other spices from the surfaces of the tools.
ex.zh: Wang 及同事从工具表面提取出了姜黄等香料的微观残留物。

senses.text: 拒绝接受；否认；断然驳斥（主张、说法、责任）
repudiate 比 reject 更重，含「与之划清界限」的意味

kin: repudiation — n. 否认；拒绝接受
repudiate vs refute — refute 是「用证据反驳」，repudiate 是「拒绝承认」

ex.en: It had seemed like a big lot until now, but now the very idea that all that fury and motion should be transpiring inside any one fence was something to be repudiated with contempt, like a mirror trick.
ex.mark: something to be repudiated with contempt
ex.zh: 直到此刻之前，那似乎还是好大一片地方；可现在，想到所有的狂暴与骚动竟都发生在某一道栅栏之内，这念头就成了应当带着轻蔑予以拒斥的东西，如同镜子的戏法一般。

ex.src: 卷 2611 · Module M1 · Q11 · 补充语境
ex.en: whenever Jimmie, a young boy, has been scolded by his father A “Henry would sometimes choose to absolutely repudiate [Jimmie’s for misbehavior, he seeks behavior], and when Jimmie appeared in his shame would bully him comfort from Henry Johnson, most virtuously, preaching with assurance the precepts of [Jimmie’s the ma

senses.text: 生物学 / 解剖学：血管、叶脉或神经的网状分布与交织
系统、机构或网络之间形成多重交叉连接的过程
印刷 / 摄影：把连续图像转成网点结构的工艺

ex.en: Though reticulation did indeed have added costs, they were offset by its benefits.
ex.zh: 尽管网状化确实带来了额外成本，但这些成本被它带来的好处抵消了。

senses.text: 鸟类夜栖处、栖架；v. 栖息（cold roosts 指寒冷的夜栖点）
come home to roost（恶果回落）、rule the roost（当家作主）

ex.en: The two leading explanations for this behavior are the “warmer together” hypothesis, which holds that the goal is to attract more starlings to increase body heat in cold roosts, and the “safer together” hypothesis, which centers on defenses like crowding to make it hard for peregrine falcons and other predators to target a single bird.
ex.zh: 对这一行为的两种主流解释是「抱团取暖」假说（目标是招来更多椋鸟以在寒冷栖息地提升体温）与「抱团更安全」假说（侧重挤成一团，让游隼等捕食者难以锁定单只鸟）。

ex.src: 卷 2078 · Module M1 · Q14 · 补充语境
ex.en: But the lack of trees on such farms means a lack of spaces for many species of birds to roost.
ex.zh: 但这类农场缺乏树木，也就意味着许多鸟类物种缺少栖息的场所。

senses.text: 最突出、最值得注意的（the information the advertiser intends to be salient）
n. salient point 要点；与 prominent 相比更强调「在众多信息中被优先注意到」

kin: salience — 同词根构词变体，真题出现 1 次；已并入本词条

ex.en: In this case, players’ cognitive resources are directed foremost toward the advergame's mechanics, leaving little or no capacity for encoding and storing the information the advertiser intends to be salient.
ex.zh: 在这种情况下，玩家的认知资源首先被广告游戏的玩法机制占去，几乎没有余力去编码和储存广告主原本想让人记住、想让它凸显出来的信息。

ex.src: 卷 2082 · Module M2 · Q11 · 补充语境
ex.en: The researchers ran their model twice under different assumptions, concluding that emphasizing the salience of local population density over personal preferences generally yielded the best results.

senses.text: 稀缺；不足；匮乏（scarcity of X）
（经济学意义上的）稀缺性——与 abundance 相对

kin: scarce / scarcely — adj. 稀缺的 / adv. 几乎不
scarcity vs shortage — scarcity 是长期结构性稀缺，shortage 是短期短缺

ex.en: This relative scarcity made it all the more exciting when the team examined remains of well-preserved organic artifacts discovered in a cave in Spain and determined that they dated even further back than previously thought.
ex.zh: 正因为相对稀缺，当研究团队检视在西班牙一处洞穴中发现的保存完好的有机器物残件、并确定其年代比先前认为的更为久远时，才格外令人振奋。

ex.src: 卷 2088 · Module M1 · Q23 · 补充语境
ex.en: Under drought conditions, wheat plants produce smaller leaves, a common response to water scarcity that limits transpirational water loss and helps maintain osmotic balance.
ex.zh: 在干旱条件下，小麦的叶片长得更小——这是应对缺水的常见反应，可限制蒸腾失水并帮助维持渗透平衡。

senses.text: 语义的；与意义相关的
semantic relationships / semantic change 语义关系 / 语义演变

kin: semantics — n. 语义学
semantic ≠ semiotic — 后者是「符号学的」，形近异义

ex.en: … titled "Learning Semantic Relationships between Entities in Twitter." Williams's team searched for the term "Twitter" on the Scopus and Web of Science databases and found that …
ex.zh: 尽管较少为人所知，毕加索——他曾慨叹自己时代的作家「只局限于把词语挪来挪去，却还遵守着句法」——也写诗，其诗作违背常规的语法、语义关系与文本结构。

senses.text: （水面、光）泛起细碎流动的微光
shimmering adj. 常修饰 water / light / heat，与 glimmer（微光）、gleam（一道光）程度不同

ex.en: Lucie, a riverscape featuring the silhouette of a single palm tree against the backdrop of shimmering water and a brilliant moonlit sky, is typical of paintings by the Florida Highwaymen, loosely affiliated landscape artists mainly active in Fort Pierce, Florida, during the 1950s and ’60s.
ex.mark: backdrop of shimmering water and a
ex.zh: 《Lucie》以一株棕榈的剪影衬着粼粼水光与皎洁的月夜天空，是「佛罗里达公路客」画派的典型之作——这群联系松散的风景画家主要活跃于 1950 至 60 年代的佛州皮尔斯堡。

senses.text: 表示；意味着；是…的标志
signify 强调「作为信号 / 标志而具有意义」，mean 只是「意思是」

kin: significant / significance — adj. 重要的 / n. 意义；重要性
signify vs signal — signal 强调「发出信号」，signify 强调「意味着」

ex.en: However, it can be unclear whether an absence of artifacts signifies a cultural shift or is merely an effect of gaps in the archaeological record.
ex.zh: 然而，器物的缺席究竟意味着一次文化变迁，抑或只是考古记录存在缺环所造成的结果，这一点可能并不清楚。

ex.src: 卷 2111 · Module M1 · Q10 · 补充语境
ex.en: Then the song slows and a bell sounds, signifying the train coming to a stop.
ex.zh: 随后歌曲放慢，铃声响起，示意火车即将停站。

senses.text: （液体）保持将沸未沸的小火慢炖
（情绪、冲突）酝酿、即将爆发；simmer down 冷静下来

ex.en: Second, the textile is added to the heated dyebath and simmered until the goldenrod’s yellow color has transferred into the cloth.
ex.zh: 第二步，把织物放入加热的染浴中慢煮，直到一枝黄花的黄色染入布料。

ex.src: 卷 2611 · Module M2A · Q21 · 补充语境
ex.en: Next, they add the cloth to the dyebath and simmer it for hours, perhaps even days.

senses.text: 一丝不苟的、极细致的：对每个细节都精确、仔细到近乎苛求
meticulously 精心地、细致地（真题 4 次均为此词形）
拉丁 meticulous「过分谨慎的」→ 对细节如履薄冰般在意

kin: meticulously — adv. 精心地、细致地——真题高频词形（如 meticulously handcrafted 精工细作的）
meticulousness — n. 细致、严谨

ex.en: Historians argue that Morris's repudiation of industrialization is ______ the Kelmscott editions' use of handmade materials and intricate ornamentation reminiscent of medieval manuscripts: these meticulously handcrafted elements exemplify the artistry involved.
ex.zh: 历史学家认为，莫里斯对工业化的拒斥正体现在凯姆斯科特出版社对手工材料与繁复装饰的运用上——这些精心手工制作的元素令人想起中世纪手稿，充分展现了其中蕴含的工艺之美。

senses.text: 安抚（情绪）、缓解（疼痛）
soothing adj. 令人安定的；真题以 soothing slumberous lullaby 写海浪与风声织成的催眠曲

ex.en: Rock me to sleep, ye waves, and outward bound,Just let me drift far out from toil and care,Where lapping of the waves shall be the sound,Which mingled with the winds that gently bearMe on between a peaceful sea and sky,To make my soothing slumberous lullaby.
ex.zh: 我的神魂昏沉，百骸齐呼，要大海的胸膛与天空的覆被。摇我入眠吧，浪涛，向外漂去；就让我远远离开劳苦与忧烦，任拍岸的浪声混着柔风，把我托在海与天之间的宁静里，织成一支抚人入睡的催眠曲。

senses.text: 极小的斑点、一点点（a speck of dust / a rippling speck）
真题 a rippling speck against the sky 以「天空中一个颤动的小点」写风筝升得极高

ex.en: He watches his father raise a kite within minutes into the wind, so high that Gogol must tip his head back in order to see, a rippling speck against the sky.
ex.mark: a rippling speck against the sky.
ex.zh: 他看着父亲几分钟内就把风筝放上风里，高得果戈理必须仰起头才看得见——那只是衬在天空上、微微颤动的一个小点。

ex.src: 卷 2613 · Module RWM2E · Q1 · 补充语境
ex.en: He watches his father lift a kite within minutes into the wind, so high that Arun must tip his head back in order to see, a fluttering speck against the sky.

senses.text: 易感性；易受影响的性质（susceptibility to X）
（对疾病的）易感性

kin: susceptible — adj. 易受影响的（susceptible to）
susceptibility vs vulnerability — vulnerability 强调「易受伤害」，susceptibility 强调「易被影响」

ex.en: These animals are thought to be especially vulnerable to ocean acidification due to calcium carbonate's susceptibility to dissolution at lower pH values.
ex.zh: 这些动物被认为对海洋酸化尤为脆弱，因为碳酸钙在 pH 值较低时易于溶解。

ex.src: 卷 2034 · Module M2 · Q13 · 补充语境
ex.en: Students in a biology class investigated why individual house mice (Mus musculus) can differ from one another in their susceptibility to cataracts in old age.
ex.zh: 一个生物课上的学生小组研究了为什么个别小家鼠（Mus musculus）年老时患白内障的易感性各不相同。

senses.text: 暴风雨；狂风暴雨（文学 / 古语色彩，现代英语多用 storm）
骚动；风潮（a tempest of protest）

kin: tempestuous — adj. 暴风雨般的；动荡激烈的
The Tempest — 《暴风雨》——莎士比亚剧作，真题文本常客

ex.en: Several games, including the 1981game Tempest, are playable at the museum, but other games, including the 2003 game Eve Online, are shown only in video footage because they are too complex to exhibit in a playable form.
ex.zh: 包括 1981 年的游戏《Tempest》在内的几款游戏可在馆内试玩，但另一些游戏（如 2003 年的《Eve Online》）只能以视频形式展示——它们太过复杂，无法以可玩的形式展出。

ex.src: 卷 2053 · Module M1 · Q6 · 补充语境
ex.en: The poem is a dedication to Puerto Cabello, a town on the northern coast of Venezuela. And while outside the tempest is raving o’er the ocean,And the ship is madly driving on some lone and desert shore;Thy warm and land-locked waters swell with an easy motion,And gently glides the light pirogue [canoe] at dipping of the oar.
ex.zh: 这首诗是献给委内瑞拉北部海岸小镇波多卡贝洛的颂歌。任凭外面风暴在海上狂啸，任凭船儿疯狂地漂向孤寂荒凉的海岸；你温暖而闭锁的港湾水面轻柔起伏，轻舟在船桨起落间缓缓滑行。

senses.text: （论点、立场）站得住脚的；可维持的（tenable position / assumption）
（职位、阵地）可保持的

kin: tenability / tenure — n. 可维持性 / n. 任期；终身教职——同根 ten-（持有）
tenable ≠ untenable — 反义：untenable 站不住脚的
defensible / viable — adj. 可辩护的 / adj. 可行的——近义

ex.en: However, literary-critical methodologies in particular make assumptions about authorial control that to be tenable must be restricted to forms like novels, poems, and plays.
ex.mark: that to be tenable must be restricted to forms like novels
ex.zh: 然而，尤其是文学批评方法，其对作者控制权所作的假定若要站得住脚，就必须被限定在小说、诗歌、戏剧这类形式之内。

ex.src: 卷 2022 · Module M2 · Q7 · 补充语境
ex.en: Luu et al. point out, the singular nature of impact ejection makes it untenable as an account of multiple loss episodes of similar duration over several years.
ex.zh: Luu 等人指出，撞击喷出物的奇异性，使其无法解释数年间多次时长相近的损失事件。

senses.text: 文本的；与文本有关的（textual evidence / analysis / variant）
text（编织→文本）+ -ual
textual「文本的」≠ texture「质地；纹理」——形近异义

kin: text — n. 文本（真题题干高频：Text 1 / Text 2）
context / subtext — n. 语境 / 潜台词——同根，学术阅读常客

ex.en: The many editions of James Joyce's 1922 novel Ulysses are not textually identical, and scholars debate which versions reflect Joyce's authorial intent.
ex.zh: 《尤利西斯》1922年以来的众多版本在文本上并不完全一致，学者们仍在争论哪些版本才体现了乔伊斯的作者原意。

ex.src: 卷 2058 · Module M2 · Q10 · 补充语境
ex.en: The student wants to include two pieces of textual evidence that demonstrate people reacting in similar ways to this sensibility of Owen's.
ex.zh: 该学生想引用两处文本证据，证明人们对欧文这种气质的反应如出一辙。

senses.text: 发生；（事情）被人知晓、透露（It transpired that…：后来才知道…）
（植物）蒸腾；散发（水汽）——科技类文章的第二义
transpire「发生」≠ inspire / aspire / conspire，词根 spir-（呼吸）易混

kin: transpiration — n. 蒸腾（作用）
occur / come to light — 近义：发生 / 曝光

ex.en: … but now the very idea that all that fury and motion should be transpiring inside any one fence was something to be repudiated with contempt …
ex.mark: should be transpiring inside any one fence
ex.zh: 那片地方原本看起来很大，可如今一想到所有这些狂暴与骚动竟然都发生在同一道栅栏之内，就让人不由得要以轻蔑的态度加以否定，如同看待一场镜中戏法。

senses.text: 急速打转、回旋（whipped and whirled about）
一阵忙乱（a whirl of activity）；give it a whirl 试一试

ex.en: In rural Alabama, a man referred to as the stranger is walking among a group of untamed calico (spotted) horses that he has penned in a lot. [The horses] whipped and whirled about the lot like dizzy fish in a bowl.
ex.mark: whipped and whirled about the lot
ex.zh: 在密西西比乡间，一个被称作「陌生人」的男子正走在一群被他圈在围栏里的野性花斑马之间——[马群]像碗里晕头转向的鱼一样，在圈里甩尾打转。

senses.text: 极为（糟糕地）；可怜地（woefully inadequate / little / unaware）——书面强调副词，带「令人遗憾」色彩
woe（悲哀）+ -ful + -ly

kin: woeful — adj. 糟糕的；悲哀的
sadly / deplorably — 近义副词：令人遗憾地

ex.en: Meanwhile, the work of Dorothy Parker, who relied on conventional poetic forms associated with previous literary periods, attracts woefully little attention from scholars of modernism.
ex.mark: attracts woefully little attention from scholars of modernism
ex.zh: 与此同时，多萝西·帕克的作品因沿用与先前文学时期相关的传统诗体，只吸引到现代主义研究者少得可怜的关注。

ex.src: 卷 2021 · Module M2 · Q9 · 补充语境
ex.en: Meanwhile, John Steinbeck's Of Mice and Men, whose coherent, linear narrative structure recalls the fiction of previous centuries, attracts woefully little attention from scholars of modernism.Text 2Distant reading, or computer-assisted quantitative analysis of massive collections of digitized texts, can reveal stylistic elements that have heretofore escaped notice, despite being shared by numerous texts from the modernist period.
ex.mark: attracts woefully little attention from scholars of modernism
ex.zh: 与此同时，约翰·斯坦贝克的《人鼠之间》——其连贯的线性叙事结构令人想起前几个世纪的小说——却几乎得不到现代主义学者的关注。——远读，即对海量数字化文本的计算机辅助定量分析，能够揭示此前无人察觉的风格要素，尽管这些要素为现代主义时期的众多文本所共有。

senses.text: 使更突出、更明显（accentuate the presence of X）
accent n. 重音 → accentuate v.；与 emphasize 同义但更偏「通过对比 / 反复呈现来凸显」

ex.en: The camera’s presence is continually accentuated by showing the operator positioning it, for example, placing it atop a steel structure, where he then adjusts the camera to capture a view of traffic passing underneath, to which the film cuts immediately after.
ex.mark: is continually accentuated by showing the
ex.zh: 影片不断通过展示操作员架设机器的过程来凸显摄影机的存在，例如把它架在一座钢构上、再调整机位以拍到下方车流，随后镜头立刻切到那个画面。

senses.text: be acquainted with 熟悉、了解（某人 / 某物）
acquaint oneself with 主动去了解；n. acquaintance 熟人 / 略知，别与 acquire 混淆

ex.en: The untaught peasant beheld the elements around him and was acquainted with their practical uses.
ex.mark: and was acquainted with their practical
ex.zh: 维克多·弗兰肯斯坦正在叙述这段文字，他描述了自己开始研究自然界时科学知识的状况：未受教育的农人观察周身万物，只熟悉它们的实际用途。

senses.text: 实际存在、真实性（historical actuality 历史真实性）
in actuality = in fact（书面副词短语）；与 potentiality（可能性）相对

kin: actualize — 同词根构词变体，真题出现 11 次；已并入本词条

ex.en: However, some differentiate between members of the dynasty like Wladyslaw I Herman, who ruled as duke from 1079 to 1102 CE, and less well-documented figures like Lestek, who is said to have ruled in the 9th and 10th centuries but whose historical actuality is disputed.
ex.zh: 不过，也有人把王朝中像 1079 至 1102 年在位的公爵瓦迪斯瓦夫一世这类有明确记载者，与莱斯特克这类据称在 9、10 世纪统治却记载寥寥、其历史真实性仍受质疑的人物区分开来。

senses.text: 富裕的；充裕的（the affluent 作名词：富裕阶层）
ad-（向）+ flu（流）→ 流向你 → 富足

kin: affluence — n. 富裕
fluent / fluid — adj. 流利的 / 流动的——同根 flu-（流）

ex.en: The affluent accepted fines as merely a tax on privilege, even as the amounts increased with frequent revisions to the laws.
ex.mark: The affluent accepted fines as merely a tax on privilege
ex.zh: 富裕阶层把罚款仅仅当作对特权征收的一项税，即便随着法律频繁修订，罚金数额也水涨船高。

ex.src: 卷 2096 · Module M2 · Q15 · 补充语境
ex.en: Reexamining these data, Gregory Clark notes that while inventories from the period appear consistent with the consumer-revolution argument, the proportion of the population whose wills included such documentation decreased considerably between 1600 and 1750, with this documentation increasingly representing more affluent individuals.
ex.zh: 重新审视这些数据时，Gregory Clark 指出：虽然该时期的财产清单看似支持「消费革命」的论点，但遗嘱中含此类记录的人口比例在 1600 至 1750 年间大幅下降，这类记录越来越多地只代表更富裕的人群。

senses.text: 聚集（体）；集聚（agglomeration economies：集聚经济）
（城市）连片扩张区；建成区——城市研究术语

kin: agglomerate — v. 聚集 / n. 集合体
aggregate / aggregation — n. 聚合体 / n. 聚集——近义真题另现

ex.en: Rudolf Cesaretti et al. conducted an analysis of historical urban scaling trends circa 1300 CE in Western Europe, focusing on agglomeration patterns within medieval settlements.
ex.mark: focusing on agglomeration patterns within medieval settlements
ex.zh: Rudolf Cesaretti 等人分析了公元1300年前后西欧历史上的城市规模变化趋势，重点关注中世纪聚落内部的集聚模式。

ex.src: 卷 2027 · Module M1 · Q4 · 补充语境
ex.en: Although the clustering of cutlery manufacturing firms in Sheffield, UK, is often cited as typical of industrial agglomeration.
ex.zh: 尽管英国谢菲尔德餐具制造企业的聚集常被引为工业集聚的典型……

senses.text: 聚集（体）；集合体（an aggregation of：一群…）
汇总；加总（data aggregation 数据聚合）

kin: aggregate — v./n./adj. 合计（的）
aggregator — n. 聚合器；整合平台

ex.en: Among tree species in the Mo Singto plot (latitude 14.26°N) and other tropical forest sites, there is little correlation between conspecific aggregation and the abundance of a given species in the wider local area, so RSA is expected, but in the Smithsonian Conservation Biology Institute (latitude 38.89°N) and other temperate forest sites, the aggregation-abundance correlation for tree species is strongly negative.
ex.zh: 在 Mo Singto 样地（纬度 14.26°N）及其他热带森林样地，树种的同种聚集度与该物种在更大局域范围内的丰盛度几乎没有相关性；而在史密森尼保护生物学研究所（纬度 38.89°N）及其他温带森林样地，树种的聚集—丰盛度相关性则呈强负值。

senses.text: 暗指；影射（allude to：间接提及，不点名）
allude（暗指）≠ elude（逃避；使记不起）≠ refer to（直接指称）

kin: allusion — n. 典故；暗指（真题高频文学术语）
allusive — adj. 含典故的；爱用暗示的

ex.en: Amos Barton.” In the text, the narrator addresses the reader directly and alludes to a discussion among Rev.
ex.zh: 因此，乔治·英尼斯1855年在画作《拉卡瓦纳山谷》中把铁路置于前景的做法就格外引人注目——铁路图像在当时常常影射以进步之名对荒野的破坏。

ex.src: 卷 2080 · Module M1 · Q17 · 补充语境
ex.en: For example, the Puerto Rican municipality of Corozal has also been called “the Cradle of Volleyball,” a nickname that alludes to what the area is well known for: being a longtime volleyball powerhouse.
ex.zh: 再如，波多黎各的科罗萨尔市也被称为「排球摇篮」——这个别名的所指正是该地为人熟知之处：长盛不衰的排球重镇。

senses.text: 不同成分融合而成的整体（an amalgam of A with B）
专指汞齐（牙科填充合金）；真题用来定义 creole 语言的「词汇供给语 + 底层语」结构

ex.zh: 克里奥尔语是「词汇供给语」（语法与词汇的主要来源）与一个或多个「底层语」（次要来源）融合而成的混合体。

senses.text: 咏叹调（歌剧中的独唱曲）
aria（独唱咏叹调）≠ recitative（宣叙调）≠ arioso（咏叙调）

aria ≠ area — 形近异义，仅差一个字母

ex.en: They omitted parts, such as the aria “I Got Plenty of Nuthin'," and sometimes made only brief gestures toward Gershwin's melodies.
ex.mark: omitted parts, such as the aria
ex.zh: 他们删掉了部分内容，比如那首咏叹调《我一无所有也有余》，有时只是对格什温的旋律略作示意。

senses.text: 反常的、异常的：偏离常规、不符合预期模式
a-（无、偏离）+ nomal（= normal 规则）+ -ous →「不合规则的」

ex.en: In her 2012 analysis of tree rings from Japan's Yaku Island, cosmic ray physicist Fusa Miyake noted an anomalous carbon-14 spike dating to 774-775 CE, indicating that a massive burst of radiation reached Earth during that time.
ex.zh: 在 2012 年对日本屋久岛树轮的分析中，宇宙射线物理学家三宅真观测到一次反常的碳-14 峰值，其年代可追溯至公元 774–775 年，表明当时有一场巨大的辐射暴抵达地球。

ex.src: 卷 2091 · Module M1 · Q13 · 补充语境
ex.en: No other known heating mechanism on Jupiter could account for the formation of this anomalous structure, so one hypothesis considered was that it was ejected from the auroral region toward the equator.
ex.zh: 木星上没有其他已知的加热机制能解释这一反常结构的形成，因此有一种假说认为它是从极光区被抛射到赤道地区的。

senses.text: 上升；攀登（ascend the throne：登上王位）

descend — v. 下降——反义同根

ex.en: And then Boston tilts away and they ascend effortlessly over a blackened Atlantic.
ex.mark: they ascend effortlessly over a blackened Atlantic
ex.zh: 接着波士顿倾斜着远去，他们毫不费力地升上黑沉沉的大西洋上空。

ex.src: 卷 2067 · Module M2 · Q25 · 补充语境
ex.en: This work of public art depicts a staircase that appears to ascend into the clouds.

ex.zh: 他本身就是那片乡土令人惊愕、难以想象的生长。

ex.en: Vascularity and other identifying characteristics of pneumatic diverticula tend not to fossilize, so paleontologists have relied on studies of living bird species to document these qualities, augmenting their findings from fossil analysis to glean additional insights into the respiratory systems of extinct genera such as Tyrannosaurus, Euhelopus, and other Cretaceous theropods and sauropods that may have also exhibited PSP.
ex.zh: 实现这一目标的途径之一是亲生物设计——它力求通过在建筑、自然与人体生理之间建立协调关系，来提升使用者的情绪与身体健康。

ex.src: 卷 2611 · Module M2A · Q13 · 补充语境
ex.en: One way to accomplish this goal is through biophilic design, which seeks to augment occupants’ emotional and physical well-being by establishing a coherent relationship among the building, nature, and human biology.

senses.text: 预示成功、兆头好的（an auspicious beginning）

ex.en: Adam is meeting his great-uncle Richard at a port. The meeting so auspiciously begun proceeded well.
ex.mark: meeting so auspiciously begun proceeded well.
ex.zh: 亚当正在港口与叔祖父理查德会面。这场开局如此顺利的会面，此后也进行得颇为融洽。

senses.text: 河流主道旁停滞的水湾、湿地

ex.en: Al Black’s Sunset Backwater Scene with Egrets, a wetland landscape with silhouettes of moss-covered trees contrasted by a vibrant orange sky, is typical of paintings by the Florida Highwaymen, loosely affiliated landscape artists mainly active in Fort Pierce, Florida, during the 1950s and ’60s.
ex.mark: Black’s Sunset Backwater Scene with Egrets,
ex.zh: 阿尔·布莱克的《白鹭落日回水景》以苔树剪影映衬鲜亮的橙红天幕，是「佛罗里达公路客」画派的典型作品——这群联系松散的画家主要活跃于 1950 至 60 年代的佛州皮尔斯堡。

marketplace / souk — n. 市场 / n.（阿拉伯）露天市场

ex.en: Even at ten in the morning, the bazaar was throbbing with activity.
ex.mark: the bazaar was throbbing with activity
ex.zh: 拉姆昌德在印度阿姆利则的一家店铺里当伙计。即便上午十点，集市也已是一片熙熙攘攘。

senses.text: 瓶颈；阻碍进展的环节（create / present a bottleneck）
（种群）瓶颈效应——演化生物学义

kin: bottleneck ≠ backlog — 后者是「积压（的工作）」
constraint / impediment — n. 制约 / n. 阻碍——近义

ex.en: Although efficiencies in long-distance transport of parcels have greatly improved delivery times, last-mile logistics (the final step in delivery to consumers) present a bottleneck for delivery companies.
ex.mark: present a bottleneck for delivery companies
ex.zh: 尽管长途包裹运输的效率提升大幅缩短了配送时间，但最后一公里物流（送达消费者的最后环节）仍给快递公司造成了瓶颈。

ex.src: 卷 2082 · Module M2 · Q12 · 补充语境
ex.en: Delivery companies are contending with the increasing popularity of next-day delivery and with the increasing volume of parcels to be delivered, resulting in a growing bottleneck of packages in the last-mile delivery stage.
ex.zh: 快递公司正疲于应对「次日达」日益流行的趋势与不断增长的包裹量，导致末端配送环节的包裹积压（瓶颈）日益加剧。

senses.text: 悬钩子属多刺灌木；arctic bramble 北极悬钩子
（英式）荆棘丛；brambly adj. 多刺的，也用来形容味道带野果的涩感

ex.en: Soil thawing in Alaska has been accelerating as a result of climate changes, potentially enabling increased carbon dioxide (CO₂) absorption through greater productivity of arctic bramble (Rubus arcticus) plants and other vegetation, but also potentially enabling increased CO₂ output through greater heterotrophic respiration (CO₂ generated by the activity of soil microorganisms).
ex.zh: 阿拉斯加的冻土融化因气候变化而加速，一方面可能通过北极悬钩子等植被生产力提升而增加二氧化碳吸收，另一方面也可能通过土壤微生物活动产生的异养呼吸增加二氧化碳排放。

senses.text: 短而硬的毛 / 刷毛；bristle-like structures 刚毛状结构
bristle at 因不满而毛发倒竖、恼怒；（某物）密布着…bristle with

ex.en: Like all species of baleen whales, the common minke whale feeds on tiny creatures known as krill by filtering water through bristle like keratin structures called baleen plates.
ex.mark: water through bristle like keratin structures
ex.zh: 与所有须鲸一样，普通小须鲸以磷虾等微小生物为食：靠名叫「鲸须板」的、由角蛋白构成的刚毛状结构过滤海水。

ex.src: 卷 2016 · Module M2 · Q12 · 补充语境
ex.en: Permafrost in Alaska has been degrading, potentially enabling increased carbon dioxide (CO2) absorption through greater productivity of bristle-pointed iris (Iris setoso) plants and other vegetation, but also potentially enabling increased CO2 output through greater heterotrophic respiration (CO2 generated by the activity of soil microorganisms).
ex.zh: 阿拉斯加的永久冻土一直在退化，这可能通过毛鸢尾等植被更高的生产力增加二氧化碳吸收，也可能通过更强的异养呼吸（土壤微生物活动产生的 CO₂）增加二氧化碳排放。

senses.text: （态度、言辞）生硬无礼、不耐烦的
比 blunt 更带「不给人留余地」的粗率感；n. brusqueness

ex.en: There is no denying that, since he was rather brusque in his ways, he never spared the young authors who asked his advice and read him their productions, but criticized vigorously, even to the verge of insult.
ex.mark: was rather brusque in his ways,
ex.zh: 无可否认，由于他行事相当生硬，前来讨教、把习作念给他听的年轻作者从不被他留情，反而会被严厉批评，几近羞辱。

senses.text: 迅速；敏捷（move with celerity）——文学 / 正式语体
celerity「动作之快」≠ velocity「物理速度」≠ alacrity「乐意之快」

kin: celerity ≠ celebrity — 形近异义：后者是「名人」
accelerate — v. 加速——同根 celer-（快）

ex.en: … he merely moved with a light-poised and watchful celerity, weaving among the calico rushes of the animals …
ex.zh: 他并不是在奔跑，只是以一种轻盈、警觉而迅捷的姿态移动，在牲畜斑驳的涌动中穿行，像拳击手一样虚晃闪避，直到走到栅栏门边，穿过院子。

senses.text: 又潮又凉、黏腻不适的（clammy hands / a clammy morning）
真题 wet lay clammy 是狄更斯式倒装，写潮湿清晨栏杆门扉上那层黏冷的水气

ex.en: On every rail and gate, wet lay clammy, and the marsh mist was so thick, that the wooden finger on the post directing people to our village--a direction which they never accepted, for they never came there--was invisible to me until I was quite close under it.
ex.zh: 每一道栏杆、每一扇门上，湿气都黏冷地凝着；沼雾浓得让路牌上指向我们村子的木指（那方向人们从不理会，因为他们从没来过）直到我走到跟前才看得见。

带贬义，区别于中性的 group / circle；cliquish adj. 排他成性的

ex.en: … to make it efficient outside the clique of the cultivated and learned, yet still remaining the best knowledge and thought of the time …
ex.mark: outside the clique of the cultivated
ex.zh: 文化伟人热衷于传播：把时代最好的知识与思想从社会的一端送到另一端；他们努力剥去知识身上生硬、粗鄙、艰深、抽象、专业化、排他的一切，使它人文化，使它能在有学养者的小圈子之外同样生效，却仍不失为时代最好的知识与思想，并因此成为「甜美与光明」的真正源泉。

senses.text: cobble / cobblestone 圆润的铺路卵石
cobble together 草草拼凑；真题 beach cobbles 指海滩卵石，是石器原料

ex.en: Nearly all implements were fashioned from limestone—mostly from beach cobbles—rather than superior chert or obsidian, and the assemblages predominantly comprise flakes produced through direct percussion, with negligible representation of cores, blades, or retouched tools.
ex.zh: 几乎所有器具都用石灰岩打制——大多取自海滩卵石——而非更优质的燧石或黑曜岩；这批器物组合以直接打击产生的石片为主，石核、石叶与修整工具极少。

senses.text: 连贯（性）；一致（性）（narrative coherence / coherence of the discipline）
相干性（coherence of light——波的特性的术语）

cohesion — n. 凝聚力——真题另现，偏「黏合、团结」
incoherence — n. 不连贯——反义

ex.en: Standardization of the meaning of culture is a worthwhile goal that would increase the coherence of the discipline.
ex.mark: increase the coherence of the discipline
ex.zh: 把文化的含义加以标准化是一个值得追求的目标，它将提升这门学科的内部一致性。

ex.src: 卷 2021 · Module M2 · Q9 · 补充语境
ex.en: For too long, scholars have focused on narrative fragmentation versus coherence, inhibiting inquiry into other points of stylistic correspondence among works that would enrich our understanding of the modernist canon.
ex.zh: 长期以来，学者们纠缠于「叙事的碎裂与连贯」之争，阻碍了对作品间其他风格对应点的探究——而这些对应点本可丰富我们对现代主义经典的理解。

senses.text: 凝聚（力）；团结（group / social cohesion）
内聚；附着（力）

kin: cohesive — adj. 有凝聚力的
coherence — n. 连贯性——近义，但偏逻辑 / 结构上的前后一致

ex.en: However, it hasn’t been clear how to foster strong group cohesion to motivate prosocial behavior at a global level given that humans tend to align more locally, from family to nationality.
ex.zh: 然而，鉴于人类的认同往往更偏向本地层面——从家庭到民族国家——如何在全球层面培育强大的群体凝聚力以激发亲社会行为，一直不甚清楚。

ex.src: 卷 2066 · Module M1 · Q24 · 补充语境
ex.en: The cohesion species concept, described in 1985 by Templeton, defines species in accordance with phenotypic cohesion.
ex.zh: 凝聚种概念由 Templeton 于 1985 年提出，依据表型凝聚来界定物种。

senses.text: 可想象的；可能的（every conceivable obstacle）
conceive + -able

kin: inconceivable — adj. 不可想象的——反义
conceivably — adv. 可能地
conceivable ≠ conceivable of — 真题作 every conceivable obstacle 一切可想到的障碍
conceive — 同词根构词变体，真题出现 9 次；已并入本词条统一计数

ex.en: It seemed as if nature had determined to throw every conceivable obstacle in the way of those who should seek to join the two great oceans of the world.
ex.zh: 大自然仿佛决心要给那些试图把世界两大洋连接起来的人，设置一切可以想见的障碍。

ex.zh: 尽管当代的快速评估技术通过允许快速测试大量候选物推进了这一过程，这些方法仍局限于检测已知物质。

ex.en: Moreover, she seeks to cultivate a practice of “constant evolution” untethered from any prescriptive agenda, so that her art navigates a liminal space between tradition and autobiography, community and itinerancy, and activism and contemplation.
ex.zh: 此外，她试图养成一种不受任何规定性议程束缚的「持续演化」实践，让她的艺术游走于传统与自传、社群与漂泊、行动与沉思之间的阈限地带。

ex.zh: Protas 及其同事探讨了趋同演化——即同一性状在两个生殖隔离的谱系中各自独立演化出来的现象——如何可能源自两个谱系共有的遗传机制。

ex.en: Its very situation—withdrawn a little behind the facile splendours of St. Pancras—implied a comment on the materialism of life.
ex.zh: 它（国王十字车站）所处的位置——稍稍退隐在圣潘克拉斯车站那轻易得来的华美之后——本身就含蓄地评论了生活的物质主义。

ex.en: In fact, art historian Nicolai Cikovsky Jr. argues that Inness glorifies the subject of the railroad by painting a scene that suggests hopefulness rather than devastation. Text 2It is impossible to deduce anything about George Inness’s attitude toward his subject in the painting The Lackawanna Valley, primarily because it is a commissioned work.

ex.zh: 要推断乔治·英尼斯在画作《拉卡瓦纳山谷》中对其描绘对象的态度是不可能的。

ex.src: 卷 2088 · Module M1 · Q2 · 补充语境
ex.en: Agee recounts driving a car through an area of rural Alabama that he is unfamiliar with. On which road the woods might give way to any extension of farm country there was no deducing: for we were somewhere toward the middle of one of the wider gaps on the road map, and had seen nothing but woods, and infrequent woods farms, for a good while now.
ex.zh: Agee 讲述了自己开车穿行阿拉巴马乡村陌生地带的经历。这条路两旁的树林会在何处让位于农田的延伸，无从推断：我们正处在地图上一处较宽的空白地带的中段，好一阵子除了树林和零星的林间农场，什么也没见到。

ex.en: Even famed film editor Thelma Schoonmaker, winner of multiple BAFTAs and recipient of the Golden Lion for Lifetime Achievement in 2014, is constrained by the footage available to her and will, at times, knowingly include shots with what are often deemed continuity “errors,” as was the case in The Aviator (2004), which includes a scene depicting Howard Hughes and Faith Domergue sharing a chocolate sundae.
ex.zh: 连屡获英国电影学院奖、2014 年获威尼斯电影节终身成就金狮奖的著名剪辑师 Thelma Schoonmaker，也受限于手头可用的素材，有时会明知故用一些通常被视为穿帮「失误」的镜头——《飞行家》（2004）即有一幕呈现 Howard Hughes 与 Faith Domergue 共享巧克力圣代。
