palatial ≠ palatable — 形近异义：后者是「可口的；可接受的」

ex.en: The whole of Manhattan Island is turned into a city of skyscrapers, churches and palatial residences.
ex.zh: 整个曼哈顿岛变成了一座由摩天楼、教堂和宫殿般宅邸构成的城市。

senses.text: 明显地；可感知地（palpably commonplace）
palp-（触摸，同 palpable）+ -ly

kin: palpable — adj. 明显的；可触知的
palpably ≠ palpably and unmistakably — 真题两副词连用加强语气
tangibly / unmistakably — adv. 可触地 / adv. 确凿无疑地——近义

ex.en: Amos Barton, whose sad fortunes Ihave undertaken to relate, was, you perceive, in no respect an ideal or exceptional character; and perhaps I am doing a bold thing to bespeak your sympathy on behalf of a man who was so very far from remarkable,—a man whose virtues were not heroic, and who had no undetected crime within his breast; who had not the slightest mystery hanging about him, but was palpably and unmistakably commonplace; who was not even in love, but had had that complaint favourably many years ago.
ex.zh: 我所要讲述其悲惨遭遇的阿莫斯·巴顿，如你所见，在任何方面都不是一个理想的或非凡的人物；为一个如此毫不出奇的人谋求你的同情，也许我是在做一件冒昧的事——他的德行并不英雄，心里也没有藏着未被发现的罪；他身上没有半点神秘可言，而是明明白白、确凿无疑地平庸；他甚至没在恋爱，只是许多年前得过这毛病、且已顺利痊愈。

senses.text: 艺术史语境：资助艺术家或机构的行径（personal patronage, royal patronage）
商业语境：顾客的光顾（thank you for your patronage）
政治语境：以官职回报支持者（political patronage）

ex.en: As modern scholar Fabio Fernandes notes, however, these two traditions aren't as distinct as they seem, as both the emperor and the private library owners viewed their libraries as extensions of their personal patronage, just on vastly differing scales.
ex.zh: 不过，正如现代学者法比奥·费尔南德斯所指出的，这两种传统并不像看上去那样泾渭分明：皇帝与私人藏书家都把自己的藏书视为个人赞助的延伸，只是规模相差悬殊。

senses.text: （水）透过孔隙缓慢下渗、渗流
（消息、观念）逐渐传开；percolate into the HZ 指溪水渗入潜流带

ex.en: Stream water percolates into the HZ and mixes with upwelling groundwater, creating a unique habitat “when the water from above meets the water from below” (as described in Ojibwe traditional ecological knowledge).
ex.mark: Stream water percolates into the HZ
ex.zh: 溪水下渗进入潜流带（HZ），与上升的地下水混合，造就了一处独特的生境——用奥吉布瓦传统生态知识的说法，就是「上面的水与下面的水相遇」的地方。

senses.text: 只求完成、不带投入地做事（a perfunctory apology）
出于程序需要而做的，缺乏实质内容
强调动作到位但态度冷淡，比 careless 更含轻蔑意味

ex.en: Advances in language processing technology have greatly boosted the utility of these apps for perfunctory tasks, like inquiring about an item on a menu, and passing interactions; be that as it may, richer communication (e.g., in business dealings or meaningful personal exchanges) often hinges on conversational patterns and gradations of meaning.
ex.mark: apps for perfunctory tasks, like inquiring
ex.zh: 语言处理技术的进步大大提升了这类应用在敷衍性任务上的实用性，比如询问菜单上的一道菜、寒暄式的过场交流；尽管如此，更丰富的沟通（例如商务往来或有意义的私人交流）往往取决于对话模式与意义层次。

senses.text: 使石化（petrified wood / forest）
使吓呆；使僵住（be petrified with fear）

kin: petrified — adj. 石化的；吓呆的——真题以此形出现
petrification — n. 石化（作用）
petrify ≠ putrefy — 形近异义：后者是「腐烂」

ex.en: Behind the lamassu, more columns sprouted from the ground like ancient trees in a petrified forest, forty feet tall, spindly but still miraculously upright.
ex.mark: like ancient trees in a petrified forest
ex.zh: 可它依然令人惊叹。在那尊人首牛身像之后，更多柱子从地面拔起，像一片石化森林里的古树，高达四十英尺，细长却仍奇迹般地直立着。

senses.text: 多孔的；疏松的（a porous molecular structure）
（边界、制度）疏松易渗透的

kin: porosity — n. 孔隙度
porous ≠ porous structure — 真题取材料科学义：靠吸附储气
permeable — adj. 可渗透的——真题亦现，近义

ex.en: Hayden A. Evans et al.therefore explored aluminum formate (ALF), an inexpensive material with a porous molecular structure that enables gas storage by adsorption, as an alternative storage medium.
ex.zh: 因此 Hayden A. Evans 等人研究了甲酸铝（ALF）——一种价格低廉、具有多孔分子结构、可借吸附储存气体的材料——把它作为另一种储氢介质。

ex.src: 卷 2613 · Module RWM1 · Q15 · 补充语境
ex.en: While earthenware (which is relatively porous and fragile) is fired at temperatures between 950°C and 1,100°C, stoneware (which is dense and impervious to liquid) must be heated to around 1,300°C.

senses.text: 务实；实用性（the practicality that led to his success）
practicality（务实、可行）≠ practicability（可实施性）

kin: practical / practically — adj. 务实的 / adv. 几乎；实际上
impracticable — adj. 行不通的——真题另现
pragmatism — n. 实用主义——近义

ex.en: Reagan as a politician is often thought of as being a strict ideological conservative, but this belief obscures the practicality that led to his success—he was willing to compromise and cooperate with people he disagreed with in order to advance his objectives.
ex.mark: obscures the practicality that led to his success
ex.zh: 作为政治人物，里根常被视为严格的意识形态保守派；但这种看法遮蔽了成就他的那种务实——他愿意与自己意见相左的人妥协、合作，以推进自己的目标。

senses.text: 先于；在…之前（the 28 days preceding each point）
precede（时间 / 顺序上在前）≠ proceed（继续进行）≠ exceed（超过）

kin: preceding / precedent — adj. 在前的 / n. 先例
precedence — n. 优先（权）：take precedence over
precede ≠ predate — 后者是「（年代上）早于」，真题亦现

ex.en: They then calculated the productivity loss of those groups at 12 weeks and 12 months after the programs began (based on the 28 days preceding each point).
ex.zh: 随后他们分别计算了这些小组在项目启动后12周与12个月时的生产力损失（以每个时间点之前28天为依据）。

ex.src: 卷 2064 · Module M2 · Q26 · 补充语境
ex.en: Modern Pueblo tribal nations were preceded by the Ancestral Puebloan civilization, which occupied parts of the southwestern US until approximately 1600 CE. .
ex.zh: 现代普韦布洛部落民族的前身是祖先普韦布洛文明，后者在美国西南部一直存续到约公元 1600 年。

senses.text: 优先地；有偏向地（preferentially defend against）
prefer + -ential + -ly

kin: preferential / preference — adj. 优先的 / n. 偏好
preferentially ≠ preferably — 后者是「最好、更可取地」
preferentially ≠ preferentially to — 真题作 preferentially defend against 优先防御

ex.en: The researchers concluded that whiteflies induce tomato plants to emit chemicals that cause other tomato plants to preferentially defend against microbial infection even when under herbivorous attack.
ex.mark: to preferentially defend against microbial infection
ex.zh: 研究者得出结论：粉虱会诱导番茄植株释放化学物质，使其他番茄植株即便在遭受植食性侵害时，也优先防御微生物感染。

senses.text: 巨大的；惊人的；非凡的（prodigious imagination / output / memory）
prodigious（量大到惊人，多褒义）≠ prodigal（挥霍的；浪子回头的）

kin: prodigy — n. 天才（儿童）；奇才——同根
prodigiously — adv. 惊人地
prodigious ≠ prestigious — 形近异义：后者是「有声望的」

ex.en: That his work is enjoyable despite this is a testament to his prodigious imagination-even if people read his books only for the ideas, they will have plenty to consider. Text 2Asimov is critiqued for his style, but it is wrong to fault a writer for failing to do what he never intended to do.
ex.zh: 尽管如此，他的作品仍然好看，这正证明了他的想象力何等惊人——即便人们读他的书只为那些思想，也大有可咀嚼之处。

senses.text: 修剪（树枝）（pruning to promote safety）
精简；删减（prune a budget / a manuscript）
西梅干、李子干——同形异义

kin: pruning — n. 修剪——真题以此形出现
arborist — n. 树艺师、树木养护师——真题同现
prune ≠ prune back — 真题取「修枝养护」义

ex.en: Arborists assess tree health and perform maintenance such as pruning to promote safety and prevent problems.
ex.zh: 树艺师负责评估树木健康状况，并施行修剪之类的养护，以提升安全性、防患于未然。

ex.src: 卷 2097 · Module M2 · Q16 · 补充语境
ex.en: Japanese bonsai artist Masashi Hirao has crafted an approach that transforms the acts of pruning, wiring, and planting into dynamic public performances.
ex.zh: 日本盆景艺术家平尾成志打磨出一种手法，把修剪、蟠扎、栽种变成充满动感的公开表演。

senses.text: 政策语境：为某群体或某商品设定的数量上限（quotas for underrepresented groups）
贸易语境：进口配额，常与 tariff 并列

ex.en: While some philosophers argue that certain types of underrepresentation (of women, for example) are unfair in principle and should be remediated via quotas, there is broad agreement that youth underrepresentation is not inherently unfair since it is universal (all people are underrepresented when young), temporary (underrepresented young people become overrepresented older people), and reflective of a legitimate concern (lack of relevant experience).
ex.zh: 尽管一些哲学家认为，某些类型的代表性不足（例如女性）在原则上不公平、应通过配额加以纠正，但人们普遍认为，青年群体的代表性不足本身并非不公，因为它是普遍的、暂时的，并且反映了一种合理的关切。

senses.text: 书面语，指平凡琐碎的日常生活，带文学与学术色彩
医学语境：quotidian fever 每日发作的热病
强调缺乏戏剧性，常与 sublime / extraordinary 对举

ex.en: A category that resists firm delineation, folk art is generally defined by an intimate connection to quotidian life.
ex.zh: 民间艺术是一个难以严格界定的类别，通常被定义为与日常生活有着密切关联。

senses.text: 使随机化；随机排列（randomized recordings / trials）
randomized controlled trial 随机对照试验——实验设计核心术语

kin: random / randomly — adj. 随机的 / adv. 随机地
randomization — n. 随机化
randomize ≠ randomize the order of — 真题作 randomized recordings 随机排序的录音

ex.en: Study participants from 21 societies, including those in Singapore and Samoa, listened to randomized recordings of 18 spontaneous laughs taken from natural conversations between pairs of women and 18 volitional laughs produced separately by 18 different women in response to an instruction to laugh.
ex.zh: 来自21个社会（包括新加坡与萨摩亚）的研究参与者聆听了随机排序的录音：其中18段是取自女性二人自然对话的自发性笑声，另18段是18位不同女性按指令刻意发出的自主性笑声。

senses.text: 纠正；矫正（rectify a mistake / an situation）
rect-（直，同 correct）+ -ify

kin: rectification — n. 校正；整改
correct / rectitude — v. 改正 / n. 正直——同根
rectify ≠ ratify — 形近异义：后者是「批准、认可」

ex.en: As they sat down they turned almost invariably to the person sitting next them, and rectified and continued what they had just said in public.
ex.mark: rectified and continued what they had just said
ex.zh: 他们一落座，几乎无一例外地转向坐在自己旁边的人，把刚才当众说过的话再修正一番、接着说下去。

senses.text: 冷藏；制冷（before refrigeration 在冷藏技术出现之前）
re- + frig（冷，同 frigid）+ -ation

kin: refrigerate / refrigerator — v. 冷藏 / n. 冰箱
refrigerant — n. 制冷剂——真题另现
refrigeration ≠ refrigeration cycle — 后者是「制冷循环」

ex.en: Before refrigeration, food was preserved using salt, smoking, or ice harvested from frozen lakes.
ex.zh: 在冷藏技术出现之前，人们用盐腌、烟熏，或从封冻的湖面取冰来保存食物。

ex.src: 卷 2112 · Module M1 · Q27 · 补充语境
ex.en: They wanted to know whether torsional cooling could be used as a refrigeration method. .
ex.zh: 他们想知道扭转制冷能否用作一种制冷方法。

senses.text: 再生；重新长出（regenerate tissue / limbs）
（使）复兴、恢复（regenerate a neighborhood）

kin: regeneration — n. 再生；复兴
regenerative — adj. 再生的； regenerative medicine 再生医学
regenerate ≠ regenerate into — 真题取「（人体）有限的再生能力」义

ex.en: Researchers are investigating this feat partly to learn more about humans’ comparatively limited abilities to regenerate, and they’re making exciting progress.
ex.zh: 研究者探究这一本领，部分是为了进一步了解人类相对有限的再生能力；目前他们正取得令人振奋的进展。

ex.src: 卷 2104 · Module M2H · Q9 · 补充语境
ex.en: Most animals can regenerate some parts of their bodies, such as skin.
ex.zh: 多数动物能再生身体的某些部分，例如皮肤。

senses.text: 重复；反复重申（reiteration of the same structures）
re-（再）+ iteration（一次重复）

kin: reiterate / iterate — v. 重申 / v. 迭代
reiteration ≠ repetition — 前者偏「有意识地一再申说」，后者中性
perpetually revisit — 真题近义表达：不断重返同一母题

ex.en: Paintings by the Florida Highwaymen—an informal collective of prolific landscape artists active in Florida during the 1950s and '60s—are recognizable by their reiteration of the same general compositional structures and subjects: moonlit waters and grassy inland rivers, to name two.
ex.mark: their reiteration of the same general compositional structures
ex.zh: 佛罗里达公路画家（一个活跃于20世纪五六十年代、松散联合的多产风景画家群体）的画作，因反复采用同一套总体构图与母题而一眼可辨：月光下的水面、草木繁茂的内陆河流，仅举两例。

senses.text: 排斥；相斥（matter and antimatter repel rather than attract）
击退（敌人）；使反感；防水（water-repellent）

kin: repellent / repulsion — adj./n. 驱避剂 / n. 排斥
repel ≠ compel / expel — 同根 pel-（推）三词常混考
attract — v. 吸引——反义，真题同句对举

ex.en: In their 2022 paper, Christos Dimopoulos et al., having granted that the existence of antigravity—in which antimatter and matter repel rather than attract each other—lacked affirmative experimental support, rightly argued that such antigravity was worth considering on theoretical grounds given that evidence against it was similarly lacking.
ex.mark: antimatter and matter repel rather than attract each other
ex.zh: 在2022年的论文中，Christos Dimopoulos 等人先承认「反重力」（即反物质与物质相互排斥而非吸引）缺乏肯定性的实验支持，随后又合理地主张：鉴于反对它的证据同样缺乏，这种反重力在理论层面仍值得考虑。

ex.src: 卷 2057 · Module M1 · Q24 · 补充语境
ex.en: One end of a soap molecule is hydrophobic (water repelling), and one end is hydrophilic (water attracting)..
ex.zh: 肥皂分子的一端是疏水的（排斥水），另一端是亲水的（吸引水）。

senses.text: 灿烂的；绚丽夺目的（resplendent in / with）
re-（加强）+ splend（光辉，同 splendid）+ -ent

kin: splendid / splendor — adj. 壮丽的 / n. 光辉
resplendent ≠ resplendently — 后者是副词
radiant / lustrous — adj. 光彩照人的 / adj. 有光泽的——近义

ex.en: The pine cones were pungent, the pine green was resplendent.
ex.zh: 松果气味浓烈，松绿一色明艳照人。

senses.text: 研究如何有效说服的技艺与理论（theories of rhetoric）
含贬义时指华而不实或别有用心的话（empty rhetoric）

ex.en: Conventional theories of rhetoric hold that presenting information as coming from credentialed experts increases that information's credibility.
ex.mark: theories of rhetoric hold that presenting
ex.zh: 传统修辞学理论认为，把信息呈现为来自有资质的专家，会提高该信息的可信度。

senses.text: 嘲笑；奚落（ridicule an idea）
嘲弄；笑柄（an object of ridicule）

kin: ridiculous — adj. 荒唐可笑的——真题亦现
ridicule ≠ ridiculously — 后者是副词
mock / deride — v. 嘲弄 / v. 讥讽——近义

ex.en: George, on the other hand, ridiculed the idea of Harris's having done anything more than eat and sleep, and had a cast-iron opinion that it was he—George himself—who had done all the labour worth speaking of.
ex.zh: 乔治则反过来嘲笑「哈里斯除了吃和睡还干过别的」这个说法，并且铁板钉钉地认定：所有值得一提的活儿都是他——乔治本人——干的。

ex.src: 卷 2028 · Module M1 · Q17 · 补充语境
ex.en: Philosophy is often ridiculed as an area of study that offers no real benefit in students’ job-hunting effort.
ex.zh: 哲学常被讥讽为一门对学生求职毫无实际助益的学问。

senses.text: 使饱和；浸透（be saturated with）
（颜色）饱和度高的：a very saturated blue-green

kin: saturation / saturated — n. 饱和（度） / adj. 饱和的
saturate ≠ saturate with — 真题取「色彩极浓」义
saturated ≠ unsaturated fat — 不饱和脂肪——同形异义

ex.en: Olo is a very saturated blue-green color that can’t be seen with the human eye under natural conditions.
ex.zh: Olo 是一种饱和度极高的蓝绿色，人眼在自然条件下是看不到的。

ex.src: 卷 2057 · Module M1 · Q22 · 补充语境
ex.en: Analyses of Rembrandt's seventeenth-century painting The Night Watch, citing its richly saturated colors and stark contrasts between light and shadow, often characterize the work as an exemplar of the Baroque-era style.
ex.zh: 对伦勃朗 17 世纪画作《夜巡》的分析，常援引其浓饱和的色彩与光暗之间的强烈反差，将其奉为巴洛克风格的典范。

senses.text: 闲逛；漫步（saunter along / through）
闲步、溜达

kin: sauntered — v. 过去式——真题以此形出现
saunter ≠ sauntering — 后者是现在分词 / 形容词
stroll / amble — v. 漫步——近义

ex.en: I sauntered along, forgetful of musty papers, of the offices, of my chief …
ex.mark: I sauntered along, forgetful of musty papers
ex.zh: 我一路闲逛，把那些发霉的纸堆、办公室、我的上司、同事、文件全抛在脑后，只想着那些必定会降临于我的好事，想着未来所包含的一切隐而未露的未知。

senses.text: 皱眉；怒视（scowl at sb）
愁容、不悦的脸色

kin: scowling — n./adj. 皱眉（的）——真题以此形出现
scowl ≠ scowl at — 真题作 in his scowling 在他皱眉的样子里
frown / glower — v. 皱眉 / v. 怒视——近义

ex.en: There was a hidden dignity in his scowling as he shuffled about pondering the least ridiculous place for the picture.
ex.mark: There was a hidden dignity in his scowling
ex.zh: 他一边踱着步、盘算着把这幅画挂在何处才最不显得荒唐，一边皱着眉；那皱眉的样子里藏着一种不为人察的尊严。

senses.text: 抄写员；文书（Indigenous scribes 原住民抄写者）
（古犹太教的）经师、律法学者

kin: scribe ≠ scribble — 后者是「潦草涂写」
scribe ≠ describe / prescribe / subscribe — 同根 scrib-（写）常混考
manuscript — n. 手稿——真题同现

ex.en: Compiled in the late 1500s largely through the efforts of Indigenous scribes, Cantares Mexicanos is the most important collection of poetry in Classical Nahuatl, the principal language of the Aztec Empire.
ex.mark: largely through the efforts of Indigenous scribes
ex.zh: 《墨西哥歌谣集》（Cantares Mexicanos）主要靠原住民抄写者的努力于十六世纪末汇编而成，是古典纳瓦特尔语（阿兹特克帝国的主要语言）最重要的诗歌总集。

senses.text: 仔细审视；细察（scrutinize data / arrangements）
scrut-（搜查，同 scrutiny）+ -ize

kin: scrutiny — n. 细察；详细审查
scrutinized — v. 过去分词——真题以此形出现
scrutinize ≠ scan — 后者只是「扫一眼 / 浏览」

ex.en: The most extensive investigations have scrutinized only 106–107 crystalline arrangements, a large absolute number but only a small subset of theoretically possible stable chemical combinations.
ex.zh: 迄今最广泛的研究也只细察了10⁶–10⁷种晶体排列——绝对数量不小，却只是理论上可能存在的稳定化学组合中的一小部分。

senses.text: 开创性的；影响深远的（a seminal study / work）
seminal（学术上的「奠基性」）≠ seminar（研讨课）≠ semantic（语义的）

kin: seminal ≠ seminally — 后者是副词
seminal 1979 study — 真题搭配：1979年的奠基性研究（Kahneman & Tversky）
groundbreaking / foundational — adj. 开创性的——近义

ex.zh: 可它依然令人惊叹。在那尊人首牛身像之后，更多柱子从地面拔起，像一片石化森林里的古树，高达四十英尺，细长得摇摇欲坠，却仍奇迹般地直立着。

ex.zh: 作为研究发现的一部分，该团队还就印欧语系如何扩散提出假说：印欧语系的一个主要分支从该语系的发源地北上，抵达黑海—里海草原，再由那里向欧洲大部扩张。

ex.zh: 距今 78 万年前刮皮工具的出现使衣物生产成为可能，但并不意味着必然发生；虽然对生活在非洲、约 30 万年前出现的解剖学意义上的现代人而言，衣物在保暖上被认为是多余的，但对 7 万年前走出非洲的人类的存续却不可或缺。

ex.en: For example, the common difrasismo in cuauhtli in ocelotl (literally, “the eagle, the jaguar”) signifies “warrior.” The device's function is both formal—providing structure to lines of verse—and ritual: semantic relations among the two nouns and the concept they signify can be tenuous, as in the previous example, such that difrasismos are often only intelligible according to the conceptual associations observed in Aztec ceremonial culture.
ex.zh: 例如，cuauhtli in ocelotl（字面意为鹰、美洲豹）这一常见的 difrasismo 表示武士。该修辞手法的功能既是形式上的——为诗句提供结构——也是仪式性的：两个名词与其所指概念之间的语义关联可能十分薄弱，如上例所示，以至于这类 difrasismo 往往只有依据阿兹特克仪式文化中的概念联想才能理解。

kin: dub ≠ dub in — 真题取「命名为」，不是「配音」
dubbed a mixtap/e/ssay — 真题原句：被称作「混带／随笔」的专辑
nickname / christen — v. 起绰号 / v. 命名——近义

ex.src: 真题原句 · 古生物学 passage
ex.en: A pair of European panda teeth found in Bulgaria led researchers to conclude that they likely belonged to an undiscovered species of panda that the researchers dubbed Agriarctos nikolovi.
ex.mark: that the researchers dubbed Agriarctos nikolovi
ex.zh: 在保加利亚发现的一对欧洲熊猫牙齿使研究者得出结论：它们很可能属于一个此前未被发现的熊猫物种，研究者将其命名为 Agriarctos nikolovi。

senses.text: 问题、状况尚可纠正或改善（not easily remediable 不易补救）
remedy v. 补救 → remediable；反义 irremediable 无可挽回的

ex.en: Although this approach can yield many insights about the biological past, it remains a relatively underutilized resource in part because hDNA is often to some extent degraded, a situation not easily remediable under current methodological paradigms and with extant DNA extraction and analysis technologies.
ex.zh: 尽管这一路径有独特优势，例如可以获取已灭绝种群的基因组数据，它仍是一种相对未被充分利用的资源：历史 DNA 往往有不同程度的降解，而在现有的方法论范式与 DNA 提取分析技术下，这一状况不易补救。

ex.src: 卷 2020 · Module M2 · Q7 · 补充语境
ex.en: Although this approach offers unique benefits, such as the ability to contrast historical genomic data with present-day data, it remains relatively underutilized because archival specimens are sometimes stored in ways that compromise DNA quality, a situation not easily remediable under current methodological paradigms and with extant DNA extraction and analysis technologies.
ex.zh: 尽管这种方法有独特优势（如把历史基因组数据与当下数据作对比），它仍未被充分利用：档案标本的保存方式有时会损害 DNA 质量，在现行方法论范式与现存 DNA 提取、分析技术下都不易补救。

senses.text: 由主观意愿驱动的、有意为之的（volitional laughter 有意发出的笑）
与 spontaneous（自发的、不由自主的）构成反义对照，实验设计常用这一对概念

ex.en: Study participants from 21 societies, including those in Japan and Turkey, listened to randomized recordings of 18 spontaneous laughs taken from natural conversations between pairs of women and 18 volitional laughs produced separately by 18 different women in response to an instruction to laugh.
ex.zh: 来自 21 个社会（包括奥地利与萨摩亚）的研究参与者，听了一批随机排序的录音：18 段取自两名女性自然对话中的自发笑声，以及另外 18 名女性按指令发出的有意笑声。

ex.src: 卷 2020 · Module M1 · Q12 · 补充语境
ex.en: Psychologists Gregory Bryant, Dorsa Amir, and colleagues investigated cross-cultural perceptions of spontaneous (real) laughter and volitional (fake or forced) laughter.
ex.zh: 心理学家 Gregory Bryant、Dorsa Amir 及同事研究了不同文化对自发（真实）笑声与自主（伪装或勉强）笑声的感知。

senses.text: 某一词根的成分在同一词族另一词内部重复（可带音变），如 teeny-weeny
re- 再 + duplicate 复制 → reduplicate → reduplication；语言学专门术语

ex.en: This phenomenon, in which an element of a root word is repeated, sometimes with modification, within another word that is related to the root word, is called reduplication.
ex.zh: 某一词根的成分在与之相关的另一个词内部重复（有时带变化），这一现象称为重叠构词。

ex.src: 卷 2004 · Module M1 · Q7 · 补充语境
ex.en: There are many examples of this type of reduplication in Hoocak.
ex.zh: 霍乔克语中有许多这类重叠构词的例子。

senses.text: 把某物从其它事物中划分出来（demarcate A as B 把 A 划归为 B）
de- 加强 + mark 标记 → demarcate；名词 demarcation 分界

ex.en: Noting that some stories feature detailed descriptions of geographic locations in the Cherokee homeland, Mooney demarcated those as a genre he referred to as “wonder stories.” While Long and Mooney’s collaboration proved valuable as an act of cultural preservation, it is important to bear in mind that Cherokee people are not known to have applied genre divisions to their stories before Mooney’s work.
ex.zh: Mooney 注意到有些故事对切罗基故土的地理位置有细致描写，便把这类故事划为一个他称为「奇谭」的类别。

senses.text: 使缠结在一起（entangled tubes 缠绕的管子）
be entangled in 卷入（纠纷、关系）；名词 entanglement 纠缠

ex.en: Her sculpture Ocupante is made of entangled blue and white LED tubes.
ex.mark: entangled blue and white LED tubes
ex.zh: 她的雕塑《Ocupante》由蓝白两色 LED 灯管缠绕而成。

senses.text: 与快感、愉悦本身相关的（hedonic motivation 享乐动机）
消费行为学里与 utilitarian（实用性的）相对：一个买「爽」，一个买「用」

ex.en: They hypothesized that hedonic motivation (the enjoyment that a consumer perceives to be associated with using a service) would be positively correlated with users’ intentions to adopt premium versions.
ex.zh: 他们假设，享乐动机（消费者认为使用某项服务所带来的愉悦）会与用户采用付费版本的意愿正相关。

ex.src: 卷 2069 · Module M2 · Q9 · 补充语境
ex.en: However, Lee and Hosanagar also determined that whereas an RS had a stronger positive effect on item views for utilitarian products (e.g., toothbrushes) than for hedonic products (e.g., chocolates), the RS had a stronger positive effect on likelihood of purchase for hedonic products than for utilitarian ones.
ex.zh: 然而 Lee 与 Hosanagar 还发现：评分对实用型产品（如牙刷）浏览量的提升强于享乐型产品（如巧克力），但对享乐型产品购买可能性的提升反而更强。

senses.text: 失去水分的过程（episodic desiccation 周期性干涸）
de- 去除 + sicc（拉丁 siccus 干）→ desiccate → desiccation；地质学常用

ex.en: To characterize the nature of the depositional environment, Frances Rivera-Hernández et al. analyzed the grain size of Murray Formation sediment, finding that although there are intervals of coarse grains, most of the sediment consists of fine grains that show signs of cracking due to episodic desiccation.
ex.zh: 大部分沉积物由细颗粒组成，这些颗粒显示出因周期性干燥而开裂的迹象。

senses.text: 使某人感到满足、高兴（find it gratifying that… 对…感到欣慰）
比 satisfy 更偏情感上的满足；gratifying 常作形容词「令人欣慰的」

ex.en: Still, he knows that each component of a building, however small, is nevertheless essential, and he finds it gratifying that after all his years of schooling, all his crits [reviews] and unbuilt projects, his efforts are to have some practical end.
ex.zh: 不过他知道，建筑的每一个构件无论多小都不可或缺；让他欣慰的是，求学多年、经历过那么多评图与未能建成的方案之后，自己的努力总算有了实际用处。

senses.text: 过分显眼、惹人注意的（less obtrusive 不那么扎眼）
ob- 朝向 + trude 推 → obtrude 强加 → obtrusive；反义 unobtrusive 不露痕迹的

ex.en: The changes of the seasons are less obtrusive on spots of this kind than amid woodland scenery.
ex.zh: 在这类地方，季节的更替不如在林地里那样惹眼。

senses.text: 以书信形式写成的（epistolary novel 书信体小说）
epistle 书信 → epistolary；SAT 文学体裁题高频标签

ex.en: The Incarnations (2015) is an epistolary novel by English author Susan Barker.
ex.zh: 《The Incarnations》（2015）是英国作家 Susan Barker 的一部书信体小说。

ex.src: 卷 2062 · Module M1 · Q24 · 补充语境
ex.en: Epistolary novels are novels written primarily as a series of fictional documents.
ex.zh: 书信体小说主要以一系列虚构书信文件的形式写成的小说。

senses.text: 使变窄、收紧（constricted pupils 缩小的瞳孔）
限制、压抑（constrict freedom）；名词 constriction

ex.en: Studies have found that when looking at other people’s eyes, humans tend to perceive dilated pupils positively and constricted pupils negatively.
ex.zh: 研究发现，人在注视他人眼睛时，倾向于对放大的瞳孔作正面评价，对缩小的瞳孔作负面评价。

ex.src: 卷 2612 · Module RW · Q40 · 补充语境
ex.en: Studies have found that when looking at other people's eyes, humans tend to perceive dilated pupils positively and constricted pupils negatively.

senses.text: 仿制的、以次充好的替代品（ersatz coffee 代用咖啡）
哲学「仿制现在论」ersatz presentism：以抽象替代物充当过去

ex.en: Ersatz presentism posits that the statement is made true by an abstract (“ersatz”) time that exists outside temporal time and represents how things were in the past.
ex.zh: 「仿制现在论」主张：该陈述之所以为真，是因为存在一个处于时间之外、代表过去事物状态的抽象「仿制」时间。

ex.src: 卷 2096 · Module M2 · Q25 · 补充语境
ex.en: Lucretianism posits that the statement is made true by the world’s acceptance of the past-tensed property of “having contained dinosaurs.”. 2006: Presentist philosopher Craig Bourne proposed “ersatz presentism.”.
ex.zh: 卢克莱修主义主张：该陈述之为真，在于世界接受了「曾经包含恐龙」这一过去时态属性。——2006 年，现在论哲学家 Craig Bourne 提出「代用品现在论」。

senses.text: 研究程序可被追查、复现的程度（level of traceability）
trace 追踪 → traceable → traceability；科研可复现性讨论的核心指标

ex.en: The team gave each of these studies a rating for level of traceability (with a higher rating for clearer description of procedures) and for category consistency (with a higher rating for using materials categories more closely aligned with the categories in the team's database).
ex.zh: 团队为每项研究评定了可追溯性等级（程序描述越清晰得分越高）与类别一致性等级（所用材料类别越接近团队数据库的分类，得分越高）。

senses.text: 细微到感官无法辨别的（imperceptible features 肉眼难见的细节）
im- 否定 + perceptible 可感知的；反义 perceptible 明显的

ex.en: Because they penetrate the visible surface of a painting, ultraviolet and other nonvisible spectra of light enable the detection of otherwise imperceptible features of the work.
ex.zh: 由于紫外线及其他不可见光谱能穿透画面的表层，它们使画作中那些原本难以察觉的特征得以被发现。

senses.text: 严厉批评、责骂（chastise the audience 数落观众）
与 castigate 近义，语气正式；此处指现场表演者与观众互动时调侃责备

ex.en: Wade cites features of the texts indicative of live performance, such as chastising the audience, extensive use of simple structures (allowing for easy memorization), and requests for tips (payment) from listeners.
ex.zh: Wade 举出文本中表明现场表演的特征，例如数落观众、大量使用易于记诵的简单结构，以及向听众索要赏钱。

senses.text: cuneus 楔 + form 形状；指笔画呈楔状的古代文字
楔形文字（cuneiform script），美索不达米亚最早的文字系统

ex.en: The cuneiform script is the earliest known set of symbols used for writing.
ex.zh: 楔形文字是目前已知最早的一套用于书写的符号系统。

ex.src: 卷 2077 · Module M1 · Q27 · 补充语境
ex.en: Sumerian was one of the first languages to be written using the cuneiform script.
ex.zh: 苏美尔语是最早用楔形文字书写的语言之一。

senses.text: 员工经常不到岗的情况（reduce absenteeism 降低缺勤率）
与 presenteeism（带病出勤、人在心不在）成对出现，是职场健康研究的两个指标

ex.en: Michelle Pereira et al. hypothesized that introducing health improvements into workplaces would increase productivity by reducing absenteeism (sick employees not working) and presenteeism (sick workers working less productively due to illness).
ex.zh: Michelle Pereira 等人假设，在工作场所推行健康改善措施可以提高生产率，途径是减少缺勤（生病员工不来上班）与「带病出勤」（生病员工上班但效率降低）。

senses.text: 数量逐渐减少到所剩无几（dwindling population 不断萎缩的种群）
强调持续、不可逆的减少；比 decrease 更有「日渐枯竭」的意味

ex.en: In response to a rapidly dwindling population of blueback salmon, the Quinault Indian Nation (a tribe in Washington State) partnered with the conservation organization Wild Salmon Center to restore naturally occurring logjams in the Quinault River.
ex.zh: 面对蓝背鲑数量的急剧下降，奎诺尔特印第安部落（华盛顿州的一个部落）与保护组织「野鲑中心」合作，在奎诺尔特河恢复天然形成的木桩阻塞。

senses.text: 不愿多谈、有所保留的（reticent about sth 对某事避而不谈）
不是「害羞」，而是「刻意不说」；名词 reticence 沉默寡言

ex.en: The narrator has asked the woman he rents a room from about Ethan Frome, a town resident he encountered recently.Her mind was a store-house of innocuous anecdote and any question about her acquaintances brought forth a volume of detail; but on the subject of Ethan Frome I found her unexpectedly reticent.
ex.zh: 但一谈到《Ethan Frome》，我发现她出乎意料地不愿多言。

senses.text: 分散的元素聚合成一个整体（coalesce into 汇合成）
co- 共同 + alescere 生长；名词 coalescence 合并

ex.en: Magical realism, a style that weaves fantasy into realistic narratives, coalesced in Latin America in the 1960s.
ex.zh: 魔幻现实主义——一种把幻想编织进现实叙事的风格——于 1960 年代在拉丁美洲成形。

ex.src: 卷 2038 · Module M2 · Q2 · 补充语境
ex.en: One popular theory of the origin of the Moon, the "big whack," posits that a protoplanet called Theia collided with Earth, flinging debris into orbit that eventually coalesced into the Moon.
ex.zh: 一种流行的月球起源理论——「大碰撞说」——认为：一颗名为忒伊亚的原行星撞上地球，抛出的碎片进入轨道，最终聚合成月球。

senses.text: 做事超出本分或能力所及（overreach oneself 弄巧成拙）
overreaching for status：为攀比地位而越界，社会史语境指僭越等级

ex.en: Such laws, enacted against a backdrop of anxiety about social dynamism, were intended to limit aspirational overreaching for status but were infrequently enforced.
ex.zh: 这类法律在人们对社会阶层流动感到焦虑的背景下颁布，本意是限制为攫取地位而进行的攀比越界，却很少真正执行。

senses.text: 与常识判断相反的（seem counterintuitive 看似不合常理）
counter- 反 + intuitive 直觉的；SAT 科学类文章的高频评价词

ex.en: Evidence now shows that being prompted to consider the shared biology of all humans can cause individuals to identify more strongly with humanity overall, suggesting that emphasis on the “human family tree” may promote collective action. Text 2Perhaps counterintuitively, a focus on group distinctions can help ensure that responsibility for issues with global effects (e.g., freshwater shortages and biodiversity loss) is shared globally.
ex.zh: 现有证据表明，引导人们思考全人类共同的生物属性，能使个体更强烈地认同全人类——这提示，强调「人类家树」或可促成集体行动。——或许有悖直觉，聚焦群体差异反而有助于确保：对具有全球性影响的问题（如淡水短缺、生物多样性丧失），责任由全球共同分担。

ex.src: 卷 2611 · Module M2B · Q2 · 补充语境
ex.en: A ameliorate B augment C coalesce D substantiate In the 2010s, the price of vintage My Little Pony figures rose dramatically, which had the counterintuitive effect of ______ demand: buyers who hadn’t previously wanted to purchase old toys suddenly thronged the market, believing prices would continue to rise and the toy

senses.text: 河道中呈 U 形的弯道（地理学专门义）
蜿蜒而行；（谈话、思路）漫无边际地展开

ex.en: U-shaped curve in a river channel is called a meander.
ex.zh: 河道中呈 U 形的弯曲称为河曲。

ex.src: 卷 2065 · Module M2 · Q25 · 补充语境
ex.en: A river with high sinuosity has many meanders, and a river with low sinuosity has few. .
ex.zh: 弯曲度高的河流有许多河曲，弯曲度低的河流则很少。

senses.text: 把复杂事物削足适履地归约为单一因素（how reductive this model is）
reduce 缩减 → reductive；reductionism 还原论，学术批评常用贬义

ex.en: Alemu Mekonnen and Gunnar Kohlin's study of fuel use in Ethiopia shows how reductive this model is, however: although income of course constrained fuel choice, several circumstances, including the local availability of different fuel sources, influenced decisions.
ex.zh: 然而，Alemu Mekonnen 与 Gunnar Kohlin 对埃塞俄比亚燃料使用的研究显示，这一模型何等简化：收入固然制约了燃料选择，但包括当地各类燃料可获得性在内的多种情况都影响了决策。

ex.src: 卷 2061 · Module M2 · Q6 · 补充语境
ex.en: Rasmus Heltberg’s study of fuel use in Ghana shows this model to be reductive, however: household fuel use was heterogeneous, flexible, and influenced by several factors, including the stability of the local electrical grid.
ex.zh: 然而 Rasmus Heltberg 对加纳燃料使用的研究表明该模型过于简化：家庭燃料使用是异质而灵活的，受当地电网稳定性等多种因素影响。

senses.text: 把某事的原因归于某人或某物（ascribe A to B）
与 attribute 近义；ascribe 更常用于「把…说成是…造成的」这一解释性语境

ex.en: The linguistic niche hypothesis (LNH) posits that the exotericity of languages (how prevalent non-native speakers are) and grammatical complexity are inversely related, which the LNH ascribes to attrition of complex grammatical rules as more non-native speakers adopt the language but fail to acquire those rules.
ex.zh: 语言生态位假说认为，语言的「外族性」（非母语使用者的普遍程度）与语法复杂度呈反比；该假说把这归因于：随着越来越多非母语者习得该语言却未能掌握这些规则，复杂的语法规则逐渐磨蚀。

senses.text: 为达到目的而使用的诡计（full of guile 满是心机）
文学语域，与 cunning 近义；形容词 guileless 反义「不设防的」

ex.en: Aunt Polly asked [Tom] questions that were full of guile, and very deep—for she wanted to trap him into damaging revealments.
ex.zh: 波莉姨妈问汤姆的问题满是圈套，而且用意极深——她想诱他露出破绽。

ex.src: 卷 2611 · Module M2B · Q7 · 补充语境
ex.en: Aunt Polly asked [Tom] questions that were full of guile, and very deep—for she wanted to trap him into damaging revealments.

senses.text: 梦幻、非理性并置的超现实主义风格（surrealist collage 超现实拼贴）
sur- 超 + real 现实 → surreal → surrealism → surrealist

ex.en: Felipe Posada (pseudonym The Invisible Realm) is a New York City-based artist who specializes in the form of art known as surrealist collage.
ex.zh: Felipe Posada（化名 The Invisible Realm）是一位常驻纽约的艺术家，专攻超现实主义拼贴。

senses.text: 相对于神职人员的普通信众（the laity 俗人群体）
与 clergy（神职人员）成对；形容词 lay 世俗的、非专业的

ex.en: Ely is a clergyman in the town of Milby. By the laity of Milby and its neighbourhood [Mr.
ex.zh: Ely 是米尔比镇的一位牧师；在米尔比及其周边的平信徒看来，他是……

senses.text: 意在平息怒气、寻求和解的（conciliatory response 安抚性回应）
conciliate 安抚 → conciliatory；与 confrontational 相对

ex.en: Conciliatory responses were most effective at mitigating the impact of concrete reviews, whereas more defensive responses were more useful when reviews were relatively abstract.
ex.zh: 安抚性回应在减轻具体评价所带来的冲击方面最为有效。

senses.text: 杠杆绕其转动的固定点（物理学专门义）
比喻「关键支撑点、着力点」

ex.en: A lever is a simple machine consisting of a rigid beam and a fulcrum.
ex.mark: a rigid beam and a fulcrum
ex.zh: 杠杆是一种简单机械，由一根刚性横梁和一个支点构成。

ex.src: 卷 2003 · Module M1 · Q23 · 补充语境
ex.en: In first-class levers, the fulcrum is located between the effort and the load..
ex.zh: 在第一类杠杆中，支点位于作用力与负荷之间。

senses.text: 两端分别落在不同范畴、时期或立场上（straddle the line between 介于两者之间）
跨坐、叉腿而立

ex.en: The late-period pieces of James Tate arguably fit this description, since they straddle the line between prose and poetry.
ex.mark: straddle the line between prose and poetry
ex.zh: James Tate 晚期的作品大概符合这一描述，因为它们横跨在散文与诗歌的分界线上。

ex.src: 卷 2070 · Module M1 · Q10 · 补充语境
ex.en: Her art, too, straddles multiple boundaries.
ex.zh: 她的艺术同样跨越多重边界。

senses.text: 在同类中显得反常、格格不入的事物（an oddity within her body of work）
odd 奇怪的 → oddity；与 anomaly 近义

ex.en: Virginia Woolf’s 1928 novel Orlando is an oddity within her body of work.
ex.mark: an oddity within her body of work
ex.zh: 弗吉尼亚·伍尔夫 1928 年的小说《Orlando》是她全部作品中一个异类。

senses.text: 依凭自由联想而非逻辑线性展开的（associative logic 联想逻辑）
associate 关联 → associative；与 linear（线性的）对照

ex.en: In a study of the mechanisms underlying associative memory—or the ability to learn and remember connections between inherently unrelated things—neuroscientists Kei Igarashi, Jasmine Chavez, and others presented mice with memory tests.
ex.zh: 在一项关于联想记忆机制（即学习并记住本无关联事物之间联系的能力）的研究中，神经科学家 Kei Igarashi、Jasmine Chavez 等人对小鼠进行了记忆测试。

ex.src: 卷 2104 · Module M2E · Q16 · 补充语境
ex.en: The team discovered that fan cells, a type of cell found in the medial temporal lobe of the brain, are necessary for the acquisition of new associative memories.
ex.zh: 研究团队发现：扇形细胞——大脑内侧颞叶中的一类细胞——是获得新联想记忆的必要条件。

senses.text: 说话坦率、不绕弯子的（a narrative voice so forthright）
褒义偏多，含「坦诚得近乎不加修饰」；与 blunt 相比少一分粗鲁

ex.en: Autofiction usually borrows formal elements from autobiographical writing too, including its first person point of view and its use of a narrative voice so forthright that it borders on confessional.
ex.mark: so forthright that it borders on confessional
ex.zh: 自传体小说通常也借用自传写作的形式要素，包括第一人称视角，以及一种直率到近乎自白的叙事声音。

senses.text: 由人类活动造成的（anthropogenic noise 人为噪声）
anthropo- 人类 + -genic 产生；气候、生态语境的核心术语

ex.en: In a meta-analysis of more than 100 studies of anthropogenic noise and various species and classes of animals, Kunc and Schmidt found that, on average, mammals showed larger effects from the noise than birds did.
ex.zh: Kunc 与 Schmidt 对 100 多项关于人为噪声与各类动物的研究做了元分析，发现平均而言哺乳动物受到的影响大于鸟类。

ex.src: 卷 2069 · Module M2 · Q12 · 补充语境
ex.en: The researchers ultimately recommended that reducing anthropogenic emissions remain the primary focus of urban air-quality improvement efforts.
ex.zh: 研究者最终建议：改善城市空气质量仍应以削减人为排放为首要目标。

senses.text: 把原本非商品的事物转化为可售卖、可获利的形式（monetized sale 以货币出售）
money → monetize；名词 monetization 货币化

ex.en: Crislayne Alfagali and other Africanist scholars have shown, however, that in parts of Africa, wage labor competition, the manufacture of surplus goods for monetized sale, and other features of capitalism predated colonization.
ex.zh: 为以货币出售而生产过剩商品。

senses.text: 为某项事业投入的资金（outlays for lobbying 游说开支）
比 expense 更强调「一次性投入的款项」；动词短语 outlay on sth

ex.en: Private foundations are prohibited from holding excess interests in a business enterprise, “self-dealing” (conducting activities that benefit foundation insiders), making taxable expenditures such as outlays for lobbying, and failing to cross a required threshold in making charitable distributions from income.
ex.zh: 私人基金会不得在企业中持有超额权益、不得进行「自我交易」（从事使基金会内部人获益的活动）、不得进行应税支出（如游说开支），也不得在从收入中划拨慈善捐赠时未达到规定比例。

senses.text: 性情温和、待人友善的（your amiable ward 您那位可亲的被监护人）
与 amicable（关系和睦的）区分：amiable 形容人，amicable 形容关系或协议

ex.en: Mirvan’s family.It is very earnestly [the Mirvans’] wish to enlarge and enliven their party by the addition of your amiable ward, who would share, equally with her own daughter, the care and attention of Mrs.
ex.zh: Mirvan 一家非常恳切地希望，把您那位和蔼可亲的被监护人加入他们的聚会，使宾主更为热闹。

senses.text: 城墙、堡垒等加固设施（the fortifications and impediments）
强化、加固（fortification of food 营养强化）

ex.en: I had gazed upon the fortifications and impediments that seemed to keep human beings from entering the citadel of nature, and rashly and ignorantly I had repined.
ex.zh: 我曾凝望那些仿佛阻止人类进入自然之城堡的防御工事与障碍，并且轻率而无知地心生怨怼。

senses.text: 外观或品格上的小缺点（slight blemishes 微小的瑕疵）
损害、玷污（blemish one's reputation）

ex.en: It is true, the Countess was a little vain, a little ambitious, a little selfish, a little shallow and frivolous, a little given to white lies,—But who considers such slight blemishes, such moral pimples as these, disqualifications for entering into the most respectable society!
ex.zh: 不错，伯爵夫人是有点虚荣、有点野心、有点自私、有点浅薄轻浮，也有点爱说些无伤大雅的小谎——可谁会把这样轻微的瑕疵、这样道德上的小痘痘，当作不能进入最体面社交圈的理由呢！

senses.text: 物体被拧转时产生的形变（力学专门义）
tort- 扭曲 → torsion；形容词 torsional 扭转的

ex.en: The twisting of an object is known as torsion.
ex.zh: 物体被拧转，这一形变称为扭转。

ex.src: 卷 2043 · Module M1 · Q27 · 补充语境
ex.en: A 2019 study led by researchers Zunfeng Liu and Ray Baughman tested the torsional heating and cooling of various fibers.
ex.zh: 2019 年由 Zunfeng Liu 与 Ray Baughman 领导的研究测试了多种纤维的扭转加热与冷却效应。

senses.text: 依类别整体处理的（categorical exclusion 类别豁免）
绝对的、无条件的（a categorical denial 断然否认）

ex.en: While many NEPA reviews require public comment, categorical exclusions (CEs) allow quick reviews with no public comment for actions that will minimally affect the environment.
ex.zh: 许多《国家环境政策法》的审查需要公众评议，但「类别豁免」允许对环境影响极小的行为快速审查、无需公众评议。

ex.src: 卷 2612 · Module RW · Q49 · 补充语境
ex.en: The categorical distinction between soft and hard commodities lies not in the products’ strength or durability but in their origin: the former type is grown or farmed, while the latter is mined or drilled.

senses.text: 依照年代先后排列（chronologically expansive 时间跨度大的）
chrono- 时间 + logy 学科 → chronological → chronologically

ex.en: Shurin’s volume is chronologically expansive, featuring such stories as James Tiptree Jr.’s “The Girl Who Was Plugged In” (1973) and Lavanya Lakshminarayan’s “Études” (2020).
ex.zh: Shurin 编选的这卷书在时间上跨度很大，收录了 James Tiptree Jr. 的《The Girl Who Was Plugged In》（1973）与 Lavanya Lakshminarayan 的《Études》（2020）等作品。

senses.text: 使（坏情况）变得更糟（crises exacerbated by… 因…而加剧的危机）
只用于负面事物；不能与 improve 互换，SAT 常考搭配误用

ex.en: In response to concerns that some recent financial crises were exacerbated by consumers misunderstanding risks associated with credit cards, loans, and other financial products, policymakers in many countries have instituted risk-disclosure requirements on sellers of those products.
ex.zh: 由于担心近来的金融危机部分源于消费者误解了信用卡、贷款等金融产品的相关风险，许多国家的监管者对这些产品的销售方设立了风险披露要求。

senses.text: 适于耕作的土地（arable land 耕地）
只形容土地，不形容作物；与 fertile（肥沃的）不完全等同

ex.en: Tanada were built by carving the steep hillsides into a series of large, flat steps, thus increasing arable land.
ex.zh: 田代（tanada）是把陡峭山坡凿成一级级宽大平坦的台阶修成的，从而扩大了耕地面积。

ex.src: 卷 2031 · Module M1 · Q26 · 补充语境
ex.en: This agricultural method allowed farmers to increase arable land and prevent landslides.
ex.zh: 这种耕作方式使农民得以扩大可耕地并防止山体滑坡。

senses.text: 强调、使格外明显（further underscores its role）
在文字下划线；比喻义在学术写作中极常用

ex.en: This increased genetic variety among related light-emitting species further underscores bioluminescence’s crucial role in marine biodiversity and evolution.
ex.zh: 相关发光物种之间遗传多样性的增加，进一步凸显了生物发光在海洋生物多样性与演化中的关键作用。

senses.text: 慢慢享受某种感受或经历（savor good news 品味好消息）
强调延长时间去体会；与 enjoy 相比更带「不舍得一口吞下」的意味

ex.en: On average, those who kept good news secret reported feeling more energized by the experience than participants who shared did, perhaps, as the researchers suggest, because the choice to savor good news is usually a personal one and autonomous motivation is linked with feelings of vitality.
ex.zh: 平均而言，把好消息保密的人报告说，这一经历让他们更有活力，胜过把消息分享出去的人；研究者认为，这也许是因为「细细品味好消息」通常是个人自主的选择，而自主性动机与活力感相关联。

senses.text: 障碍大到无法逾越（insurmountable reluctance 难以克服的抗拒）
in- 否定 + surmount 攀登、克服 + -able

kin: 复盘 — 与 657 reserve 共用同一 Ethan Frome 真题句——an insurmountable reluctance to speak of him，背 insurmountable 时顺带复盘 reserve 的「沉默」义

ex.en: There was no hint of disapproval in her reserve; I merely felt in her an insurmountable reluctance to speak of him.
ex.zh: 她的沉默中并没有一丝不赞成的意味；我只是感到，她内心有一种难以克服的抗拒，不愿谈起他。

senses.text: 以对等回报为基础的社会规范（reciprocity nudge 互惠式助推）
reciprocal 相互的 → reciprocity；行为经济学常用

ex.en: The team also found that the specific type of nudge (reciprocity, compensation, etc.) did not significantly affect user behavior.
ex.zh: 团队还发现，助推的具体类型（互惠、补偿等）并未显著影响用户行为。

senses.text: 不通过货币的直接交换（barter economy 物物交换经济）
与 commodity currency（商品货币）相对：后者已有共同等价物

ex.en: By using specific goods like cotton as common units of exchange, commodity currency economies streamline trade, which is why they often replaced barter economies.
ex.zh: 通过以棉花等特定商品作为共同交换单位，商品货币经济简化了贸易，这也是它们往往取代物物交换经济的原因。

ex.src: 卷 2069 · Module M2 · Q26 · 补充语境
ex.en: Economists Bruce Champ and Scott Freeman: bartering requires that “the person with whom you wish to trade must not only have what you want but also want what you have.
ex.zh: 经济学家 Bruce Champ 与 Scott Freeman 指出：以物易物要求「你想与之交易的人，不仅要拥有你想要的东西，还必须想要你拥有的东西」。

senses.text: 不具伤害性、不惹麻烦的（innocuous anecdote 无害的轶事）
in- 否定 + nocuous 有害的；与 noxious（有毒的）区分

ex.en: Her mind was a store-house of innocuous anecdote and any question about her acquaintances brought forth a volume of detail …
ex.zh: 她的脑子里像一座仓库，装满了无害的轶事；只要问起她认识的某个人，她就能倒出一大堆细节。

senses.text: 以力量压制、使屈服（subdue prey 制服猎物）
抑制（情绪、声音）；形容词 subdued 低调的、被压低的

ex.en: Finding that the venom used by the Panamanian scorpion Centruroides granosus to subdue prey also inhibits growth of the pathogenic bacteria Escherichia coli, Dumas Gálvez and colleagues conclude that the particular form of venom production observed in C. granosus may have propagated through the species because it mitigates risk during feeding in addition to enhancing predation success.
ex.zh: Dumas Gálvez 及同事发现，巴拿马蝎 Centruroides granosus 用以制服猎物的毒液同时能抑制致病菌大肠杆菌的生长，据此认为该物种这种特定的产毒方式之所以在种群中扩散，可能是因为它在提高捕食成功率之外，还降低了进食过程中的风险。

senses.text: 怀着深敬之情看待（revered figures 受人崇敬的人物）
reverence 敬意 → revere；形容词 reverent / reverend

ex.en: According to the book's publisher, Penguin Random House, the book “celebrates the gifts of life and mourns the deaths of revered African American figures.”.
ex.zh: 据该书出版方企鹅兰登书屋介绍，这本书「颂扬生命的馈赠，哀悼备受崇敬的非裔美国人逝者」。

senses.text: 无意中暴露出（情感、事实）（betray the vanity of the writer 露出作者的虚荣）
背叛、出卖；两个义项在 SAT 中都会考，靠宾语判断

kin: betrayal — 同词根构词变体，已并入本词条统一计数

ex.en: I am at a loss how to describe the success of the work, without betraying the vanity of the writer.
ex.mark: betraying the vanity of the writer
ex.zh: 我不知该如何描述这部作品的成功，而又不暴露出作者自身的虚荣。

senses.text: 不情愿地交出、让出（refuse to relinquish power 拒不放权）
强调「松手让出」，比 abandon 更正式，常与 power / control / claim 搭配

ex.en: Aristotle observes that different forms of government can fall in different ways—for example, oligarchies might grant power to military leaders during wartime who refuse to relinquish that power during peacetime—but some methods of preserving order apply across all forms of government.
ex.zh: 亚里士多德观察到，不同政体可能以不同方式衰败——例如寡头政体可能在战时把权力交给军事领袖，而这些人到了和平时期仍拒绝交出权力——但有些维护秩序的方法适用于所有政体。

senses.text: 不相信他人动机真诚的消极态度（considered ignoble 被视为不光彩的）
与 skepticism（怀疑）不同：cynicism 含道德上的犬儒与嘲讽

ex.en: ​​​​​​​Alessandro Nai et al. presented study participants with vignettes about fictive political candidates, portraying them as embodying a personality trait widely considered admirable (e.g., agreeableness) or one considered ignoble (e.g., cynicism).
ex.zh: Alessandro Nai 等人向研究参与者呈现了关于虚构政治候选人的短文，把这些候选人描绘成具有某种广受推崇的人格特质（如亲和性），或某种被视为不光彩的特质（如愤世嫉俗）。

senses.text: 社会、政治层面的剧烈动荡（cultural upheaval 文化剧变）
up- 向上 + heave 举起 → upheaval；与 turmoil 近义

ex.en: Such an analysis of Pablo Picasso's Les Demoiselles d'Avignon might consider how the painting's portrayal of fragmented human figures challenged conventions of beauty during a time of cultural upheaval (early twentieth century).
ex.zh: 对毕加索《亚维农少女》作这样的分析，可以考虑这幅画对破碎人体形象的呈现，如何在文化剧变的时代（二十世纪初）挑战了美的成规。

ex.src: 卷 2031 · Module M1 · Q26 · 补充语境
ex.en: The Sengoku period (1467 CE-1615 CE) was characterized by social upheaval and civil war.
ex.zh: 战国时代（1467-1615）的特征是社会动荡与内战频仍。

senses.text: 逐渐削弱、消耗（attrition of complex rules 复杂规则的磨蚀）
强调缓慢、持续的损耗，而非一次性消失；战争语境指消耗战

ex.en: … which the LNH ascribes to attrition of complex grammatical rules as more non-native speakers adopt the language but fail to acquire those rules.
ex.zh: 语言生态位假说把这归因于：随着越来越多非母语者习得该语言却未能掌握这些规则，复杂的语法规则逐渐磨蚀。

senses.text: 忽然获得本质性理解的时刻（a connection or epiphany 关联或顿悟）
主显节；文学批评中指尖锐的启示瞬间

ex.en: A connection or epiphany can happen while watching or reading something brilliant.
ex.zh: 关联或顿悟，可能发生在观看或阅读一部精彩作品之时。

senses.text: 彼此接壤、连成一片的（contiguous forests 连片森林）
强调地理上相连；与 adjacent（相邻但不一定接触）有别

ex.en: In their study of caterpillars in fragmented forests (formerly contiguous forests that have been broken into isolated patches by roads or other interruptions), Riley M.
ex.zh: Riley M. 等人在破碎化森林（原本连片、后被道路或其它阻隔切成孤立斑块的森林）中研究毛虫时……

ex.src: 卷 2064 · Module M2 · Q26 · 补充语境
ex.en: These buildings had cube-shaped, contiguous rooms that surrounded kivas. .
ex.zh: 这些建筑拥有立方形的连片房间，环绕着地下礼室（kiva）。

senses.text: 冻土、冰雪融化（soil thawing 土壤解冻）
（关系）缓和、回暖；SAT 气候类文章常指永久冻土融化释放碳

ex.en: Soil thawing in Alaska has been accelerating in response to climate warming, potentially enabling increased carbon dioxide (CO₂) absorption through greater productivity of Port Clarence Indian paintbrush (Castilleja caudata) plants and other vegetation, but also potentially enabling increased CO₂ output through greater heterotrophic respiration (CO₂ generated by the activity of soil microorganisms).
ex.zh: 阿拉斯加的土壤解冻因气候变暖而不断加速，这可能通过克拉伦斯港印第安画笔花（Castilleja caudata）等植被生产力的提高而增强二氧化碳的吸收，但也可能通过异养呼吸增强（土壤微生物活动产生的 CO₂）而增加 CO₂ 排放。

ex.src: 卷 2001 · Module M1 · Q23 · 补充语境
ex.en: Typically, the ice sheet begins to show evidence of thawing in late summer.
ex.zh: 通常，冰盖在夏末开始显出解冻迹象。

senses.text: 需要极大努力、过程艰苦的（an arduous writing process 艰难的写作过程）
强调「费力且漫长」；与 hard 相比更书面，常形容旅程、谈判、过程

ex.en: Though Vasily Grossman’s novel Stalingrad is considered inferior to his later work Everything Flows, some critics praise it despite an arduous writing process required to satisfy Soviet censors (Jordan Penney in Pop Matters called Stalingrad “powerful”).
ex.zh: 尽管瓦西里·格罗斯曼的小说《Stalingrad》被认为不如他后来的《Everything Flows》，仍有评论家称赞它，尽管为通过苏联审查，这部作品的写作过程极为艰难（PopMatters 的 Jordan Penney 称《Stalingrad》「有力」）。

ex.src: 卷 2612 · Module RW · Q34 · 补充语境
ex.en: Though Anton Kuznetsov’s novel The Volga Crossing is considered inferior to his later work The Open Road, some critics praise it despite an arduous writing process required to satisfy Soviet censors (Nina Wallace in The Observer called The Volga Crossing “dazzling”).

senses.text: 未经证实地断言（be alleged to be 据称是）
新闻与法律语域，暗含「尚未证实」；名词 allegation 指控

ex.en: Multiple sculptures dating to the period have been alleged to be the reported bust, but none have been authenticated as Desiderio's depiction of Strozzi.
ex.zh: 多件属于该时期的雕塑被指认为所报道的那尊胸像，但无一件被确证为 Desiderio 所塑的斯特罗齐像。

ex.src: 卷 2613 · Module RWM1 · Q4 · 补充语境
ex.en: Some critics allege that current sustainable forestry certification requirements and procedures, while uniform in application, are ______ in effect.

senses.text: 处理事情时的巧妙与分寸感（too much finesse about him 他身上机巧太过）
巧妙地处理、化解（finesse a problem）

ex.en: … there was a thought too much finesse about him, and, as even his father sometimes told him …
ex.mark: a thought too much finesse about him
ex.zh: 他身上有几分过于精明的机巧。

senses.text: 掀开覆盖物使显露（unveil the face of Nature 揭开自然的面纱）
首次公布、发布（unveil a plan / a product）

ex.src: 真题原句 · 同源片段
ex.en: He had partially unveiled the face of Nature …
ex.mark: partially unveiled the face of Nature
ex.zh: 他已部分揭开了自然的面纱。

senses.text: 某事内在地包含、需要（the position entails running 这个位置意味着要跑动）
不是「导致」，而是「本身即包含」；主语常为职责、方案、权利

ex.en: The running back position entails running, or rushing, down the field with the football to gain yards for the team.
ex.zh: 跑卫这一位置本身就要求跑动，即带球冲向前场为球队推进码数。

senses.text: 不严肃、缺乏分量的（shallow and frivolous 浅薄轻浮）
形容人、言行或诉讼（frivolous lawsuit 无理诉讼）；与 trivial 有别，后者指不重要

ex.en: Amos Barton." The Countess Czerlaski is a newcomer to the town of Milby.It is true, the Countess was a little vain, a little ambitious, a little selfish, a little shallow and frivolous, a little given to white lies,—But who considers such slight blemishes, such moral pimples as these, disqualifications for entering into the most respectable society!
ex.zh: 不错，伯爵夫人是有点虚荣、有点野心、有点自私、有点浅薄轻浮，也有点爱说些无伤大雅的小谎。

senses.text: 在模糊或复杂的情况下看出、辨明（discern the ecological role 辨明生态作用）
强调「费力看出」；形容词 discerning 有眼光的

ex.en: To discern the ecological role that blackberry plants, or Rubus fruticosus L. aggregate, serve for species of foraging insects, many of which are in decline, Annabel Squire and team recorded about two thousand insect visits to R. fruticosus (between 11 a.m. and 4 p.m.) during the plant's flowering period.
ex.zh: 为了辨明黑莓（Rubus fruticosus L. 复合群）为多种觅食昆虫（其中许多正在减少）所提供的生态作用，Annabel Squire 及团队在该植物花期（上午 11 点至下午 4 点）记录了约两千次昆虫访花。

senses.text: 教堂中牧师布道的高台（London pulpits 伦敦的讲道坛）
借指神职人员的布道、宗教权威

ex.en: Ely] was regarded as a man of quite remarkable powers and learning, who must make a considerable sensation in London pulpits and drawing-rooms on his occasional visit to the metropolis; and by his brother clergy he was regarded as a discreet and agreeable fellow.
ex.zh: 在人们看来，Ely 是一位能力与学识都相当出众的人，偶尔造访伦敦时，必将在伦敦的讲道坛与沙龙里引起不小的轰动；而在同僚教士眼中，他是个谨慎而随和的人。

senses.text: 难以理解的人或事（cast light on this enigma 为这个谜提供线索）
enigmatic 神秘的；与 riddle、mystery 相比更强调「难以解读」

kin: enigmatic — 同族形容词 · 谜一样的、晦涩的——独立词条见 206
同句复盘 — 与 968 cast 共用同一真题句：cast 高亮 cast light on（词组义），本词高亮 this enigma（谜团义），背一复习二

ex.en: His recently published memoirs possibly cast light on this enigma, but given that such details were not provided until after the thirty-page mark, they might as well have remained state secrets.
ex.zh: 他新近出版的回忆录或许能照亮（cast light on）这个谜团（enigma），但由于这些细节直到第三十页之后才出现，它们还不如继续当国家机密算了。

senses.text: 从遗址、沉积物或样本中重新取得（recovered from Bronze and Iron Age sites 出土于青铜与铁器时代遗址）
回到原有状态（recover from illness）；名词 recovery 恢复；采集

kin: recovery — 同词根构词变体，已并入本词条统一计数

ex.en: A dataset of gold objects, including beads and medallions, recovered from Bronze and Iron Age sites at Nosiri, Oshakan, and other places in the Caucasus reveals a steep drop in the total number of gold artifacts beginning around 1500 BCE in some locations.
ex.mark: recovered from Bronze and Iron Age sites
ex.zh: 一批金器——包括珠子与圆形饰牌——出土于高加索地区 Nosiri、Oshakan 等地的青铜与铁器时代遗址，它们显示，在某些地点，金制品的总数自公元前 1500 年左右起急剧下降。

ex.src: 卷 2068 · Module M1 · Q1 · 补充语境
ex.en: The recovery program led by Marisel López-Flores has dramatically increased the population size of the endangered Amazona vittata, the endemic parrot of Puerto Rico.
ex.zh: 由 Marisel López-Flores 领导的恢复计划，使濒危的波多黎各特有鹦鹉 Amazona vittata 的种群数量显著回升。

senses.text: 某事得以成立所必需的前提（an absolute prerequisite for 的绝对前提）
pre- 先 + requisite 必需物；与 requirement 近义但更强调先后顺序

ex.en: A newly designed piezoelectric harvester incorporating a highly conductive carbon fiber reinforced polymer (CFRP) electrode has been shown to provide steady energy loads during resonance, an absolute prerequisite for wireless communication devices to be powered piezoelectrically.
ex.zh: 一种引入高导电碳纤维增强聚合物（CFRP）电极的新型压电采集器已被证明能在共振时提供稳定的能量负载，而这正是无线通信设备依靠压电方式供电的绝对前提。

senses.text: 同一次孵出的幼体（brood care 育幼行为）
沉思、忧思（brood over）；此处指动物对后代的抚育

ex.en: From meerkats to short-tailed crickets, many animals practice some form of brood care (caring for offspring).
ex.zh: 从猫鼬到短尾蟋蟀，许多动物都实行某种形式的育幼行为（照料后代）。

ex.src: 卷 2100 · Module M1 · Q9 · 补充语境
ex.en: This finding establishes brood care in insects approximately 38 million years earlier than previously known.
ex.zh: 这一发现把昆虫的育幼行为向前推了约 3800 万年。

senses.text: 直接冲击感官与情绪的、非理性的（a visceral kind of armchair tourism 一种直击感官的「卧游」）
内脏的（visceral organs）；引申为「本能的、深层的」

ex.en: American journalist Nathan Heller praises it, writing that “it affords a visceral kind of armchair tourism.”
ex.mark: a visceral kind of armchair tourism
ex.zh: 美国记者 Nathan Heller 称赞它，写道它「带来一种直击感官的卧游体验」。

senses.text: 按层级高低组织起来的（hierarchical pieces 等级分明的棋子）
hierarchy 层级 → hierarchical；社会学、组织研究高频

ex.en: Chess, with its hierarchical pieces representing different social classes, was particularly popular during this period.
ex.zh: 象棋的棋子等级分明，分别代表不同的社会阶层，因此在这一时期特别流行。

ex.src: 卷 2065 · Module M2 · Q15 · 补充语境
ex.en: Hypothesizing that this typical relationship would have differed in medieval settlements because of the constraining influence of strong hierarchical social structures (which are much less pronounced in modern cities) on social networking and economic integration—drivers of urban agglomeration—the team created a model that accounted for the presence of restrictive institutions.
ex.zh: 研究团队推测：这一典型关系在中世纪聚落中会有所不同——因为森严的等级社会结构（在现代城市中远不明显）会约束社交网络与经济整合，而这两者正是城市集聚的驱动力——于是他们建立了一个把限制性制度纳入考量的模型。

senses.text: 把某范围完整包含在内（encompass more types of material 涵盖更多类型的材料）
包围、环绕；名词 compass 范围

ex.en: A region of the Soviet Union encompassing the present-day city of Sukhumi, Georgia—the Abkhazian-speaking Abkhaz Autonomous Soviet Socialist Republic—was in fact only nominally autonomous.
ex.zh: 苏联的一个地区——涵盖今格鲁吉亚苏呼米市一带、以阿布哈兹语为语言的阿布哈兹苏维埃社会主义自治共和国——实际上只是名义上的自治。

senses.text: 在数量或影响力上居首的（the material interest is so predominant 物质利益如此当道）
与 dominant 近义；predominant 更强调「占比最高」

ex.en: No matter what is their special work or profession, they stand for the spiritual interest of the world, and it is a common calamity if they neglect their post in a country where the material interest is so predominant as it is in America.
ex.mark: the material interest is so predominant
ex.zh: 无论他们的具体工作或职业是什么，他们都代表着世界的精神利益；而在一个物质利益像美国这样当道的国家，如果他们玩忽职守，那便是共同的灾难。

ex.src: 卷 2100 · Module M1 · Q8 · 补充语境
ex.en: Although the website will convert prices to the buyers’ home currency, most sellers target local markets, so the researchers used virtual private networks to collect prices in each country’s predominant currency.
ex.zh: 尽管该网站会把价格换算成买家本国货币，多数卖家仍以本地市场为目标，因此研究者使用虚拟专用网络（VPN）来采集各国主流（predominant）货币下的价格。

senses.text: 硬而脆、受力即断的（the brittle star 海蛇尾）
（语气、关系）脆弱的、一触即发的；此处 brittle star 是生物名「海蛇尾」

ex.en: To better understand the benefits of this unusual design, scientists built a soft robot inspired by the brittle star’s body structure.
ex.zh: 为了更好地理解这种不寻常结构的好处，科学家仿照海蛇尾的身体结构制造了一个软体机器人。

ex.src: 卷 2102 · Module M2 · Q15 · 补充语境
ex.en: Brittle stars are sea animals that move along the ocean floor using their five arms.
ex.zh: 海蛇尾是一类海洋动物，靠五条腕在海底移动。

senses.text: 按先后顺序排列的（sequential layers 依次生长的层）
sequence 序列 → sequential；与 simultaneous（同时的）相对

ex.en: Mammoth tusks grew in sequential layers, incorporating ingested minerals and organics, and so each ivory stratum reflects the ratio of strontium isotopes (87Sr/86Sr) in the local environment; thus, the sequence of strata shows where the animal roamed during life.
ex.zh: 猛犸象牙以依次叠加的层状结构生长，层中结合了摄入的矿物质与有机物；因此每一象牙层都反映了当地环境中锶同位素（87Sr/86Sr）的比值——地层序列由此显示出这头动物生前的活动轨迹。

senses.text: 通过调查确定（ascertain the origins 查明来源）
比 find out 正式；常用于科学、法律语境的「确证」

ex.en: Although this approach offers unique benefits, such as the ability to ascertain the biogeographical origins of organisms, it remains a relatively underutilized resource because hDNA is often to some extent degraded, a situation not easily remediable under current methodological paradigms and with extant DNA extraction and analysis technologies.
ex.zh: 尽管这一路径有独特优势，例如能够查明生物的地理起源，它仍是一种相对未被充分利用的资源，因为历史 DNA 往往有不同程度的降解。

senses.text: 并非有意为之、伴随而来的（incidentally preserved 偶然保存下来的）
与 accidental 近义，但 incidental 更强调「顺带的、非主要的」

ex.en: Shaohong Feng and colleagues relied on historical DNA (hDNA)--genomic data incidentally preserved in specimens housed in collections such as those at the American Museum of Natural History--to investigate genetic diversity declines in the crested ibis (Nipponia nippon).
ex.zh: Shaohong Feng 及同事借助历史 DNA（hDNA）——即偶然保存在博物馆收藏标本中的基因组数据——来研究朱鹮（Nipponia nippon）遗传多样性的下降。

senses.text: 加强、支持（bolstering a clear argument 支撑一个清晰的论点）
提高（信心、股价）；原义是垫枕、支撑物

ex.en: In rural Minnesota, ecologist Leroy Walston conducted a study to determine whether seeding solar panel fields with wildflowers could bolster pollinator populations in nearby food crops.
ex.zh: 第一部书的各章都在为关于收入不平等的清晰而连贯的论点提供支撑，而第二部书对《摩奴法论》梵文文本作者归属之类话题的离题议论，不仅不必要地拉长了篇幅，还搅浑了论证。

senses.text: 处于劣势、不被看好的一方（the underdog 弱势者）
体育、政治语境指「以弱敌强」的一方；形容词 underdog story 逆袭故事

ex.en: The Underdogs is a 1915 novel by Mariano Azuela, originally written in Spanish.
ex.zh: 《The Underdogs》是 Mariano Azuela 于 1915 年出版的小说，原以西班牙语写成。

senses.text: 不依循成规、自成一格的特质（suffer by his originality 因其独创而受损）
original 原创的 → originality；文学评论高频

ex.en: Williams is discussing how works by nineteenth-century US poet and fiction writer Edgar Allan Poe were received by American readers. Poe must suffer by his originality.
ex.zh: 爱伦·坡必因其独创性而受损。

ex.src: 卷 2061 · Module M1 · Q6 · 补充语境
ex.en: Poe must suffer by his originality.
ex.zh: 爱伦·坡必然因其原创性而受损。

senses.text: 构思精巧、别出心裁的（the ingenious artifice 精巧的机关）
形容人「有巧思」或物「设计巧妙」；与 ingenuous（天真无邪的）拼写易混

ex.en: Hercules is a hero of Greek mythology. Dantès dug away the earth carefully, and detected, or fancied he detected, the ingenious artifice.
ex.zh: 唐泰斯小心地挖开泥土，察觉到——或者说自以为察觉到——那个精巧的机关。

senses.text: 与教士、教会事务相关的（the clerical aspect 教士气派）
另一义为「文书工作的」（clerical work）；此处取教会义，与 clergy 同源

ex.en: … but perhaps in doing so the thorough clerical aspect of the whole might have been somewhat marred.
ex.zh: 屋内有种沉闷的气氛，本可不必牺牲体面就加以改善：颜色本可挑得更好，光线本可更均匀；但若那样做，整体的那股教士气派恐怕就会被削弱几分。

senses.text: 一个人稳定的气质与情绪倾向（that was the temperament I gravitated toward）
比 personality 更偏天生的气质；音乐语境指「平均律」

ex.en: This uniformity did not surprise him; over the years, he’d learned that the waters here were temperamental.
ex.zh: 说到底，那也是我心所向的性情。

senses.text: 属于更早时代、已不再通行的（archaic language 古语）
形容语言、制度、用法；与 ancient 不同，archaic 强调「已废弃但残留」

ex.en: … the challenges modern readers face in interpreting the archaic language of Old English …
ex.mark: the archaic language of Old English
ex.zh: 现代读者在解读古英语的古老语言时所面临的困难。

senses.text: 渴望提升社会地位、向往更好生活的（aspirational overreaching for status 为攀比地位而越界）
社会学语境指「以更高阶层为参照」；商业语境 aspirational brand 轻奢品牌

kin: aspiring — 同词根构词变体，已并入本词条统一计数

ex.src: 真题原句 · 2092 卷 Module 2 Q13
ex.en: … were intended to limit aspirational overreaching for status but were infrequently enforced.
ex.zh: 这类法律在人们对社会阶层流动感到焦虑的背景下颁布，本意是限制为攫取地位而进行的攀比越界，却很少真正执行。

senses.text: 通过敲击发声的乐器组（metallic percussion 金属打击乐）
撞击、叩击；医学语境指叩诊

ex.en: By combining dense synthesizer arrangements and metallic percussion with vocals electronically shifted in pitch above her natural range, American musician Laura Les exemplifies the style of contemporary electronic music known as hyperpop.
ex.zh: 美国音乐人 Laura Les 把密集的合成器编排与金属打击乐结合起来，并把人声以电子方式移调到她自然音域之上，堪称当代电子音乐风格「hyperpop」的代表。

ex.src: 卷 2612 · Module RW · Q7 · 补充语境
ex.en: Kline’s combination of dense synthesizer arrangements and metallic percussion with a recorded voice electronically shifted in pitch above its natural range exemplifies the hyperpop sound.

senses.text: 物体外形的走势线（the CONTOUR probe 轮廓号探测器）
勾勒；此处 CONTOUR 为 NASA 探测器的专名

ex.en: The CONTOUR probe mission seemed similarly well planned, but engineers lost communications with the probe before it could achieve the mission goal of visiting comet 73P/Schwassmann-Wachmann.
ex.zh: 「轮廓号」（CONTOUR）探测器任务看起来同样计划周详，但在它实现造访 73P/Schwassmann-Wachmann 彗星的任务目标之前，工程师就与探测器失去了通信。

ex.src: 卷 2092 · Module M1 · Q27 · 补充语境
ex.en: The armrests and the seat of the chair are sleek and contoured, and the back consists of seven spindle-like slats.

senses.text: 鱼类、两栖类在水中产卵（how the animals spawn there 这些动物如何在那里产卵）
大量产生、催生（spawn debate 引发争论）

ex.en: Though biologists believe they have identified the general area in the Sargasso Sea that is crucial to the endangered eels’ survival, little is yet known about how the animals spawn there.
ex.zh: 尽管生物学家相信他们已确定马尾藻海中对该濒危鳗鱼生存至关重要的那片大致区域，但人们对这些动物究竟如何在那里产卵仍知之甚少。

ex.src: 卷 2035 · Module M1 · Q9 · 补充语境
ex.en: The logjams create shady pools where the blueback salmon can rest and spawn, thus promoting blueback population recovery.
ex.zh: 这些倒木形成阴凉的水潭，供青背鲑休息与产卵，从而促进其种群恢复。

senses.text: 以捕猎为生的（predatory owls 捕食性猫头鹰）
掠夺性的（predatory pricing 掠夺性定价）

ex.en: For instance, research indicates that the wingless, predatory Juravenator likely had feathers.
ex.zh: 例如，研究表明，无翼且具捕食性的 Juravenator 很可能长有羽毛。

ex.src: 卷 2011 · Module M2 · Q5 · 补充语境
ex.en: Price and colleagues showed that high moonlight intensity inhibits the activity of the white-throated woodrat (Neotoma albigula), a result explicable in terms of benefits and costs: greater lunar intensity may not enable the woodrats to increase foraging success enough to offset the higher chance of detection by predatory bobcats or coyotes.
ex.zh: Price 及同事发现：高强度月光会抑制白喉林鼠的活动——这一结果可用收益与代价解释：更强的月光未必能让林鼠把觅食成功率提高到足以抵消被山猫或郊狼发现的更高风险。

senses.text: 弥漫于整个领域、难以回避的（became pervasive in the public consciousness 深入公众意识）
per- 贯穿 + vade 走 → pervade → pervasive；名词 pervasiveness

ex.en: Remarkable for anticipating and amplifying cultural perceptions of Florida that became pervasive in the public consciousness, paintings by the Highwaymen are readily identifiable by the natural iconography—​​​​​​​placid inland rivers, windswept palm trees—that McLendon and colleagues perpetually revisited.
ex.mark: became pervasive in the public consciousness
ex.zh: 这些作品因预判并放大了佛罗里达的文化形象而著称，那些形象后来深入公众意识。

senses.text: 时断时续、周期性出现的（an intermittently dry stream 间歇性断流的溪）
与 continuous 相对；医学 intermittent fever 间歇热

ex.en: The editors of Home Ground: A Guide to the American Landscape turned to Arturo Longoria, a nonfiction writer, to craft the entry for “arroyo,” a term referring to the bed of an intermittently dry stream or creek.
ex.zh: 《Home Ground: A Guide to the American Landscape》的编者请非虚构作家 Arturo Longoria 撰写「arroyo」这一词条，该词指间歇性断流的溪流或河床。

ex.src: 卷 2022 · Module M2 · Q7 · 补充语境
ex.en: Asteroid 6478 Gault has experienced intermittent mass loss since at least 2013, but in contrast to some other asteroids with repeated mass-loss episodes, 6478 Gault has not lost mass at its perihelion (the closest point of its orbit to the Sun), and thus the loss is not attributable to solar energy-driven ice vaporization.
ex.zh: 小行星 6478 Gault 至少自 2013 年起经历间歇性质量流失；但与另一些反复流失质量的小行星不同，它并未在近日点（轨道上离太阳最近的点）流失质量，因此这种流失不能归因于太阳能量驱动的冰汽化。

senses.text: 使进展变慢或受阻（hinder local economic development 阻碍地方经济发展）
比 prevent 弱：只拖慢、不妨碍最终完成；名词 hindrance

ex.en: Nature reserves and other types of protected areas (PAs) are established to promote conservation, but because they restrict certain economic activities, it is widely believed that they hinder local economic development.
ex.zh: 自然保护区及其它类型的保护地旨在促进保育，但由于它们限制某些经济活动，人们普遍认为这会阻碍地方经济发展。

senses.text: 以证据证实（the hypothesis was validated 假设得到验证）
valid 有效的 → validate；名词 validation 验证、认可

ex.en: Not only was the hypothesis validated, there was also a clear indication of competitive advantage for birds.
ex.zh: 这一假设不仅得到了验证，还明确显示出鸟类具有竞争优势。

ex.src: 卷 2092 · Module M1 · Q5 · 补充语境
ex.en: In their study of European rollers, lesser grey shrikes, and 92 other passerine birds in Iran, researchers used mitochondrial sequences to validate established species boundaries.
ex.zh: 在研究伊朗的欧洲佛法僧、灰伯劳及其他 92 种雀形目鸟类时，研究者利用线粒体序列验证既有的物种边界。

senses.text: 横越、走过（This Traverse may the poorest take 这趟旅程最穷的人也走得起）
书面语，比 cross 更庄重；名词指「横越的路程」

ex.en: A frigate is a light, fast ship; coursers are swift horses. There is no Frigate like a Book To take us Lands away Nor any Coursers like a Page Of prancing Poetry—This Traverse may the poorest take Without oppress of Toll—How frugal is the Chariot That bears the Human soul.
ex.mark: This Traverse may the poorest take
ex.zh: 这趟旅程，最穷的人也走得起，无需缴纳路费。

senses.text: 反复出现的图形、主题（a comb-like motif 梳状图案）
艺术史指纹样，文学批评指「母题」；与 theme 相比更具体

ex.en: Guadalupe Romero Villanueva et al. conducted radiocarbon analysis of paint used in rock art at the Patagonian archaeological site Cueva Huenul 1, revealing that images of a comb-like motif date to as early as 8,000 years ago, predating other paintings in the region by several millennia.
ex.zh: Guadalupe Romero Villanueva 等人对巴塔哥尼亚考古遗址 Cueva Huenul 1 岩画所用颜料做了放射性碳分析，结果显示，梳状图案的图像早至 8000 年前，比该地区其它绘画早了好几千年。

ex.src: 卷 2080 · Module M2 · Q7 · 补充语境
ex.en: The motif may therefore have functioned to help preserve cultural knowledge during a time of ecological and demographic stress.
ex.zh: 因此，这一母题的功能可能在于：在生态与人口双重压力的时代，帮助保存文化知识。

senses.text: 物质由高浓度向低浓度散布（oxygen diffusion 氧的扩散）
（文化、技术）传播；形容词 diffuse 弥漫的、散漫的

ex.en: Myoglobin (Mb) is a protein that primarily aids in oxygen storage and diffusion across the mitochondrial membrane in cardiac muscle cells; these are necessary functions in aerobic organisms, including teleost fish.
ex.zh: 肌红蛋白是一种主要帮助心肌细胞储存氧并促使氧穿过线粒体膜的蛋白质；这些对有氧生物（包括硬骨鱼）而言都是必不可少的功能。

ex.src: 卷 2065 · Module M1 · Q12 · 补充语境
ex.en: Based on the data, the researchers concluded that for some teleost species, oxygen storage and diffusion may occur with negligible assistance from Mb.
ex.zh: 基于这些数据，研究者得出结论：对某些硬骨鱼类而言，氧气的储存与扩散几乎无需肌红蛋白协助。

senses.text: 依年代先后排列的（reverse chronological order 倒序）
chrono- 时间 + logical 学科的 → chronological；副词 chronologically

ex.en: However, it relates Edison's life in reverse chronological order, an unusual approach about which reviewer Derek Thompson said, "Nothing is gained by [it], and much comprehension is lost. "
ex.zh: 然而，这本书以倒序的方式讲述爱迪生的生平，这一不寻常的处理让评论者 Derek Thompson 说：「这样做一无所获，反倒让人失去很多理解。」

ex.src: 卷 2102 · Module M1 · Q10 · 补充语境
ex.en: Shurin’s volume is chronologically expansive, featuring such stories as Samuel R.
ex.zh: Shurin 的选集时间跨度极广，收录了 Samuel R. Delany 等人的作品。

senses.text: 与行政机构、规章程序相关的（bureaucratic initiatives 行政举措）
bureau 局 + -cracy 统治 → bureaucracy → bureaucratic；常含贬义「繁文缛节」

ex.en: … advocates of developmental-state theory hold that the formal enforcement of meritocratic hiring and other bureaucratic initiatives enable growth.
ex.zh: 发展型国家理论的拥护者主张，对公职人员个人敛财的法律约束以及其它行政举措，能够促成经济增长。

senses.text: 一组可据以辨识的成分数据（fecal-steroidal profiles 粪便甾醇谱）
土壤、沉积物的垂直截面（soil profiles 土壤剖面）
high-profile 高调的、受瞩目的（high-profile offenders 显要的违规者）

ex.en: By contrast, bison dung cannot be distinguished from elk dung based solely on their fecal-steroidal profiles, as both contain similar levels of beta-sitosterol and cholestanone, among other sterols.
ex.zh: 相比之下，仅凭粪便甾醇谱无法区分野牛粪与麋鹿粪，因为两者都含有相近水平的 β-谷甾醇与胆甾烷酮等甾醇。

ex.src: 卷 2092 · Module M2 · Q12 · 补充语境
ex.en: To explain the finding, they noted that many of the included studies didn't specify whether the reported soil profiles were those of the rhizosphere.
ex.zh: 为解释这一发现，他们指出：纳入的许多研究并未说明所报告的土壤剖面是否属于根际。

senses.text: irrespective of 不受…影响、与…无关
比 regardless 更正式；后必须接 of，不能单独使用

ex.en: Some ethicists hold that the moral goodness of an individual's actions depends solely on whether the actions themselves are good, irrespective of the context in which they are carried out.
ex.zh: 一些伦理学家认为，一个人行为的道德善恶只取决于行为本身是否良善，而与行为发生的具体情境无关。

senses.text: 质地粗、不细腻的（a coarse outer coat 粗硬的外层毛）
粗俗的（coarse language）；与 course（课程）同音易混

ex.en: Domestic sheep’s wild ancestor, the mouflon, has a coarse outer coat and an inner coat of wool fiber that is finer in diameter and therefore much softer.
ex.zh: 家羊的野生祖先欧洲盘羊，长有一层粗硬的外层毛，以及一层纤维直径更细、因而柔软得多的内层绒毛。

ex.src: 卷 2013 · Module M2 · Q10 · 补充语境
ex.en: The researchers concluded that variations in the landscape affect net CO₂, in ways that most models are too coarse to capture.
ex.zh: 研究者得出结论：地形变化会影响净二氧化碳通量，而多数模型过于粗放，难以捕捉这些影响。

senses.text: 水面或沙面被水流塑成的小脊状起伏（ripples 沙纹）
泛起波纹；（影响）扩散（ripple effect 连锁反应）

ex.en: Sazami (Ripples) is an important work of Nihonga, or classical Japanese painting.
ex.zh: 《Sazami》（《涟漪》）是日本画（Nihonga，即古典日本绘画）的重要作品。

ex.src: 卷 2105 · Module M1 · Q31 · 补充语境
ex.en: Ripples form in two main ways: from waves or from currents.
ex.zh: 波纹主要有两种成因：波浪或水流。

senses.text: 长时间地注视、思索（contemplate her devices 盘算她的手段）
比 think about 更带「凝神静观」的意味；contemplation 沉思

ex.en: Like many other simple‑hearted souls, it was her pet vanity to believe she was endowed with a talent for dark and mysterious diplomacy, and she loved to contemplate her most transparent devices as marvels of low cunning.
ex.mark: loved to contemplate her most transparent devices
ex.zh: 像许多心地单纯的人一样，她有一份得意的虚荣：相信自己天生擅长隐秘而深沉的权谋，还喜欢把自己那些一眼就能看穿的手段，当作精妙狡计的杰作来反复玩味。

ex.src: 卷 2035 · Module M2 · Q14 · 补充语境
ex.en: Architects dedicated to this approach carefully contemplate every aspect of their projects from location characteristics and initial materials selection to ultimate interior design choices and building installation.
ex.zh: 奉行这一理念的建筑师会仔细推敲项目的方方面面——从选址特点与最初的材料选择，到最终的室内设计决策与建筑安装。

senses.text: 居民众多的（the second-most populous continent 人口第二多的大洲）
popul- 人民 → populous；与 popular（受欢迎的）区分

ex.en: As the second-most populous continent in the world, Africa was home to an estimated 1.186 billion people in 2015.
ex.zh: 作为世界人口第二多的大洲，非洲在 2015 年约有 11.86 亿人口。

ex.src: 卷 2051 · Module M2 · Q21 · 补充语境
ex.en: In a US national election, one might expect major-party campaigns to focus on the most populous states.
ex.zh: 在美国全国大选中，人们或许以为两大党的竞选会把火力集中在人口最多的州。

senses.text: 司空见惯、毫无新奇之处的（the design is commonplace 设计平淡无奇）
老生常谈；与 extraordinary 相对

ex.en: … as its rootedness in commonplace craft traditions gives it an authenticity and accessibility that fine art …
ex.zh: 与此同时，若恰当看待，民艺与纯艺术是有区别的：它根植于寻常的工艺传统，因而具有一种纯艺术所无法企及的本真性与亲近感——纯艺术推崇的是精致与创新。

senses.text: 方向或关系相反的（an inverse relationship 反比关系）
invert 倒转 → inverse；in inverse proportion to 与…成反比

ex.en: Biologist Ari Martinez and colleagues, who studied the ecological community the species share, hypothesized that there is an inverse relationship between birds' field of vision while forageing and their sensitivity to alarm calls from neighboring species.
ex.zh: 生物学家 Ari Martinez 及同事研究了这些物种共享的生态群落，并假设鸟在觅食时的视野范围与其对邻近物种警报声的敏感度之间存在反比关系。

senses.text: 独自一人的状态（One Hundred Years of Solitude 《百年孤独》）
中性或褒义，指主动选择的清静；与 loneliness（孤独寂寞）不同

ex.en: It is associated with Gabriel García Márquez, whose One Hundred Years of Solitude is a key text.
ex.zh: 它与加夫列尔·加西亚·马尔克斯相关联，其《百年孤独》是这一脉络的关键文本。

ex.src: 卷 2019 · Module M2 · Q11 · 补充语境
ex.en: Scholars cite One Hundred Years of Solitude, the 1967 novel by Colombian author Gabriel Garcia Marquez, as a foundational text of magical realism, the Latin American style of fiction in which antirealistic plot devices—often borrowed from the spiritual and narrative traditions of Indigenous and colonial societies in the Americas—are deployed in an otherwise realistic mode of representation typical of the modern novel.
ex.zh: 学者们把哥伦比亚作家加西亚·马尔克斯 1967 年的《百年孤独》奉为魔幻现实主义的奠基之作——这一拉美小说风格在原本属于现代小说的现实主义叙事框架中，部署反现实的情节设计（常借自美洲原住民与殖民社会的灵性及叙事传统）。

senses.text: 讲述故事的民间歌曲（traditional ballads 传统歌谣）
与 lyric（抒情诗）相对：ballad 重叙事；音乐语境指慢板情歌

ex.en: Dolly Parton, who was born and raised in the region, was deeply influenced by these traditional ballads, as can be heard in the songs she wrote in the first decade of her career.
ex.zh: 多莉·帕顿出生并成长于该地区，深受这些传统歌谣影响——这一点在她职业生涯头十年所写的歌里可以听出来。

ex.src: 卷 2053 · Module M2 · Q7 · 补充语境
ex.en: The influence of the ballads of this region can be heard in the word choice and subject matter of the lyrics to “Jolene,” one of her best songs from this period.
ex.zh: 该地区民谣的影响可从她这一时期最好的歌曲之一《Jolene》歌词的遣词与题材中听出。

senses.text: 使指向某个方向（be oriented toward 朝向）
使适应、使熟悉环境（orient oneself）；名词 orientation 方向、定位

ex.en: University of California, Berkeley biologist Ciera Martinez and colleagues examined several species of grapevines and closely related plants, which have leaves that grow in pairs, to see if both leaves in a pair tend to be oriented toward the same side (that is. have more tissue on the same side) or not.
ex.mark: be oriented toward the same side
ex.zh: 加州大学伯克利分校生物学家 Ciera Martinez 及同事考察了数个葡萄属物种及近缘植物——它们的叶片成对生长——以弄清一对叶片是否倾向于朝向同一侧（即在同侧有更多组织）。

ex.src: 卷 2013 · Module M2 · Q8 · 补充语境
ex.en: The researchers recorded Yupno speakers explaining certain temporal words and phrases, such as abjuk, a present-oriented expression that translates to “now," and coded each speaker's manual gestures.
ex.zh: 研究者录下雅普诺语使用者解释特定时间词语（如面向当下的 abjuk，可译作「现在」）的过程，并对每位说话者的手势进行编码。

senses.text: 集中存放某类事物的地方（repositories of ecological information 生态信息的储存库）
知识库、资料库；同根 repository 亦指「可信赖的资料来源」

ex.en: Indigenous songs can be repositories of ecological information, from Yi songs about the natural environment to Tlingit songs about wildlife encounters.
ex.zh: 原住民歌曲可以是生态信息的储存库——从彝族关于自然环境的歌，到特林吉特人关于与野生动物相遇的歌。

senses.text: 言行有分寸、不张扬的（a discreet and agreeable fellow 谨慎而随和的人）
与 discrete（离散的、分开的）拼写近、意义完全不同，SAT 常考

ex.en: … and by his brother clergy he was regarded as a discreet and agreeable fellow.
ex.zh: 在同僚教士眼中，他是个谨慎而随和的人。

senses.text: 一个表演者或团体能演出的作品总集（a minstrel's repertoire book 吟游艺人的曲目本）
（某人的）全部技能、手段

ex.en: But according to professor James Wade, even more unusually, the three texts in the manuscript’s first booklet were likely copied by Richard Heege from a traveling minstrel’s repertoire book.
ex.zh: 但据 James Wade 教授说，更为不寻常的是，手稿第一个小册子里的三篇文本很可能是 Richard Heege 从一位流动吟游艺人的曲目本上抄录的。

ex.src: 卷 2054 · Module M2 · Q12 · 补充语境
ex.en: Recently, however, James Wade has argued that a manuscript collection compiled in the fifteenth century by Richard Heege contains three pieces likely copied from a repertoire book belonging to a minstrel working in the area around Heege’s home.
ex.zh: 然而 James Wade 近年主张：Richard Heege 在十五世纪汇编的一部抄本中，含有三件很可能抄自某位游吟艺人曲目簿的作品——该艺人活跃于 Heege 家乡附近。

senses.text: 制定、颁行（enact the Clean Air Act into law 将《清洁空气法》立法）
扮演、上演（enact a role）；名词 enactment 颁布

ex.en: But Nixon’s legacy is complex: he has been praised for his role in enacting the Clean Air Act into law, and he once made an attempt at reforming United States health care policy that is arguably a precursor to the Affordable Care Act, which became law during the Barack Obama administration.
ex.mark: enacting the Clean Air Act into law
ex.zh: 但尼克松的政治遗产是复杂的：人们称赞他把《清洁空气法》签署成法，他还曾尝试改革美国医疗保障政策，这可以说是《平价医疗法案》的前身——后者在奥巴马执政期间成为法律。

ex.src: 卷 2077 · Module M2 · Q13 · 补充语境
ex.en: In 2004, the US state of North Dakota enacted rate stability regulations (RSRs), constraining insurance companies’ latitude to raise premiums (the periodic fees policyholders pay to maintain insurance policies) after policies are in effect.
ex.zh: 2004 年，美国北达科他州颁布了费率稳定条款（RSR），限制保险公司在保单生效后上调保费（投保人为维持保单定期缴纳的费用）的自由度。

senses.text: 质量、状态逐渐变坏（evaporite deterioration 蒸发盐劣化）
deteriorate 恶化 → deterioration；比 damage 更强调渐进过程

ex.en: After five months in Earth air at 30%‑40% humidity (lower‑than‑average humidity for most nondesert Earth locations), a small sample of Leto material showed significant evaporite deterioration and new compound formation; after eight months in similar conditions, another sample experienced complete loss of sodium evaporites.
ex.zh: 在地球空气中以 30%–40% 的湿度（对地球多数非沙漠地区而言属偏低湿度）放置五个月后，一小份 Leto 材料样本出现明显的蒸发盐劣化与新生化合物；在类似条件下放置八个月后，另一份样本的钠蒸发盐则完全流失。

ex.src: 卷 2083 · Module M1 · Q9 · 补充语境
ex.en: Their measurements and observations revealed that quality of conditions during the concrete curing phase negatively correlates with gas permeability and that high gas permeability values are associated with increased deterioration as concrete surfaces age.
ex.zh: 他们的测量与观察显示：混凝土养护阶段的条件质量与气体渗透率呈负相关，而高气体渗透率伴随混凝土表面老化加剧的劣化。

senses.text: 并非有意地、因疏忽而造成（may have inadvertently excluded 可能无意中排除了）
in- 否定 + advertent 留意的 → inadvertently；形容词 inadvertent

ex.en: However, in a response paper, Jeff Ollerton et al. note that Rosas-Guerrero et al. may have inadvertently excluded studies published before the term “pollinator effectiveness” came into common use.
ex.zh: 然而，Jeff Ollerton 等人在一篇回应文章中指出，Rosas-Guerrero 等人可能无意中排除了在「传粉者效能」这一术语通行之前发表的研究。

ex.src: 卷 2028 · Module M2 · Q2 · 补充语境
ex.en: Those studying the works of William Ellery Channing, for instance, may inadvertently overlook nuances in his work by focusing only on the most obvious ways in which his style corresponds to transcendentalism.
ex.zh: 例如，研究 William Ellery Channing 的学者若只关注其风格与超验主义最明显的对应，就可能无意间忽略作品中的细微之处。

senses.text: 总是、在任何情况下都（were invariably necessary 无一例外都是必需的）
in- 否定 + variable 可变的 → invariable → invariably

ex.en: Olivia Rutigliano and other scholars cite a lack of nuance and erasure of intention in the implication that pseudonymous identities were invariably necessary due to social roles, appropriately contending that what may have been a constraint for some was an elective exercise in self-fashioning for others.
ex.zh: Olivia Rutigliano 等学者指出，那种认为笔名身份因社会角色而无一例外都属必需的说法缺乏细腻分辨，也抹去了（作者的）意图；他们恰当地主张，对某些人而言或许是束缚的东西，对另一些人而言则是自我塑造的自主实践。

senses.text: 与运动有关的（kinetic energy 动能）
kine- 运动 + -tic；与 potential energy（势能）相对

ex.src: 真题原句 · 同源片段
ex.en: … convert kinetic energy (resonance) to electrical energy …
ex.zh: 压电采集器把动能（共振）转化为电能。

senses.text: 直说真话、不加掩饰的（to be quite candid 老实说）
比 frank 更强调「不设防地坦白」；candid photograph 抓拍

ex.en: Are you entirely happy, now that you are at home again? PROFESSOR RUBEK: No—to be quite candid—perhaps not entirely happy—MAIA: (With animation.) There, you see!
ex.zh: 你现在回到家了，完全快乐吗？鲁贝克教授：不——老实说——也许并不完全快乐——玛雅：（兴奋地）你看！

senses.text: 加速化学反应而自身不被消耗的物质（chemical catalysts 化学催化剂）
促成变化的人或事件（a catalyst for change）

ex.en: These devices are silicon-based solar cells coated in chemical catalysts that activate reactions that split water molecules into hydrogen and oxygen gas.
ex.zh: 这些装置是硅基太阳能电池，表面覆有化学催化剂，可激活把水分子分解为氢气和氧气的反应。

senses.text: 各成员单位保留主权、松散联合的政治体（the present confederation 现行邦联）
与 federation（联邦）不同：邦联的中央权力更弱

ex.en: Though the authorship of most of the essays is certain, that of some is obscure: for instance, while No. 15, "The Insufficiency of the Present Confederation to Preserve the Union," was surely penned by Hamilton, No. 62, "The Senate," may have been written by either Hamilton or Madison.
ex.mark: The Insufficiency of the Present Confederation
ex.zh: 尽管大多数单篇论文的作者归属是确定的，少数几篇仍有疑问：例如第 15 篇《现行邦联不足以维系联邦》确为汉密尔顿所写，而第 62 篇《参议院》则可能出自汉密尔顿或麦迪逊之手。

ex.src: 卷 2026 · Module M2 · Q22 · 补充语境
ex.en: A loose confederation of cities from eleven modern-day countries, the Hanseatic League was a powerful mercantile alliance that dominated northern European trade between the 13th and 17th centuries.

senses.text: 拥护、信奉、倡导（理念、事业、观点）
拉丁 e-（向）+ spondere（承诺）→「对……立誓」——spouse（配偶）同根「立约之人」

kin: espousal — n. 拥护、支持
拼形警示 — expound v. 阐述（仅一字母之差，义完全不同）
近义 — advocate / embrace（抽象义）拥护

ex.en: The Bauhaus was an influential German art and design school; the school famously espoused the design principle of "form follows function."
ex.zh: 包豪斯是一所极具影响力的德国艺术设计学校，以奉行「形式追随功能」的设计原则而闻名。

ex.src: 卷 2096 · Module — · Q25 · 补充语境
ex.en: Philosophers espousing presentism (the view that only present things exist) must contend with the truth-maker objection (TO).
ex.zh: 信奉「现在主义」（认为只有当下存在之物才存在）的哲学家，必须直面「真值制造者」反驳。

senses.text: 怀抱志向追求更高目标（an aspiring poet 一位有抱负的诗人）
aspire to / after；名词 aspiration 志向；aspirational 向上流动的

ex.en: Miguel was an aspiring poet, and he had heard from his brother that the Ureña girls were none other than the daughters of Nicolás Ureña, and they were smart as clockwork.
ex.zh: 米格尔是个有志于诗的年轻人，他从哥哥那里听说，乌雷尼亚家的姑娘们正是尼古拉斯·乌雷尼亚的女儿，而且她们聪明得像钟表一样精准。

ex.src: 卷 2032 · Module M2 · Q9 · 补充语境
ex.en: The work aspires to be comprehensive by, for example, including accounts from cast and crew members of every Star Trek television series and film to date.
ex.zh: 这部作品力求全面：例如收录了迄今每一部《星际迷航》剧集与电影的演职人员的讲述。

senses.text: 难以找到、难以捉摸的（an elusive fungus 一种难觅的真菌）
与 illusive（虚幻的）易混；elude 躲避 → elusive

ex.en: Chorioactis geaster, a species of mushroom that makes a distinctive hissing sound when it releases its spores, is an elusive fungus that has been observed only in Texas and Oklahoma in the US and in the Miyazaki and Nara Prefectures in Japan.
ex.zh: Chorioactis geaster 是一种在释放孢子时会发出独特嘶嘶声的蘑菇，属难以寻觅的真菌，仅在美国得克萨斯与俄克拉何马，以及日本宫崎与奈良等地被观察到。

ex.src: 卷 2100 · Module M2 · Q15 · 补充语境
ex.en: Although oil shocks have occurred multiple times since 1945, a broadly applicable description of how oil shocks affect economies has proved elusive, a problem typically attributed to the fact that oil shocks’ effects are substantially conditioned on country-specific characteristics (oil import-export ratios, most importantly).
ex.zh: 尽管 1945 年以来石油危机已发生多次，但一个能广泛适用的「石油冲击如何影响经济」的描述却始终难产——问题通常被归因于：石油冲击的影响在很大程度上取决于各国具体特征（最重要的是石油进出口比）。

senses.text: 难以磨灭的、擦不掉的（印记、记忆）
in-（不）+ del（擦掉）+ -ible →「擦不掉的」——delete 同根

kin: indelibly — adv. 不可磨灭地
delete 家族 — delete v. 删除 / deletion n. 删除——词根 del「涂去」
近义 — permanent / enduring 持久的

ex.en: Karel Čapek's 1920 play R.U.R. (Rossum's Universal Robots), in which artificial workers overthrow their masters, left an indelible mark on the science fiction genre, and the English language, by introducing the term "robot" (derived from the Czech word robota, meaning "indentured labor" or "drudgery").
ex.zh: 卡雷尔·恰佩克 1920 年的剧作《罗素姆万能机器人》（剧中人造工人推翻了主人）给科幻类型乃至英语本身留下了一道难以磨灭的印记——它引入了「机器人」一词（源自捷克语 robota，意为「劳役」或「苦工」）。

senses.text: 流体旋转形成的漩涡（vortex size 涡的尺寸）
