比喻「漩涡般的处境」；复数 vortices

ex.en: Liao showed that as vortex size increases, pressure fluctuations at the snout increase for narrow-headed and intermediate-headed fish but remain low for wide-headed fish.
ex.zh: Liao 表明，随着涡的尺寸增大，窄头鱼与中头鱼吻部的压力波动会加剧，而宽头鱼则始终维持在较低水平。

ex.src: 卷 2102 · Module M2 · Q14 · 补充语境
ex.en: The Vortex is a 1924 satirical play by Noël Coward.
ex.zh: 《旋涡》是诺埃尔·科沃德 1924 年的讽刺剧。

senses.text: 以威慑使不敢做（deter cyclists from riding 使骑行者不敢上路）
强调「吓阻」而非物理阻挡；名词 deterrent 威慑物

ex.en: Their results suggest that poor street lighting can deter new or inexperienced cyclists from riding in a city but has little effect on experienced cyclists.
ex.zh: 他们的研究结果表明，路灯照明不佳会使新手或缺乏经验的骑行者不敢在城市骑行，但对有经验的骑行者影响甚微。

ex.src: 卷 2002 · Module M1 · Q28 · 补充语境
ex.en: This ranking deter mined the size of a ship’s crew: first-rate ships had between 850 and 875 crewmen, while lower-ranked ships had fewer.
ex.zh: 这一等级决定舰员规模：一级舰配备 850 至 875 名舰员，低等级舰则更少。

senses.text: 与陆地有关的（terrestrial farming 陆地农耕）
地球的（terrestrial planets 类地行星）；与 aquatic、celestial 相对

ex.en: In what is now southern Florida, the Calusa people (circa 1000–1600 CE) supported their relatively large population’s dietary needs with hydrological engineering rather than terrestrial farming methods.
ex.zh: 在今天佛罗里达南部一带，卡卢萨人（约公元 1000–1600 年）依靠水利工程而非陆地农耕方式，满足了其相对众多人口的饮食需求。

ex.src: 卷 2001 · Module M2 · Q15 · 补充语境
ex.en: Theropod dinosaurs, a diverse group of predators, ruled Earth's terrestrial ecosystem for over 160 million years, but their foraging ecology remains largely unknown.
ex.zh: 兽脚类恐龙——种类繁多的捕食者——统治地球陆地生态系统逾 1.6 亿年，但其觅食生态仍基本未知。

senses.text: 与生俱来、非习得的（innate neural structures 先天的神经结构）
与 acquired（后天习得）相对；innate immunity 先天免疫

ex.en: Modularity of mind is the notion that the mind is at least partly composed of innate neural structures (modules) that perform fast, necessary tasks.
ex.zh: 心智模块论认为，心智至少部分由先天的神经结构（模块）构成，这些模块执行快速而必要的任务。

ex.src: 卷 2077 · Module M2 · Q7 · 补充语境
ex.en: In their emphasis on the innate qualities of manufactured materials, both prints push traditional boundaries for figurative art.
ex.zh: 两幅版画都强调制成材料的固有特质，从而推动了具象艺术的传统边界。

senses.text: 多位作者作品的汇编（reflected in anthologies 在选集中有所体现）
antho- 花 + logy 收集 → anthology 原义「花环」

ex.en: This divide is reflected in anthologies: a large majority of prose poems in such collections are under half a page, though The Penguin Book of the Prose Poem (2018) includes a high proportion of longer works.
ex.zh: 这种分野在选集中有所体现：此类选本中的散文诗绝大多数不足半页，尽管《企鹅散文诗选集》（2018）收录了相当比例的长篇作品。

ex.src: 卷 2102 · Module M1 · Q10 · 补充语境
ex.en: Editor Jared Shurin’s enormous 2023 anthology The Big Book of Cyberpunk comprises 108 stories.
ex.zh: Jared Shurin 主编的巨型选集《赛博朋克大书》（2023）收录了 108 篇小说。

senses.text: 极度亢奋、忘我的欢愉（the daily ecstasy of its sun-kissed life 每日阳光照耀下的狂喜）
程度远强于 joy；形容词 ecstatic 欣喜若狂的

ex.en: My feelings seem to be those of our ancient earth in the daily ecstasy of its sun-kissed life; my own consciousness seems to stream through each blade of grass, each sucking root, to rise with the sap through the trees, to break out with joyous thrills in the waving fields of corn, in the rustling palm leaves.
ex.mark: the daily ecstasy of its sun-kissed life
ex.zh: 我的感受仿佛就是古老大地在日日阳光抚照的生命中那份狂喜；我的意识似乎流过每一片草叶、每一条吸水的根须，随树液升上树梢，在起伏的玉米田与沙沙作响的棕榈叶间迸发出欢欣的颤栗。

senses.text: 数量极多、难以计数（myriad pine-needles 无数松针）
可作名词（a myriad of）或形容词（myriad + 复数名词）

ex.en: The land-breeze blows down through the pines, resinous, fragrant, cold, bringing breath-like memories of dim, dark woods shaded by myriad pine-needles.
ex.zh: 陆风穿过松林吹来，带着松脂的气息，清冽而寒冷，唤起关于幽暗林地的朦胧记忆——那些林地被无数松针遮成一片阴翳。

ex.src: 卷 2058 · Module M1 · Q8 · 补充语境
ex.en: It's a term created by British and Portuguese colonizers to refer to the myriad spiced sauces with ties to the Indian subcontinent.
ex.zh: 该词由英国和葡萄牙殖民者创造，用来指称与印度次大陆有渊源的无数香辣酱料。

senses.text: 在时间上重合（a period coinciding with… 与…同时的时期）
（意见、利益）一致；名词 coincidence 巧合

ex.en: The motif was subsequently reproduced multiple times at the site over the next 3,000 years, a period coinciding with extremely arid conditions and slightly negative population growth.
ex.zh: 此后的 3,000 年里，这一母题在该遗址被反复重现——这段时期恰与极度干旱的气候条件以及略微负增长的人口相重合。

senses.text: 一个民族口耳相传的故事、信仰与习俗（juxtaposition with folklore 与民间传说的并置）
folk 民众 + lore 传说学问；folkloric 民俗的

ex.en: This style has exerted a decisive influence on authors around the world, including Orhan Pamuk, whose 2001 novel My Name is Red resembles classic magical realist novels in its juxtaposition of literary realism with folklore—namely, that of Turkey.
ex.mark: juxtaposition of literary realism with folklore
ex.zh: 这一风格对世界各地的作家产生了决定性影响，其中包括奥尔罕·帕慕克：他 2001 年的小说《我的名字叫红》把文学现实主义与民间传说（即土耳其的民间传说）并置，颇似经典的魔幻现实主义小说。

senses.text: 与天体运行有关的（astronomically aligned complexes 按天文方位排列的建筑群）
（数字）天文数字般的、极大的

ex.en: As Morales-Aguilar et al. have shown, developments at those earlier Mirador sites (e.g., the eight astronomically aligned complexes at El Mirador) were a historical precondition for the sophistication exhibited by the architects of later cities.
ex.zh: 正如 Morales-Aguilar 等人所表明，米拉多尔早期遗址的那些建设（例如埃尔米拉多尔八处按天文方位排列的建筑群）是后来的城市建设者得以展现其精巧技艺的历史前提。

ex.src: 卷 2032 · Module M1 · Q24 · 补充语境
ex.en: Minor planets are astronomical objects that orbit the Sun but are neither planets nor comets. .
ex.zh: 小行星是绕太阳运行、既非行星亦非彗星的天体。

senses.text: 受扰后能恢复原状的能力（more resilient to environmental shocks 对环境的冲击更具韧性）
re- 回 + silire 跳 → resilient；名词 resilience 韧性

ex.en: Although the increase in widgeon grass has been associated with a substantial increase in total seagrass coverage in the bay, researchers caution that the latter change does not necessarily make the seagrass ecosystem as a whole more resilient to environmental shocks.
ex.zh: 尽管宽叶眼子菜的增多与该湾海草总覆盖面积的大幅上升有关，研究者提醒，后一变化并不必然使整个海草生态系统对环境冲击更具韧性。

ex.src: 卷 2613 · Module RWM1 · Q16 · 补充语境
ex.en: In their study of ancient building materials, Stanford researchers used microscopic analysis and chemical testing to understand the ______ that made Maya lime plaster unusually resilient.

senses.text: 以某点为轴旋转（the beam pivots 横梁绕其转动）
枢轴、核心；v. 转向（pivot to a new strategy）

ex.en: The fulcrum is the point about which the beam pivots..
ex.zh: 支点就是横梁绕其转动的那个点。

senses.text: 被视为与某事物密不可分（now synonymous with the group's aesthetic 如今与该群体的美学画上等号）
同义的（synonymous with）；名词 synonym 同义词

ex.en: … imitated the technique accounts in part for the impressionistic qualities that are now synonymous with the group's shared aesthetic.
ex.zh: Hair 的许多追随者（包括 Isaac Knight）模仿了这一技法，这在一定程度上解释了如今与该群体共同美学画上等号的那种印象派气质。

senses.text: 陡峭处的边沿（bending upon the brink 在岸边弯垂）
on the brink of 濒临（崩溃、战争）

ex.en: The speaker is looking at the reflections of plants in a river. The little fern-leaf, bending Upon the brink, its green reflection greets,And kisses soft the shadow that it meets With touch so fine,The border line The keenest vision can’t define;So perfect is the blending.
ex.zh: 那片小小的蕨叶在岸边弯垂，它碧绿的倒影前来相迎，以极轻柔的触碰吻上所遇的影子；那交界之线，最锐利的目光也无法分辨——融合得如此完美。

ex.src: 卷 2002 · Module M1 · Q30 · 补充语境
ex.en: Pauline Johnson’s 2002 poem “Shadow Lake.”The little fern-leaf, bending Upon the brink, its green reflection greets,And kisses soft the shadow that it meets With touch so fine,The border line The keenest vision can’t define;So perfect is the blending.
ex.zh: Pauline Johnson 2002 年的诗作《影湖》。小小的蕨叶，俯身在岸边，迎接它绿色的倒影，轻柔地吻着它所遇见的影子——那触碰如此细微，那分界线连最锐利的目光也无法分辨；那融合是如此完美。

senses.text: 正式用语，指整体由若干部分组成（comprises some 1,200 languages 包括约 1200 种语言）
comprise 用主动式表「由…组成」，不用 be comprised of（正式文体视为误用）；与 compose / constitute 对比记忆

ex.src: 真题原句 · 语言学 passage
ex.en: The Austronesian language family comprises some 1,200 languages, including Minangkabau and Ilokano, which are spoken primarily in Indonesia and the Philippines.
ex.zh: 南岛语系包括约 1200 种语言，其中米南加保语和伊洛卡诺语主要通行于印度尼西亚和菲律宾。

senses.text: 以书写、艺术等方式把内心感受外化（expressive writing 表达性写作）
express 表达 → expressive；名词 expressiveness 表现力

kin: expression — 同词根构词变体，已并入本词条统一计数

ex.en: Techniques of positive expressive writing include one called "three good things," which involves writing down three good things that happen each day, and "resource diary," which involves writing about the resources one has available.
ex.zh: 积极的表达性写作技法中，有一种叫「三件好事」，即写下每天发生的三件好事；还有一种叫「资源日记」，即写下自己可支配的各种资源。

ex.src: 卷 2022 · Module M2 · Q12 · 补充语境
ex.en: However, such attempts have typically focused on spoken language despite the fact that some expressions in these languages appear only in songs.
ex.zh: 然而此类尝试通常只关注口语，尽管这些语言中的某些表达只出现在歌曲里。

senses.text: 质量中等、不出色的（a mediocre writing style 平庸的文风）
贬义偏强，含「本可以更好却只是将就」的意味

ex.en: Isaac Asimov, author of The Caves of Steel and The Stars, Like Dust, is highly regarded despite his mediocre writing style.
ex.zh: 艾萨克·阿西莫夫是《钢穴》与《星辰，如尘埃》的作者，尽管文风平庸，却备受推崇。

senses.text: 减轻（痛苦、拥堵等问题）（alleviate congestion 缓解拥堵）
只减轻不消除；与 mitigate 近义，alleviate 更常搭配 pain / congestion

ex.en: Many experts, like lawyer and cycling advocate Ernesto Hernandez-Lopez, have proposed bike travel as one possible way to alleviate congestion on the busy roadways of Los Angeles County California.
ex.zh: 许多专家——如律师兼骑行倡导者 Ernesto Hernandez-Lopez——提出，自行车出行是缓解加州洛杉矶县繁忙道路拥堵的一种可行方式。

ex.src: 卷 2076 · Module M2 · Q7 · 补充语境
ex.en: Hincapié found that one impediment is lack of knowledge about the practical details of how businesses are started; he further found that simply providing young adults with good informational resources on the topic significantly alleviates this problem.​​​​​​​
ex.zh: Hincapié 发现一个障碍是缺乏「企业如何创办」的实操细节知识；他进一步发现，只需为年轻人提供这方面优质的信息资源，就能显著缓解这一问题。

senses.text: 机构持有的长期捐赠资产（Lilly Endowment Inc. 礼来基金会）
天赋、禀赋（natural endowment）；动词 endow 捐赠、赋予

ex.en: While US public charities, like Habitat for Humanity International, must file Form 990 yearly with the IRS, private foundations, such as Lilly Endowment Inc., must file a different form, 990-PF.
ex.zh: 美国的公共慈善机构（如仁人家园国际）须每年向国税局提交 990 表，而私人基金会（如礼来基金会）则须提交另一种表格 990-PF。

senses.text: sufficient to invalidate how the basking shark has been categorized 足以推翻姥鲨以往的分类方式；研究类篇章里 ≈ overturn / refute（推翻既有结论或归类）
in-（否定）+ valid（有效的）+ -ate（动词后缀）；反义词 validate 使生效、证实

kin: invalidated — 过去分词作谓语 / 被动）
invalid — 同根形容词 · 无效的（an invalid argument）；另作名词「病弱者」，注意重音前移 /ˈɪnvəlɪd/

ex.src: 卷 2059 · Module M2 · Q8 · 正确选项原句
ex.en: It is, by itself, sufficient to invalidate how the basking shark has been categorized in the past.
ex.zh: 仅凭这一证据本身，就足以推翻（invalidate）姥鲨以往被归入的分类方式。

ex.src: 卷 2028 · Module M1 · Q9 · 选项原句 · 补充语境
ex.en: It has been largely invalidated by results obtained from similar studies.
ex.zh: 该结论已在很大程度上被同类研究得出的结果推翻。

senses.text: 因结局未定而产生的紧张期待（the suspense and drama 悬念与戏剧性
suspend 悬置 → suspense；形容词 suspenseful

ex.en: Clancy of the Mounted is a 1933 serial that, over its 12 episodes, kept its audience interested with the suspense and drama that are typical of the northern adventure genre.
ex.zh: 《Clancy of the Mounted》是 1933 年的一部系列片，在十二集里以北方冒险类型惯有的悬念与戏剧张力维持观众的兴趣。

ex.src: 卷 2068 · Module M1 · Q23 · 补充语境
ex.en: Every installment ended with a moment of unresolved suspense..
ex.zh: 每一集结尾都留下一刻悬而未决的悬念。

senses.text: 诉诸柔情怀旧的（the sentimental mode 感伤模式）
席勒美学中与 naive（素朴的）相对：一个描摹现实，一个追寻理想

ex.en: In his afterword to Crowley's book Little, Big, Bloom praises the novel's adroit blend of what playwright Friedrich Schiller termed the naive and sentimental modes—while Schiller thought works could be classified as either naive (seeking to describe reality) or sentimental (seeking to develop ideas), Little, Big demonstrates that a work can be both.
ex.zh: 在为克劳利《Little, Big》所写的后记中，布鲁姆称赞这部小说巧妙融合了剧作家席勒所称的「素朴」与「感伤」两种模式——席勒认为作品或属素朴（力求描摹现实），或属感伤（力求发展理念），而《Little, Big》证明一部作品可以两者兼具。

senses.text: 从反面来说（conversely, … 反之）
converse 相反的 → conversely；用于引出对称的另一面

ex.en: Conversely, Pascal, used in software development and educational instruction, is not an object-oriented language.
ex.zh: 相反，用于软件开发和教学编程的 Pascal 并不是面向对象的语言。

ex.src: 卷 2070 · Module M2 · Q10 · 补充语境
ex.en: Conversely, Percnostola rufifrons (the black-headed antbird), with which T. surinamus shares territory in French Guiana, practices foliage gleaning (picking insects off leaves), substantially limiting the bird’s field of vision while foraging.
ex.zh: 相反，与棕头蚁鸟共享法属圭亚那领地的黑头蚁鸟采取叶片拾取式觅食（从叶上啄取昆虫），觅食时视野受到极大限制。

senses.text: 在同一时刻发生的（scan for prey and predators simultaneously 同时搜寻猎物与天敌）
与 sequential（依次的）相对；副词 simultaneously

ex.en: The bird species Tachyphonus surinamus (the fulvous-crested tanager) practices a foraging strategy known as sallying (catching insects in flight and returning to a perch to eat them), enabling it to scan for prey and predators simultaneously.
ex.zh: 鸟类 Tachyphonus surinamus（黄冠唐纳雀）采用一种称为「突袭式觅食」的策略（在空中捕虫后返回栖枝进食），这使它能够同时搜寻猎物与天敌。

ex.src: 卷 2101 · Module M1 · Q5 · 补充语境
ex.en: While these films effectively reduce heat gain and improve energy efficiency in buildings with large windows, they simultaneously decrease natural light transmission.
ex.zh: 这些膜虽能有效减少热量增益、提升大窗建筑的能效，却也同时降低了自然采光。

senses.text: 河流及其支流汇水的地理范围（the lake's watershed 湖泊流域）
分水岭、转折点（a watershed moment）

ex.en: The relative levels of fecal zoostanols (steroids with animal origins), such as coprostanol and epi-coprostanol, in layers of lake bed sediments at Buffalo Ford Lake in Yellowstone National Park show that bison, elk, or both have been the dominant ungulate species in the lake’s watershed for at least the last 2,000 years.
ex.zh: 黄石国家公园布法罗福特湖湖底沉积层中，粪源动物甾醇（源自动物的类固醇，如粪甾醇与表粪甾醇）的相对含量表明，至少在过去两千年里，野牛、麋鹿或两者一直是该湖流域内的优势有蹄类物种。

ex.src: 卷 2074 · Module M2 · Q8 · 补充语境
ex.en: Although fecal-steroidal profile alone is not sufficient to distinguish between samples from bison and those from elk, the relative levels of zoostanols (steroids with animal origins), such as coprostanol and 24-ethyl-coprostanol, in sediments at Buffalo Ford Lake in Yellowstone National Park show that bison, elk, or both were the predominant ungulates in the lake's watershed for all strata of sediment examined, going as far back as 2,300 years.
ex.zh: 尽管仅凭粪甾醇不足以区分野牛与麋鹿的粪样，但黄石公园水牛湖沉积物中动物甾醇（如粪甾醇与 24-乙基粪甾醇）的相对水平表明：在所检测的全部沉积层（远至 2300 年前），野牛、麋鹿或两者一直是该湖流域占主导的有蹄类。

senses.text: 山峰高出周围地形的幅度（the summit's prominence 峰顶的相对高度）
显要、突出（come to prominence 崭露头角）

ex.en: But a summit's elevation may not be as good an indication of how high the mountain appears to observers as is the summit's prominence, or its height above its surroundings, and these values can differ significantly.
ex.zh: 但一座山峰的海拔，未必比其「相对高度」（即峰顶高出周围地形的幅度）更能说明它在观察者眼中看起来有多高，而这两个数值可能相差很大。

ex.src: 卷 2089 · Module M1 · Q5 · 补充语境
ex.en: The moon jar first gained prominence in Korea in the late seventeenth century.
ex.zh: 月亮罐于 17 世纪晚期在朝鲜首次获得显赫声名。

senses.text: 价值高到无法估量（be invaluable in determining 对确定…极为宝贵）
注意不是「无价值的」：in- 在此为强调，valuable 到无法计价

ex.en: The predictive model, which incorporates this algorithm, is sure to be invaluable in determining the optimal mix of a city's amenities.
ex.zh: 纳入这一算法的预测模型，在确定一座城市设施的最佳组合时必定极有价值。

ex.src: 卷 2611 · Module M1 · Q17 · 补充语境
ex.en: This interdisciplinary approach—integrating mathematical knowledge with artistic disciplines like fiber arts and ceramics—______ invaluable, enabling the team to create an immersive installation that neither group could have developed alone.

senses.text: 把观点条理分明地说出来（as it is articulated in… 正如…所阐述的）
口齿清晰、表达有力的（an articulate speaker）

ex.en: This phenomenon can be explained by the finite nature of cognitive capacity as it is articulated in Annie Lang's limited capacity model of motivated mediated message processing.
ex.zh: 这一现象可以用认知能力的有限性来解释，正如 Annie Lang 的「动机性媒介信息加工有限容量模型」所阐述的那样。

senses.text: 寡言、不轻易吐露心绪的态度（There was no hint of disapproval in her reserve 她的沉默里没有半点非难）——SAT 文学篇章高阶义，对应真题正确项 Constraint（克制）
为将来留存的数量（foreign currency reserves 外汇储备；petroleum reserves 石油储量；an ample reserve of stored energy 充足的储能）
reserved for… 专供、留给（reserved for use by the Kanaka Maoli）；Game Reserve / Nature Reserves （野生）保护区——地名性用法

kin: reserves — foreign currency reserves of emerging economies——外汇储备，与 722 emerging economies 同句）
reserved — 真题形态 · 3 次（be reserved for… 被留给 / 寡言的（a reserved person）——兼有「矜持」义，与原义相通）
reservation — 派生名词 · 真题 8 次：① 预约、预订 ② 保留意见（have reservations about…）；另指「（北美原住民）居留地」（the tribe's reservation）
reservoir — 近形异义词 · 水库 / 储层（geothermal reservoirs 地热储层）——词源同为 reservare，但已是独立词条，勿混
insurmountable — 同句复盘 · 548 insurmountable 与本词条共用同一 Ethan Frome 真题句：her reserve（她的沉默）+ an insurmountable reluctance（无法逾越的抗拒）——背一复习二

ex.en: There was no hint of disapproval in her reserve; I merely felt in her an insurmountable reluctance to speak of him.
ex.zh: 她的沉默（reserve）里没有半点非难的意味；我只是感觉到，她心中有一道无法逾越的屏障，令她不愿谈及他。

ex.src: 卷 2045 · Module M1 · Q11 · 补充语境
ex.en: Hawaiian home lands are areas of public land in the state of Hawaii that have been reserved for use by the Kanaka Maoli, or the Native Hawaiian people.
ex.zh: 夏威夷家园地是夏威夷州为卡纳卡毛利人（即夏威夷原住民）保留（reserved for）使用的公有土地。

senses.text: 与地震、地壳震动有关的（seismic data 地震数据）
影响深远的（seismic shift 剧变）；seismology 地震学

ex.en: Uisdean Nicholson and his team have discovered evidence in seismic data of a 40-kilometer-wide subsurface crater beneath nearly a kilometer of water off the coast of West Africa that is consistent with a 400-meter-wide asteroid striking the seafloor.
ex.zh: Uisdean Nicholson 及团队在西非近海近一千米深的水下，从地震数据中发现了证据：一个直径 40 公里的地下陨石坑，与一颗直径 400 米的小行星撞击海底的情形相符。

ex.src: 卷 2081 · Module M2 · Q1 · 补充语境
ex.en: The Apollo Moon landings (1969–1972) left charged particle detectors and seismic sensors on the Moon and produced large amounts of data.
ex.zh: 阿波罗登月计划（1969-1972）在月球上留下了带电粒子探测器和地震传感器，产出了海量数据。

senses.text: 森林中枝叶交叠的上层（beneath the tree canopy 在树冠之下）
华盖、天篷（great canopies of white cloud 大片白色云盖）

ex.en: While not everyone notices it, beneath the tree canopy of an ordinary city park lies an extraordinary web of life—fungus breaking down fallen leaves, native bees pollinating wildflowers, and moss growing in the crevices of an old log.
ex.zh: 尽管并非人人都注意到，在一座普通城市公园的树冠之下，藏着一张非凡的生命之网——真菌分解落叶，本土蜜蜂为野花传粉，苔藓在旧木的缝隙里生长。

ex.src: 卷 2086 · Module M1 · Q5 · 补充语境
ex.en: Toward noon it built up great canopies of white cloud that threw a cool shadow over fields and woods; then before sunset the clouds dissolved again, and the western light rained its unobstructed brightness on the valley.
ex.zh: 近午时分，天空垒起巨大的白云华盖，在田野与树林上投下清凉的影子；日落前云又消散，西天的光便毫无遮拦地把明亮洒进山谷。

senses.text: （权利、期限）届满而终止（a copyright expires 版权到期）
与 exhale（呼气）无关；expiration date 有效期至

ex.en: When a book's copyright expires, the book enters the public domain.
ex.zh: 当一本书的版权到期，该书即进入公有领域。

ex.src: 卷 2611 · Module M2A · Q25 · 补充语境
ex.en: When a book’s copyright expires, the book enters the public domain.

senses.text: 未经推理而直接形成的判断（if this intuition is correct 若这一直觉成立）
与 instinct（本能）不同：intuition 仍属认知层面，可被论证检验

ex.en: If this intuition is correct and we lack an inviolable duty to speak truthfully, what grounds opposition to lying in the first place?
ex.zh: 如果这一直觉是对的，而我们并没有必须说真话的绝对义务，那么反对说谎的依据究竟从何而来？

ex.src: 卷 2050 · Module M1 · Q27 · 补充语境
ex.en: Posada's “My art is a journey through the invisible realm—a space where intuition, memories, visions, and dreams are free to take visual form.”
ex.zh: 波萨达说：「我的艺术是一场穿越无形之境的旅程——在那里，直觉、记忆、幻象与梦，都可以自由地获得视觉形态。」

senses.text: 照原样再现某一做法或特征（replicating a feature of Buenos Aires 复制布宜诺斯艾利斯的某个特征）
科研语境指「重复实验」；名词 replication 重复验证

ex.en: Buenos Aires has high pedestrian traffic, but simply replicating a feature of Buenos Aires associated with walkability—e.g., its high concentration of shaded streets—may be insufficient to induce increased walking in other cities.
ex.mark: replicating a feature of Buenos Aires
ex.zh: 布宜诺斯艾利斯的步行人流很大，但仅仅复制它与适宜步行相关的一项特征——例如其高密度的遮荫街道——或许不足以促使其它城市的人增加步行。

ex.src: 卷 2064 · Module M1 · Q20 · 补充语境
ex.en: Leann Kanda, a researcher and sewing enthusiast, experimented with several techniques in her attempt to replicate the famous pleating of the Fortuny Delphos gown.
ex.zh: 研究者兼缝纫爱好者 Leann Kanda 为复现著名的福图尼德尔斐袍褶裥，尝试了多种技法。

senses.text: 在硬质材料上刻出图案（carved onto a printing block 刻在印版上）
carve out 开创、闯出（carve out a niche）

kin: carving — 同词根构词变体，已并入本词条统一计数

ex.en: Relief printing is a technique in which an image is carved onto a printing block, covered in ink or paint, and stamped onto paper.
ex.zh: 凸版印刷是一种把图像刻在印版上、涂上油墨或颜料、再压印到纸上的技法。

ex.src: 卷 2048 · Module M1 · Q1 · 补充语境
ex.en: In art class, his favorite hour of the week, he carves his name with paper clips into the bottoms of clay cups and bowls.
ex.zh: 在每周他最爱的一小时美术课上，他用回形针在陶杯陶碗的底部刻下自己的名字。

senses.text: 细部交错、结构复杂的（intricate patterns 繁复的纹样）
褒义偏多，强调精巧；名词 intricacy 错综复杂

ex.en: Inventories of excavation sites from the Alazani River valley and nearby areas dating from 4000 to 500 BCE show a steep drop occurring around 1500 BCE in the number of objects featuring gold filigree, an advanced technique in which fine threads of gold are arranged in intricate patterns.
ex.zh: 阿拉扎尼河谷及邻近地区公元前 4000 至 500 年的发掘遗址清单显示，公元前 1500 年左右，带金丝细工（一种把细金丝排成繁复纹样的高级工艺）的器物数量急剧下降。

ex.src: 卷 2025 · Module M2 · Q22 · 补充语境
ex.en: The ghazal, a poetic form originating in seventh-century Arabic poetry, has an intricate structure.
ex.zh: 加扎勒——源于七世纪阿拉伯诗歌的诗体——结构繁复。

senses.text: 流体不规则、紊乱的运动（general turbulence 一般湍流）
动荡（political turbulence）；形容词 turbulent

ex.en: Liao using models of three head shapes—narrow (low ratio of width to length), intermediate, and wide (high ratio of width to length)—showed that for medium-sized vortices, fish with wide heads would be least able to distinguish between vortices and general turbulence in the water.
ex.zh: Liao 用三种头型的模型（窄头、中等头、宽头，按宽长比划分）表明，对中等尺寸的涡而言，宽头鱼最难以区分水中的涡与一般湍流。

senses.text: 与某人相识的状态（my acquaintance with Mrs.… 我与…夫人的相识）
比 friend 疏远；make one's acquaintance 结识某人

ex.en: Yung Wing was the first American college graduate of Chinese heritage; Phoebe Brown was the first prominent female hymn writer in the United States. I look back upon my acquaintance with Mrs.
ex.zh: 我回顾自己与这位夫人的结识……

ex.src: 卷 2048 · Module M1 · Q8 · 补充语境
ex.en: Miguel was hoping not only to meet us but to make the acquaintance of the poet himself at Mamá's house.
ex.zh: 米格尔不仅盼着见到我们，还盼着在妈妈家与诗人本人结识。

senses.text: 植被繁密、生长旺盛的（lush tropical forests 茂密的热带森林）
（色彩、声音）浓郁丰富的；lush greenery 葱郁的草木

ex.en: Harold Newton’s Yellow Day, a wetland landscape with palm trees and lush greenery set against the pastel yellows and pinks of the sky and water, is typical of paintings by the mid-twentieth-century landscape artists now known as the Florida Highwaymen.
ex.zh: 一些艺术史学者认为，「公路客」画派在塑造该州至今仍存的公众印象方面起过作用：Black 及同事反复描绘的自然意象——茂密的热带森林、艳丽的落日——如今被视为佛罗里达的经典样貌。

ex.src: 卷 2000 · Module M2 · Q17 · 补充语境
ex.en: For example, the Puerto Rican municipality of Hatillo has also been called "the Land of Green Fields," a nickname that alludes to what the area is well known for: the lush greenery that surrounds it.
ex.zh: 再如，波多黎各的哈蒂约市也被称为「绿野之地」——这个别名暗指该地闻名之处：环绕四周的葱茏绿意。

senses.text: 存活时间的长短（the longevity of certain seeds 某些种子的寿命）
（事物）持久性；与 long 同源，longevity 更正式

ex.en: In 1879, in an effort to determine the longevity of certain seeds left in soil, botanist William Beal buried 20 glass bottles filled with sand and seeds from a variety of plants, including Verbascum, Amaranthus retroflexus, and Stellaria media.
ex.zh: 1879 年，为测定留在土壤中某些种子的寿命，植物学家 William Beal 埋下 20 只玻璃瓶，瓶中装有沙土以及毛蕊花、反枝苋、繁缕等多种植物的种子。

ex.src: 卷 2112 · Module M2 · Q16 · 补充语境
ex.en: Researchers studying solar cell longevity use mathematical models to predict operational lifespans under normal conditions.
ex.zh: 研究太阳能电池寿命的研究者用数学模型预测其在常规条件下的运行寿命。

senses.text: 引起、导致某种状态（sleep inducing 引人入睡）
与 cause 相比更偏「诱导出某种生理、心理反应」；名词 inducement 诱因

ex.en: In tomato plants, herbivory induces defensive production of jasmonic acid, while microbial infection induces defensive production of salicylic acid; plants also emit airborne chemicals to initiate the appropriate defense in nearby tomato plants.
ex.zh: 阿彼察邦把自己的电影形容为引人入睡，这或许会让人觉得它们让观众感到乏味；但乏味并不必然导致睡眠：当人没有一个能投注注意与兴趣的目标时，乏味带来的紧张反而可能引发焦虑，而非催人入睡。

ex.src: 卷 2053 · Module M2 · Q3 · 补充语境
ex.en: Thai slow-cinema director Apichatpong Weerasethakul (Uncle Boonmee Who Can Recall His Past Lives) even states that his own work induces sleep in audiences.
ex.zh: 泰国慢电影导演阿彼察邦（《能召回前世的布米叔叔》）甚至表示，他自己的作品会催观众入眠。

senses.text: 有争议地提出、坚持某一观点（contends that… 主张…）
比 argue 更带「与人争辩」的意味；contention 论点、争执

ex.en: Philosophers espousing presentism (the view that only present things exist) must contend with the truth-maker objection (TO). .
ex.zh: 信奉「现在主义」（认为只有当下存在的事物为真）的哲学家，必须应对「真理制造者」异议（truth-maker objection，TO）。

senses.text: 需要持续努力的重大活动（artistic endeavors 艺术事业）
比 attempt 更正式、更有分量；v. 努力做（endeavor to do）

ex.en: This characterization can be useful, but it also presents drawbacks in terms of how the work is perceived, given the high value placed on creativity and imagination in artistic endeavors.
ex.zh: 这种定性有其用处，但在作品如何被看待方面也带来弊端——毕竟在艺术事业中，创造力与想象力被赋予了很高的价值。

ex.src: 卷 2613 · Module RWM2H · Q19 · 补充语境
ex.en: The Euclid Space Telescope project has furthered this endeavor through both the increasing precision of its ______ and the vast scope of its observations, which have captured data from nearly 12 million celestial objects beyond our galaxy.

senses.text: 作为某事物的迹象（features indicative of live performance 表明现场表演的特征）
be indicative of 而非 indicative to；名词 indicator 指标

ex.en: Wade cites features of the texts indicative of live performance, such as politely addressing the audience, extensive use of simple rhyming (allowing for easy memorization), and requests for tips (payment) from listeners.
ex.zh: Wade 举出文本中表明现场表演的特征，例如礼貌地称呼观众、大量使用易于记诵的简单押韵，以及向听众索要赏钱。

ex.src: 卷 2612 · Module RW · Q117 · 补充语境
ex.en: In a 2021 study, however, Laura Nguyen and Dimitris Papadopoulos found that obsidian-object production methods at Petras stayed remarkably consistent during this architectural transition, which they interpret as indicative of local cultural continuity in the Middle and Late Bronze Ages.

senses.text: 可作多种解释、界限不清的（genre categories are ambiguous 类型划分模糊）
与 ambivalent（态度矛盾的）区分：前者指意义不明，后者指心里两难

ex.en: It is also unclear whether categorizing music by genre is useful, since genre categories are ambiguous, subjective, and simplistic.
ex.zh: 按类型为音乐分类是否有用也仍不清楚，因为类型划分本身模糊、主观而且过于简化。

ex.src: 卷 2099 · Module M2 · Q6 · 补充语境
ex.en: But his conflict with Sempringham Priory must be seen as an indirect result of a legally ambiguous property dispute involving land on which his manor sat: he was taking property that he seems to have sincerely believed was rightfully his.
ex.zh: 但他与塞普林厄姆修道院的冲突，须视为一场法律归属含糊的地产纠纷的间接结果：他取走的，似乎是他真心相信本属于自己的产业。

senses.text: 附着在表面（particles can adhere 颗粒能附着）
坚持、遵守（adhere to a rule）；名词 adhesion 黏附

ex.en: The team used three separate extraction methods: an ultrapure water rinse, a rinse combined with ultrasonic waves, and an alkaline solution treatment that removes epicuticular wax (a surface coating on most land plants to which particles can adhere).
ex.zh: 团队采用了三种分离提取方法：超纯水冲洗、超声波辅助冲洗，以及去除上表皮蜡质的碱性溶液处理——上表皮蜡质是多数陆生植物表面的涂层，颗粒可以附着其上。

ex.src: 卷 2076 · Module M1 · Q10 · 补充语境
ex.en: Wenhao Xu and colleagues demonstrated that applying a low direct current electrical field to graphite (a conductor) and an acrylamide (AAm) gel can increase how strongly materials adhere to each other.
ex.zh: Wenhao Xu 及同事证明：对石墨（导体）与丙烯酰胺凝胶施加低强度直流电场，可增强材料之间的黏合。

senses.text: 蛇、蝎等动物分泌的毒汁（scorpion venom 蝎毒）
恶毒、怨恨（speak with venom）；形容词 venomous 有毒的

ex.en: Scientists recently tested whether scorpion venom reduces the growth of bacteria.
ex.zh: 科学家最近检验了蝎毒是否能抑制细菌的生长。

ex.src: 卷 2075 · Module M2 · Q18 · 补充语境
ex.en: The statement “all tarantulas are venomous” is scientific because it could be proved false by a single observation to the contrary, according to Karl Popper.
ex.zh: 按照卡尔·波普尔的观点，「所有狼蛛都有毒」这一陈述是科学的，因为一次相反的观察即可将其证伪。

senses.text: 居住于某环境中（dwelling in sediment 栖息于沉积物中）
dwell on 反复思量；dwelling 住所

ex.en: In a 2021 paper, Joanna Wolfe and team note that many decarcinized groups are extinct and have very few living relatives—signs that decarcinization might be an “evolutionary dead-end.” But the team also discusses frog crabs, a living decarcinized group with traits suited to dwelling in sediment; fossils show that the group had decarcinized members as far back as the Early Cretaceous.
ex.zh: 在 2021 年的一篇论文中，Joanna Wolfe 及团队指出，许多「去蟹化」类群已经灭绝、现存近亲极少——这表明去蟹化可能是一条「演化死胡同」。但团队也讨论了蛙蟹：这是一个现存的去蟹化类群，其性状适于栖息在沉积物中；化石显示，该群体早在白垩纪早期就有去蟹化成员。

ex.src: 卷 2108 · Module M2 · Q27 · 补充语境
ex.en: Mug House is an Ancestral Puebloan dwelling site located in southwestern Colorado. ·It was built under a rock overhang and inhabited from approximately 1160-1290 CE. ·The overhanging rock ledges offered protection from heavy rain and snow.
ex.zh: 马克杯屋是位于科罗拉多西南部的祖先普韦布洛人居住遗址。它建于岩石挑檐之下，约于公元 1160 至 1290 年间有人居住。悬挑的岩檐可遮挡暴雨与积雪。

senses.text: 行为离奇、不合常规的（other eccentric figures 其它古怪角色）
比 strange 更带「无伤大雅的怪癖」意味；名词 eccentricity

ex.en: While Tove Jansson accomplished a great deal as a painter and cartoonist, she became widely popular as the creator of the Moomin characters she is still best remembered for today—Moomintroll, Groke, and other eccentric figures.
ex.zh: 托芙·扬松作为画家和漫画家成就斐然，但真正让她广受欢迎的，是她创造的姆明角色——姆明特罗尔、格罗克等一众古怪人物，至今人们记得最牢的仍是这些。

senses.text: 衬托主体的景物（against the backdrop of shimmering water 以粼粼水面为背景）
（事件的）大背景（against the backdrop of anxiety 在焦虑的背景下）

ex.en: … enacted against a backdrop of anxiety about social dynamism, were intended to limit aspirational overreaching for status but were infrequently enforced.
ex.zh: 一幅河景：单株棕榈的剪影衬在粼粼水光与明亮月夜的背景之上。

senses.text: 构成整体的各个部分（other atmospheric constituents 其它大气成分）
构成的；选区选民（constituents）

ex.en: The ratio of methane to other atmospheric constituents—represented by a measure called the methane mole fraction—influences a variety of meteorological phenomena, notably precipitation and humidity.
ex.zh: 甲烷与其它大气成分的比例——用一种称为「甲烷摩尔分数」的量来表示——会影响多种气象现象，尤其是降水与湿度。

ex.src: 卷 2084 · Module M2 · Q11 · 补充语境
ex.en: Direct contact with constituents via such means as public events and emails from voters is a major source of politicians’ beliefs about their constituents’ views, but it is susceptible to a selection effect.
ex.zh: 通过公开活动和选民来信等方式与选民直接接触，是政客了解选民观点的主要渠道，但它容易受选择效应影响。

senses.text: 研究美与艺术本质的哲学分支（the philosophy of aesthetics 美学哲学）
（作品、空间的）审美风格；形容词 aesthetic 审美的

ex.en: The ancient Greek concept of “mimesis,” a term used in the works of Plato, Aristotle, and other Greek philosophers in discussions of representational art—visual, performance, or literary art that aims to depict the real world—is a foundational concept of the Western philosophy of aesthetics.
ex.zh: 古希腊的「摹仿」（mimesis）概念——柏拉图、亚里士多德等希腊哲学家在讨论再现性艺术（旨在描绘现实世界的视觉、表演或文学艺术）时使用的术语——是西方美学哲学的基础概念。

ex.src: 卷 2077 · Module M2 · Q11 · 补充语境
ex.en: They argue that aesthetics often outweigh fidelity to the past among designers for shows with historical settings.
ex.zh: 他们主张：在设计历史题材剧集的布景时，美学考量常常压倒对历史的忠实。

senses.text: 可拉伸、可容纳变动的（elastic enough to include 弹性大到足以纳入）
（概念、规则）灵活可变的；名词 elasticity 弹性

ex.en: This style is elastic enough to include Namasenda, who incorporates hip-hop rhythms into the hyperpop sound, as well.
ex.zh: 这一风格的包容度足够大，甚至可以把 Namasenda 也纳入其中——她把嘻哈节奏融进了 hyperpop 的声响。

senses.text: 牧师在礼拜中宣讲的宗教训诫（the sermon is a sound of words 布道是诉诸听觉的言语）
长篇说教；动词 sermonize 说教

ex.en: The sermon is a sound of words spoken to the ear, and prepared only for present meditation and extends no farther than the strength of memory can convey it …
ex.mark: The sermon is a sound of words
ex.zh: 布道是诉诸听觉的言语，只为当下的默想而准备，其效力不超过记忆所能承载的范围；而印成的书是一种记录，留在每个人手中，随时可以与他的记忆重新结识，也随时可以被拿出来，作为他据以立论的权威或凭据，并把内容传向此后世世代代，直到作者已被遗忘于坟墓之中的漫长时光。

senses.text: 承认自身局限、不自我夸大的品质（intellectual humility 智识上的谦逊）
humility 是美德，humiliation 是羞辱，二者不可混用

ex.en: Some psychologists such as Elena Park are conducting projects that are meant to foster intellectual humility (the ability to realize that one is wrong and to publicly admit it) among scientific researchers.
ex.zh: 一些心理学家（如 Elena Park）正在开展项目，意在培养科研人员的智识谦逊（即意识到自己可能出错，并公开承认这一点）。

ex.src: 卷 2017 · Module M1 · Q13 · 补充语境
ex.en: Jia Hu and colleagues hypothesized that workplace leaders who reflect on lessons learned from past mistakes are likely to exhibit more humility than leaders who don't engage in such reflection.
ex.zh: Jia Hu 及同事假设：会反思过往错误教训的职场领导者，比不做这种反思的领导者表现出更多谦逊。

senses.text: 事物发展变化的路径（the evolutionary trajectory 演化轨迹）
抛射体的弹道；引申为「发展走向」

ex.en: Susette Castaneda-Rico and colleagues relied on historical DNA (hDNA)—genomic data incidentally preserved in specimens housed in natural history collections—to investigate the evolutionary trajectory of Peromyscus mekisturus (a rodent species).
ex.zh: Susette Castaneda-Rico 及同事借助历史 DNA（hDNA）——即偶然保存在自然史收藏标本中的基因组数据——来研究一种啮齿类动物 Peromyscus mekisturus 的演化轨迹。

ex.src: 卷 2033 · Module M1 · Q12 · 补充语境
ex.en: Beatrice Ehmann and her colleagues showed that this difference in life trajectory is reflected in the diets of immature orangutans, with females' diets overlapping more with their mothers' diets than males' diets do.
ex.zh: Beatrice Ehmann 及同事证明：这种生命轨迹的差异体现在未成年猩猩的饮食上——雌性的饮食与母亲的饮食重叠度高于雄性。

senses.text: 地势高而平坦的大片区域（the Adamawa plateau 阿达马瓦高原）
（发展后的）停滞期、平台期（reach a plateau）

ex.en: However, excavation of multiple sites on the Adamawa plateau in Central Africa conducted by Étienne Zangato and Augustin Holl uncovered evidence of iron workshops that may have been in operation as late as 900–750 BCE in Gbabari and as early as 2300–1900 BCE in Ôboui and Gbatoro.
ex.zh: 然而，Étienne Zangato 与 Augustin Holl 在非洲中部阿达马瓦高原多处遗址的发掘，发现了炼铁作坊的证据：Gbabari 的作坊可能晚至公元前 900–750 年仍在运作，而 Ôboui 与 Gbatoro 的作坊早至公元前 2300–1900 年。

senses.text: 设想出来、未必真实的（hypothetical questions 假设性问题）
hypothesis 假设 → hypothetical；与 actual、empirical 相对

ex.en: These hypothetical spacetime tunnels are known as wormholes..
ex.zh: 1979 年，丹尼尔·卡尼曼与阿莫斯·特沃斯基向来自以色列、瑞典和美国的师生提出了一系列涉及财务决策的假设性问题。

senses.text: 数量迅速增多（macroalgal proliferation 大型藻类的大量增殖）
proliferate 增殖 → proliferation；核不扩散即 non-proliferation

ex.en: Pace found that those concentrations did not negatively correlate with macroalgal proliferation.
ex.zh: Pace 发现，这些浓度与大型藻类的增殖并无负相关。

ex.src: 卷 2111 · Module M1 · Q21 · 补充语境
ex.en: During the Tournaisian, an age spanning 346.7 to 358.9 million years ago, Earth underwent many significant geologic and evolutionary changesit experienced not only glaciation in East Gondwana but also the proliferation oflarge lycopodian trees.
ex.zh: 在杜内期（约 3.467 至 3.589 亿年前），地球经历了诸多重大地质与演化变化——既有东冈瓦纳的冰川作用，也有大型石松树的繁衍。

senses.text: 坚定地主张、声明（asserting that… 断言…）
语气强于 claim；assert oneself 坚持自我主张

ex.en: A fall 1838 entry in one of Darwin’s notebooks mentions species’ struggle for survival in a world of insufficient resources “as inference from Malthus,” referring to a 1798 essay by economist Thomas Malthus asserting that population growth will outpace agricultural production.
ex.zh: 达尔文一本笔记中 1838 年秋的一则条目提到，物种在资源不足的世界中为生存而竞争，是「从马尔萨斯推演而来」——指的是经济学家托马斯·马尔萨斯 1798 年的一篇文章，该文断言人口增长将超过农业生产。

ex.src: 卷 2085 · Module M2 · Q14 · 补充语境
ex.en: Citing the discovery of grinding equipment dating as far back as 5,000 ya consistent with processing of plant foods, some researchers have asserted that the Bantu expansion can be explained by the farming/language dispersal hypothesis.
ex.zh: 一些研究者援引早至 5000 年前、与植物性食物加工相符的研磨设备，主张班图扩张可用「农耕/语言扩散假说」解释。

senses.text: 逐项计数、记录（recognize and tally time references 识别并统计时间指称）
计数、 tally with 与…相符

ex.en: The researchers drew this conclusion from an analysis of more than 50,000 novels spanning many centuries and cultures, using software to recognize and tally both specific time references—that is, clock phrases, such as 7 a.m. or 2:30 p.m.—and implied ones, such as mentions of meals typically associated with a particular time of day.
ex.zh: 研究者从跨越数百年与多种文化的五万多部小说中得出这一结论：他们用软件识别并统计明确的时间指称（即时钟表述，如 7 a.m. 或 2:30 p.m.）与隐含的时间指称（如提及通常与某个时段相关联的餐食）。

senses.text: 包裹尸体的布；引申为覆盖、遮蔽之物（the other shroud, night 另一重裹尸布——夜）
笼罩、掩盖（shrouded in mystery）

kin: shrouded — 同词根构词变体，已并入本词条统一计数

ex.en: In the text, Molloy has arrived at the town ramparts, an elevated walkway atop the city walls.And having cleared the ramparts I had to confess the sky was clearing, prior to its winding in the other shroud, night.
ex.zh: 莫洛伊已来到小镇的城墙边，那是城墙顶上的一条高架步道。而翻过城墙之后，我不得不承认天色正在转晴，随后又被另一重裹尸布——夜——收拢。

senses.text: 地壳之下的一层（the underlying mantle 下伏地幔）
覆盖物、披风；take on the mantle of 承继…的衣钵

ex.en: Early Earth is thought to have been characterized by a stagnant lid tectonic regime, in which the upper lithosphere (the outer rocky layer) was essentially immobile and there was no interaction between the lithosphere and the underlying mantle.
ex.zh: 一般认为，早期地球以「停滞盖层」构造体制为特征：那时上部的岩石圈（外层岩石层）基本不动，岩石圈与下伏地幔之间也没有物质交换。

ex.src: 卷 2093 · Module M2 · Q13 · 补充语境
ex.en: Ratios below 0.710 suggest more material from the mantle in the magma, while ratios increasing above that number usually indicate greater proportions of material from the continental crust.
ex.zh: 比值低于 0.710 提示岩浆中地幔物质较多，而高于该数值通常指示大陆地壳物质占比更大。

senses.text: 高温加热用的设备（storage containers or furnaces 储罐或炉具）
酷热之地；炼钢语境 blast furnace 高炉

ex.en: Austenitic stainless steel has two subtypes: the 200 series, often used for washing machines, and the 300 series, which has more nickel than the 200 series and is often used for storage containers or furnaces.
ex.zh: 奥氏体不锈钢有两个亚类：200 系常用于洗衣机，300 系含镍量高于 200 系，常用于储罐或炉具。

ex.src: 卷 2087 · Module M2 · Q17 · 补充语境
ex.en: The furnaces used in ancient China to produce glazed tiles reached heights of 150 feet and diameters of 24 feet.
ex.zh: 中国古代生产琉璃瓦的窑炉高达 150 英尺，直径达 24 英尺。

senses.text: 环境本身的（ambient water temperature 周围水温）
ambient noise 环境噪声、ambient light 环境光；名词 ambience 氛围

ex.en: The blue shark and the striped marlin are ectothermic (cold-blooded) fish, whereas the salmon shark and the Pacific bluefin tuna are regional endotherms—they retain metabolic heat resulting in body temperatures above the ambient water temperature.
ex.zh: 蓝鲨与条纹枪鱼是外温（冷血）鱼类，而鲑鲨与太平洋蓝鳍金枪鱼属区域性内温动物——它们能保留代谢产生的热量，使体温高于周围水温。

ex.src: 卷 2080 · Module M2 · Q9 · 补充语境
ex.en: Mushrooms, including Coprinellus micaceus and species from the genus Cantharellus, are known to use the process of evapotranspiration to maintain internal temperatures below ambient temperatures.
ex.zh: 包括晶盖鬼伞和鸡油菌属物种在内的蘑菇，已知会利用蒸腾过程使体内温度维持在低于环境温度的水平。

senses.text: 文学、历史、哲学等（arts and humanities 艺术与人文学科）
与 sciences 相对；humanity 单数指「人性、人类」

ex.en: But some medical program educators are skeptical, questioning if arts and humanities experiences can be clearly shown to have any worthwhile advantages for their students.
ex.zh: 但一些医学项目的教育者持怀疑态度，质疑艺术与人文学科的经历能否被清楚证明对学生有任何值得肯定的益处。

ex.src: 卷 2111 · Module M1 · Q15 · 补充语境
ex.en: To strengthen the evidence base in support of incorporating humanities into the coursework for medical students, then,.

senses.text: 与时间相关的（temporal distinctions 时间上的区分）
与 temporary（暂时的）不同；temporal lobe 颞叶

ex.en: Previous research has found evidence of Spanish speakers referring to the left /right axis to describe events in time, and many researchers believe that this tendency to make temporal distinctions along imagined linear axes is universal.
ex.zh: 此前的研究已发现，西班牙语使用者会用「前／后」轴来描述时间中的事件，许多研究者相信，这种沿想象中的线性轴作时间区分（即时间上的区分）的倾向具有普遍性。

ex.src: 卷 2078 · Module M2 · Q1 · 补充语境
ex.en: As Rafael Núñez and colleagues have recently shown, the Yupno language contains many temporal expressions, such as usa-don sonda, which translates to “next week.”
ex.zh: 正如 Rafael Núñez 及同事近期所示，雅普诺语包含许多时间表达，如可译作「下周」的 usa-don sonda。

senses.text: 歌曲的文字部分（the lyrics as Rainey and Smith sang them 雷尼与史密斯所唱的歌词）
抒情的；lyric poetry 抒情诗

ex.en: Davis's work was particularly labor intensive because in order to transcribe, or write down, the lyrics as Rainey and Smith sang them, Davis had to listen repeatedly to the vinyl recordings, which weren't very clear.
ex.zh: 戴维斯的工作格外费力，因为要把雷尼与史密斯所唱的歌词逐字记下，她必须反复聆听那些音质并不清晰的唱片。

ex.src: 卷 2065 · Module M1 · Q24 · 补充语境
ex.en: The media outlet NPR has described her music as having an “acoustic guitar-driven groove and lyrics celebrating self-confidence.” .
ex.zh: 美国国家公共广播电台（NPR）形容她的音乐「以原声吉他驱动的律动，配以赞颂自信的歌词」。

senses.text: 作者讲述自己一生的作品（Frederick Douglass's autobiography 道格拉斯的自传）
与 biography（他人所写传记）、memoir（回忆录，侧重特定经历）区分

ex.en: This line is from Frederick Douglass's autobiography Narrative of the Life of Frederick Douglass, an American Slave.
ex.zh: 这句话出自弗雷德里克·道格拉斯的自传《一个美国奴隶的生平叙事》。

senses.text: 不移动的（a stationary bike 固定式健身车）
与 stationery（文具）同音异义，SAT 常见拼写陷阱

ex.en: Nicole Trewick and team tested their prediction that positive feedback would produce analogous results among participants cycling on a stationary bike in a virtual reality environment.
ex.zh: Nicole Trewick 及团队检验了他们的预测：正反馈会在虚拟现实环境中骑固定式健身车的参与者身上产生类似结果。

ex.src: 卷 2034 · Module M2 · Q9 · 补充语境
ex.en: Inventively, sea otters use stationary anvil stones to break open mollusk shells.
ex.zh: 海獭别出心裁地使用固定的砧石砸开软体动物的壳。

senses.text: 诗歌、歌曲中反复出现的句子（the common refrain 常见的反复句）
v. refrain from 克制不做；与 restrain（抑制他人）区分

ex.en: … the common refrain “say what I am called” invites a verbalized response; and the conflation of many of the riddles’speakers with their solutions (typically animals …
ex.zh: 反复出现的「说出我叫什么」邀请对方口头作答；而许多谜语的说者与其谜底（通常是动物、器物或自然现象）相重合，则暗示一种戏剧性的扮演，或许意在公共聚会中取乐。

senses.text: 不足、欠缺之处（remedy this deficiency 弥补这一缺失）
与 deficit（赤字、逆差）不同：deficiency 指「缺少应有之物」

ex.en: According to an arts journalist, later in his career as a renowned curator and art historian, Enwezor sought to remedy this deficiency, not by focusing solely on modern African artists, but by showing how their work fits into the larger context of global modern art and art history.
ex.zh: 恩韦佐试图弥补这一缺失，办法并不是只聚焦于现代非洲艺术家。

senses.text: 支撑建筑的立柱（massive sandstone pillars 巨大的砂岩柱）
支柱、中坚（a pillar of the community）

ex.en: At five-thirty the old Panhandle bridge, supported by massive sandstone pillars, stalwart, as when erected fifty years before to serve a generation now passed behind the portals of life, had become a spectral outline against the sky.
ex.zh: 五点半时，那座由巨大砂岩柱支撑的老潘汉德尔桥依旧如五十年前初建时那般坚固，在天空下只剩一道幽灵般的轮廓——它当年是为一代人而建，而那一代人如今已跨过生命之门。

ex.src: 卷 2031 · Module M1 · Q8 · 补充语境
ex.en: He gestured to the lamassus [sculptures] and pillars surrounding us.
ex.zh: 他指了指我们四周的拉玛苏（神兽雕像）与石柱。

senses.text: 水流、风力对地表或结构的磨蚀（wave erosion 波浪侵蚀）
（权利、价值）逐渐削弱；动词 erode

ex.en: Adelaide, Australia, has installed engineered structures along 53% of its shoreline to protect infrastructure from wave erosion and other hazards, a practice known as shoreline hardening.
ex.zh: 澳大利亚阿德莱德在 53% 的海岸线上修建了工程结构，以保护基础设施免受波浪侵蚀及其它危害，这种做法被称为海岸硬化。

ex.src: 卷 2063 · Module M1 · Q4 · 补充语境
ex.en: For example, the tree roots would have greatly reduced soil erosion, and the accumulated twigs the trees shed likely created new habitats for animal life.
ex.zh: 例如，树木根系本可大幅减少土壤侵蚀，落下的枯枝也本可能为动物创造新的栖息地。

senses.text: 从别处衍生而来、缺乏原创的（entirely derivative of 完全从…派生）
艺术评论中含贬义「模仿他人的」；金融语境指「衍生品」

ex.en: Mimesis is typically translated as “imitation” in modern editions of ancient Greek texts, but scholar Stephen Halliwell warns that this is overly reductive: “imitation” implies that art merely copies—and is thus by definition entirely derivative of—a reality that exists outside and prior to the work of art, and translating “mimesis” thusly obscures the multifaceted ways in which the ancient Greeks understood the relationship between art and reality.
ex.zh: 「摹仿」在现代校本的希腊文古籍中通常译为 imitation，但学者 Stephen Halliwell 提醒说，这过于简化：「模仿」暗示艺术只是复制，因而在定义上完全派生自作品之外、先于作品存在的现实；这样翻译会遮蔽古希腊人理解艺术与现实关系时的多重面向。

ex.src: 卷 2071 · Module M2 · Q11 · 补充语境
ex.en: Dong Liu et al. investigated the fracture toughness (both the initiation and propagation toughness) of the HEA CrMnFeCoNi and its MEA derivative CrCoNi and concluded that the alloys’ toughness performance differs from that of most HEAs and MEAs.

senses.text: 引发情感或意义上的应和（adds powerful resonance 增添强烈的共鸣）
物理共振；形容词 resonant 引起共鸣的

ex.en: Her approach adds powerful resonance to films that explore the highly personal experiences of place and home, and often the difficult decision to stay or leave.
ex.zh: 她的处理方式为那些探讨地方与家园的切身经验、以及「留下还是离开」这一艰难抉择的影片，增添了强烈的共鸣。

ex.src: 卷 2016 · Module M2 · Q4 · 补充语境
ex.en: It is the link of shared humanity with the artists across so many centuries that gives the Lascaux Cave paintings such resonance.
ex.zh: 正是与跨越许多世纪的艺术家之间共享的人性纽带，赋予了拉斯科洞穴壁画如此深长的共鸣。

senses.text: 修士聚居修行的场所（a monastery near his manor 他庄园附近的修道院）
与 priory（小修道院）、abbey（大修道院）层级不同

ex.en: Most infamously, he participated in what was essentially a private war against Sempringham Priory, a monastery near his manor, even making off with 500 pounds' worth of monastery property during a raid.
ex.zh: 最为人诟病的是，他参与了一场实质上针对森普林厄姆小修道院的私战——那是他庄园附近的一座修道院——甚至在一次袭击中掠走了价值 500 英镑的修道院财产。

senses.text: 强大到令人不敢轻慢的（his formidable technique 他令人叹服的技术）
既可形容对手「难对付」，也可形容能力「高超得令人敬畏」

ex.en: Although he is indebted to the European tradition of figurative painting, with its proportionality of human form and depth between foreground and background, Anishinaabe painter Daniel Ashkewe uses his formidable technique to portray—and thereby ensure the transmission of—cultural traditions predating the European colonization of the lands of his tribe.
ex.zh: 尽管他受惠于欧洲具象绘画传统——那种讲究人体比例与前景背景纵深感的传统——阿尼什纳贝画家 Daniel Ashkewe 却以令人叹服的技术描绘了早于欧洲殖民其部族土地的种种文化传统，并借此确保它们得以传承。

senses.text: 因罕见、陌生而引人兴趣的特质（interested in the novelty of the ship 对这艘船的新奇感兴趣）
新奇的事物；形容词 novel 新颖的

ex.en: Adam, seeing that the old man was interested in the novelty of the ship, suggested that he should stay the night on board, and that he would himself be ready to start at any hour and go anywhere that the other suggested.
ex.zh: 亚当见老人对这艘船的新奇之处颇感兴趣，便提议他在船上过夜，并说自己随时都准备出发，去对方想去的任何地方。

ex.src: 卷 2102 · Module M1 · Q1 · 补充语境
ex.en: After you have stayed a week and the bloom of novelty has rubbed off you wonder if you can accommodate yourself to the peculiar conditions.
ex.zh: 住满一周、新奇的光泽磨掉之后，你就会开始怀疑自己能否适应这里的种种特殊境况。

senses.text: 认真而真诚的（very earnestly wish 恳切地希望）
与 Ernest（人名）同音；in earnest 认真地

ex.en: For instance, Perry contends that some of Waugh’s earliest works, notably his biography of artist Dante Gabriel Rossetti, exhibit the earnest romanticism that would characterize Waugh’s later fiction.
ex.zh: 例如，Perry 主张：Waugh 最早的一些作品——尤其是他为画家 Dante Gabriel Rossetti 所作的传记——已展现出那种日后成为其小说特征的真挚浪漫主义。

senses.text: 以力量制止、使无法发展（suppress domestic production 压制国内生产）
抑制（情绪、免疫反应）；名词 suppression

ex.en: Eliminating tariffs can lead to an influx of cheaper imported goods, lowering prices; in a place where domestic production is relatively expensive, this influx can suppress domestic production, as the country’s consumers favor more cheaply produced imported goods over domestically produced ones.
ex.zh: 这种大量涌入会压制国内生产，因为该国消费者更青睐价格更低的进口商品，而非本国产品。

ex.src: 卷 2063 · Module M2 · Q14 · 补充语境
ex.en: As observed in a 2011 study by Emilio García-Robledo and Alfonso Corzo, macroalgal proliferation may have a suppressive effect on the abundance of cyanobacteria and other microphytobenthos (MPB)—chlorophyll-producing microbes inhabiting marine sediment—in part by reducing the amount of sunlight available to MPB.

senses.text: 交通、通道堵塞（traffic congestion 交通拥堵）
充血的；动词 congest 使堵塞

ex.en: In a college course on urban affairs, a student asserts that traffic congestion in the United States increased between 1990 and 2000 mostly in and around very large cities such as Philadelphia, Pennsylvania.
ex.zh: 在一门城市事务课程中，一名学生断言，1990 至 2000 年间，美国的交通拥堵主要发生在费城等特大城市及其周边。

ex.src: 卷 2103 · Module M2E · Q13 · 补充语境
ex.en: In response to this challenge and others, such as the increasing congestion of roadways, delivery companies are continually looking for ways to make last-mile delivery more efficient.
ex.zh: 为应对这一挑战及道路日益拥堵等其他难题，快递公司不断寻找让末端配送更高效的办法。

senses.text: 覆盖物、遮蔽之物（swathed in some soft veil 裹在一层轻柔的面纱里）
遮掩（veiled criticism 含蓄的批评）

ex.en: And like a spirit, swathed in some soft veil,Steals twilight and its shadow's o'er the swale.
ex.zh: 荒僻的潟湖里，野稻丛中，蜥蜴以单调的声调嘶鸣。归巢的大雁寻觅着可栖身之处，那里芦苇生长、渗水的苔藓附着。迟归的鹤振着沉重的翅膀、懒懒地飞，随夜色临近而滑入寂静。而黄昏像个幽灵，裹在一层轻柔的面纱里，携着它的影子悄悄爬过那片低洼的草地。莎草静卧，雾气漫起，浓重、灰白而潮湿，沼泽已入眠。

senses.text: 某种事物开始盛行的时点（the advent of online streaming 在线流媒体的出现）
比 appearance 更强调「划时代的到来」；Advent 大写指基督降临节

ex.en: The advent of online streaming has led many music listeners to drift away from ownership of music (through downloads or through physical media such as compact discs) in favor of the streaming services You Tube Music and Accu Radio, among others.
ex.zh: 在线流媒体的出现，使许多音乐听众不再追求「拥有」音乐（通过下载或光盘等实体媒介），转而使用 YouTube Music、Accu Radio 等流媒体服务。

senses.text: 色彩明亮强烈的（vibrantly blue head plumage 亮蓝色的头部羽毛）
（城市、文化）生机勃勃的；名词 vibrancy

ex.en: As juveniles, all white-necked jacobin hummingbirds display vibrantly blue head plumage; when they enter adulthood, males retain these blue feathers and most females molt to a drab green hue.
ex.zh: 所有白颈雅各宾蜂鸟在幼年时都长着亮蓝色的头部羽毛；进入成年后，雄性保留这些蓝色羽毛，而多数雌性则换羽为暗哑的绿色。

ex.src: 卷 2105 · Module M2H · Q35 · 补充语境
ex.en: Chemists investigating the properties of coal tar in the mid-nineteenth century discovered compounds that led to the creation of vibrant artificial colorants.
ex.zh: 十九世纪中叶研究煤焦油性质的化学家发现了一些化合物，催生了鲜艳的人工色素。

senses.text: 为推动社会或政治变革而采取的行动（political activism 政治行动主义）
active 积极的 → activism；environmental activism 环保行动

ex.en: Imani Jacqueline Brown is an artist who blends scientific research, political activism, and various media in her work.
ex.zh: 伊玛尼·杰奎琳·布朗是一位艺术家，她的创作融合了科学研究、政治行动主义与多种媒介。

senses.text: 事物本身存在的不足（these defects are partly remediable 这些缺陷部分可补救）
与 flaw 近义；动词 defect 意为「叛逃」，读音变为 /dɪˈfekt/

ex.en: This information is necessary so that the electrician can begin figuring out whether the continued outage is caused by a defective device or simply by too many devices running at the same time.
ex.zh: 这些缺陷部分可以补救，甚至并不构成对字面真实的绝对违背。

ex.src: 卷 2611 · Module M2A · Q19 · 补充语境
ex.en: A defect density, customer satisfaction; and B defect density, customer satisfaction and, C defect density, customer satisfaction, and D defect density; customer satisfaction, and Located in western Germany, Eifel National Park is a Dark Sky Park, a type of natural area recognized by DarkSky International.

senses.text: 产生预期效果的能力（test the efficacy of the model 检验模型的效力）
与 efficiency（效率）不同：efficacy 问「有没有用」，efficiency 问「省不省」

ex.en: Researchers used anonymized location data from the US and Côte d’Ivoire to document people’s daily patterns of mobility, using these results to test the efficacy of the researchers’ predictive computer model.
ex.zh: 研究者使用来自美国与科特迪瓦的匿名位置数据，记录人们日常的出行模式，并用这些结果检验其预测性计算机模型的效力。

ex.src: 卷 2071 · Module M1 · Q27 · 补充语境
ex.en: The workshop advised mariners to avoid orcas pending further testing of the efficacy of TAST, a harmless acoustic deterrent.
ex.zh: 研讨会建议船员在进一步验证无害声学威慑装置 TAST 的效力之前，避让虎鲸。

senses.text: 与剧场、舞台演出相关的（theatrical costume design 戏剧服装设计）
夸张做作的（a theatrical gesture）

ex.en: In a research paper about theatrical costume design, a student argues that costume designers for modern productions of Shakespeare's A Midsummer Night's Dream (set in ancient Greece) sometimes include such elements unintentionally.
ex.zh: 在一篇关于戏剧服装设计的论文中，一名学生主张，为莎士比亚《仲夏夜之梦》（背景设定在古希腊）的现代演出设计服装的设计师，有时会无意间纳入这类元素。

senses.text: 使（资产、船只）困住无法脱身（the potential for stranding 资产搁浅的可能性）
股、缕；（论述的）一条线索

ex.en: The significance to investors of the potential for stranding is evident, and companies ought to disclose such risks to them, but it is no less important to ensure that when unsustainable companies involved in petroleum distribution cease operations, those companies' employees are assisted in their transitions to other jobs.
ex.zh: 资产搁浅的可能性对投资者的重要性显而易见，企业应当向他们披露此类风险；但同样重要的是，要确保当参与石油销售的不可持续企业停止运营时，这些企业的员工能在转岗中获得帮助。

ex.src: 卷 2070 · Module M2 · Q6 · 补充语境
ex.en: Wang and colleagues excluded all pathways other than the CMN by using barriers to keep the plants’ root systems separate while allowing mycorrhizal strands through—an essential step He and colleagues’ study did not take. Text 2Wang and colleagues took the necessary precaution of separating the plants’ root systems (thereby excluding root-to-root transmission).
ex.zh: Wang 及同事用屏障隔开各株植物的根系、只放行菌根菌丝，从而排除了菌根网络之外的一切路径——这是 He 等人的研究未采取的关键步骤。——Wang 等人采取了必要预防措施：分离植物根系（从而排除根间直接传导）。

senses.text: 日常饮食中不可或缺的基本食物（a staple in their diet 他们饮食中的主食）
主要的、基本的（staple crops 主要作物）

ex.en: Kwakwaka'wakw song keeper Kwaxsistalla Wathl'thla aided research by ethnobiologist Dana Lepofsky et al. by contributing songs that reference creating terraced intertidal gardens to foster the healthy development of clams, a staple in the Kwakwaka'wakw people's diet.
ex.mark: a staple in the Kwakwaka'wakw people's diet
ex.zh: 夸夸嘉夸族的歌者 Kwaxsistalla Wathl'thla 为民族生物学家 Dana Lepofsky 等人的研究提供了帮助，贡献了提到修建潮间带梯田式园圃、以促进蛤蜊健康生长的歌曲——蛤蜊是该族饮食中的主食。

ex.src: 卷 2099 · Module M1 · Q10 · 补充语境
ex.en: Signs of his incompetence were evident on his front door: the nameplate hung crookedly, and the hasp didn’t quite meet its staple.
ex.zh: 他不称职的迹象在自家前门就可见一斑：铭牌挂歪了，搭扣与扣鼻也没对齐。

senses.text: 水果压榨后的浆状物（acerola pulp 针叶樱桃果浆）
纸浆；（通俗低劣的）庸俗作品 pulp fiction

ex.en: Recent advancements in ohmic heating were made through research in Brazil on the preservation of acerola pulp.
ex.zh: 欧姆加热技术近来的进展，来自巴西关于针叶樱桃果浆保存的研究。

senses.text: 能长期保存、不易损坏的（durable historical artifacts 耐久的历史器物）
与 lasting 近义；durable goods 耐用品

ex.en: She ties this hypothesis to the high value the sea snails would have had for the Calusa, both nutritionally and as a building material (conch shells are highly durable).
ex.zh: 她把这一假说与海螺对卡卢萨人（Calusa）的高价值联系起来——既作为食物，也作为建筑材料（海螺壳非常耐用）。

ex.src: 卷 2066 · Module M2 · Q11 · 补充语境
ex.en: Being coarser than Merino wool overall, Navajo-Churro wool yields a more durable yarn, which Diné (Navajo) weavers use in their celebrated rugs.
ex.zh: 纳瓦霍-丘罗羊毛整体比美利奴羊毛粗，纺出的纱线更耐用，迪内（纳瓦霍）织工正是用它织出著名的地毯。

senses.text: economy 的复数在此不指「多种经济」，而指「多个经济体（国家 / 地区）」——emerging economies 新兴经济体，即快速增长的发展中市场（真题语境：外汇储备变动研究）
economic 经济上的（adj.）≠ economical 节约的（adj.）；economy 单数 = 经济 / 节约（economy of scale 规模经济）

kin: emerging — 现在分词作定语 · 新兴的、正在崛起的（emerging technologies / emerging field 真题亦现）
economy → economies — 复数义变考点：国家经济体系（economies of East Asia）；「节约」义则不可数

ex.en: Investigating whether herding also occurs among nations in matters of economic policy, Maru Etta-Nkwelle examined changes in the foreign currency reserves of emerging economies in various world regions in the years following the widespread financial crisis of 1997.
ex.zh: 为考察羊群效应是否也发生在各国的经济政策层面，Maru Etta-Nkwelle 研究了 1997 年金融危机全面爆发后数年间，世界各地区新兴经济体（emerging economies）的外汇储备变动。

senses.text: 结构严密、论证严格的（a more rigorous structure 更严谨的结构）
褒义；名词 rigor 严格、严酷

ex.en: Economist Thomas Piketty’s book Capital in the Twenty-First Century has a more rigorous structure than its sequel, Capital and Ideology.
ex.zh: 经济学家托马斯·皮凯蒂的《二十一世纪资本论》结构比其续作《资本与意识形态》更为严谨。

senses.text: 生物或行为上的可辨识特点（a male trait 雄性特征）
遗传学、心理学常用；与 characteristic 近义但更偏「可遗传、可测量」

ex.en: They claim that the historical mischaracterization of birdsong as a male trait is largely the result of bias: much of the research ornithologists have carried out has been near universities in the temperate northern hemisphere, where female birdsong is less common than it is in the tropics.
ex.zh: 他们主张，把鸟鸣历史性地误认为雄性特征，很大程度上是偏见的产物：鸟类学家开展的许多研究都在北半球温带的大学附近进行，而那里的雌鸟鸣叫远不如热带常见。

ex.src: 卷 2025 · Module M2 · Q14 · 补充语境
ex.en: Researchers conducted a meta-analysis of studies of how such noise affects animals and found that, for every study, relevant traits or behaviors of the animals were observably different between the exposed group and the otherwise similar but unexposed group.
ex.zh: 研究者对「此类噪声如何影响动物」的研究做了一项元分析，发现每项研究中暴露组与条件相似但未暴露的对照组相比，动物的相关性状或行为都存在可观察的差异。

senses.text: 外来物种扩散并造成危害的（invasive species 入侵物种）
侵入性的（invasive surgery 微创/侵入性手术）

ex.en: However, like many highly specialized species, the kiwikiu is particularly vulnerable to environmental stressors, such as disease, invasive species, and habitat destruction, that disrupt the delicately balanced ecosystems in which the birds live.
ex.zh: 然而，像许多高度特化的物种一样，kiwikiu 特别容易受到环境压力的冲击，例如疾病、入侵物种与栖息地破坏——这些都会扰乱鸟类所赖以生存的精细平衡的生态系统。

ex.src: 卷 2018 · Module M2 · Q15 · 补充语境
ex.en: But researchers Alejandro Camacho and Jason Mc Lachlan have pointed out that "invasive" and "native" are labels that describe temporary circumstances.
ex.zh: 但研究者 Alejandro Camacho 与 Jason Mc Lachlan 指出：「入侵」与「本土」只是描述暂时状态的标签。

senses.text: 力求如实再现现实的创作方法（magical realism 魔幻现实主义）
与 romanticism（浪漫主义）相对；magical realism 是拉美文学标志性流派

ex.en: Scholars cite The Kingdom of This World, the 1949 novel by Cuban author Alejo Carpentier, as a foundational test of magical realism, the Lation American style of fiction in which antirealistic plot devices—often borrowed from the folkloric traditions of Indigenous and colonial societies in the Americas—are deployed in an otherwise realistic mode of representation typical of the modern novel.
ex.zh: 学者们把古巴作家阿莱霍·卡彭铁尔 1949 年的小说《这个世界的王国》视为魔幻现实主义的奠基性试验——这一拉美小说风格在原本属于现代小说典型的写实再现模式中，嵌入了反现实的叙事手法（多借自美洲原住民与殖民社会的民间传说传统）。

ex.src: 卷 2026 · Module M2 · Q13 · 补充语境
ex.en: This style has exerted a decisive influence on authors around the world, including Orhan Pamuk, whose 2001 novel My Name ls Red resembles classic magical realist novels in its juxtaposition of literary realism with folklore namely, that of Turkey.
ex.zh: 这一风格对世界各地的作家都产生了决定性影响，其中包括奥尔罕·帕慕克——他 2001 年的《我的名字叫红》把文学现实主义与民间传说（即土耳其的民俗）并置，酷似经典的魔幻现实主义小说。

senses.text: 用作比较基准的初始数值（pretraining baselines 训练前的基线）
（项目的）基准线；baseline data 基线数据

ex.en: Persad and her colleagues concluded that concentration of precipitation into fewer events would result in a higher number of dry days, triggering more irrigation, but that this change in irrigation output is highly sensitive to the baseline concentration of precipitation that currently exists in an area.
ex.zh: 这一研究文献受困于假设不清、样本量不足、缺少对照组，以及未能为所测的参与者属性建立训练前的基线。

ex.src: 卷 2612 · Module RW · Q84 · 补充语境
ex.en: This research literature is plagued by unclear hypotheses, insufficient sample sizes, a lack of control groups, and failures to establish pretraining baselines for the measured attributes of participants.

senses.text: 按时间顺序记述的历史（a three-volume chronicle 三卷本编年史）
记录、记述（chronicle the decline 记录衰落过程）

ex.en: Edmund Morris, noted for his three-volume chronicle of the life of Theodore Roosevelt, completed Edison, his biography of Thomas Edison, in 2019.
ex.zh: 以三卷本西奥多·罗斯福传记闻名的埃德蒙·莫里斯，于 2019 年完成了他那部托马斯·爱迪生传记《Edison》。

ex.src: 卷 2027 · Module M1 · Q8 · 补充语境
ex.en: Siemowit appears in the Gesta principum Polonorum, a chronicle of medieval Polish history written between 1112 and 1118.
ex.zh: 谢莫维特见于《波兰君公事迹》——一部写于 1112 至 1118 年间的中世纪波兰编年史。

senses.text: 使裂开、破碎（the lithosphere is fractured into plates 岩石圈断裂成板块）
骨折；（社会）分裂；形容词 fractured

ex.en: Researchers investigated the timing of the transition from a stagnant lid regime to a tectonic plate regime, in which the lithosphere is fractured into dynamic plates that in turn allow lithospheric and mantle material to mix.
ex.zh: 研究者考察了从「停滞盖层」体制向「板块构造」体制转变的时间——在后者中，岩石圈断裂成动态的板块，从而使岩石圈物质与地幔物质得以混合。

ex.src: 卷 2071 · Module M2 · Q11 · 补充语境
ex.en: HEAs and MEAs are known for withstanding cracking at extremely low (cryogenic) temperatures relatively well, though their fracture toughness generally falls as temperature does.
ex.zh: 高熵合金与中熵合金以在极低（低温）温度下相对不易开裂著称，尽管其断裂韧性通常随温度下降而降低。

senses.text: 被关在人工环境中的（captive chimpanzees 圈养的黑猩猩）
俘虏；captive audience 不得不听/看的受众

ex.en: Among studies of nonhuman primates, James Welles's 1976 study of captive chimpanzees and catarrhine monkeys reported more right-handed individuals than left-handed ones, but William C.
ex.zh: 在非人灵长类研究中，James Welles 1976 年对圈养黑猩猩与狭鼻猴的研究报告称，右利手的个体多于左利手，但 William C.……

senses.text: 基层司法官员（judges or magistrates 法官或治安官）
英国指基层治安法官，美国指较低审级的司法官员

ex.en: A report from an international organization that monitors the numbers of women serving as judges or magistrates on various nations’ highest courts, such as the Supreme court in Finland and the Supreme Court in the Dominican republic.
ex.zh: 一份来自某国际组织的报告，监测了各国最高法院（如芬兰最高法院与多米尼加共和国最高法院）中担任法官或地方法官的女性人数。

ex.src: 卷 2611 · Module M2A · Q12 · 补充语境
ex.en: For instance, the number of women judges and magistrates on high courts in ______

senses.text: 发展过程中的重大节点（the album Milestones 专辑《Milestones》）
路边的里程标石；引申为「标志性事件」

ex.en: Known for the albums Someday My Prince Will Come and Milestones, jazz trumpeter Miles Davis collaborated several times with pianist Gil Evans.
ex.zh: 爵士小号手迈尔斯·戴维斯以《Someday My Prince Will Come》与《Milestones》等专辑闻名，曾多次与钢琴家 Gil Evans 合作。

senses.text: 拥有地方自治权的行政区（the Puerto Rican municipality of Hatillo 波多黎各的阿蒂约市）
municipal 市政的 → municipality；municipal government 市政府

ex.en: Huazalingo is a municipality in the state of Hidalgo, Mexico.
ex.zh: 例如，波多黎各的阿蒂约市也被称为「绿野之地」，这个别称点出了该地区的著名之处：环绕四周的葱郁草木。

ex.src: 卷 2027 · Module M1 · Q24 · 补充语境
ex.en: In 2015, geologist Peter Rogerson calculated that the geographic center of Oklahoma was a point 4.4 miles south of the municipality of Edmond.
ex.zh: 2015 年，地质学家 Peter Rogerson 计算出俄克拉何马州的地理中心位于埃德蒙市以南 4.4 英里处。

senses.text: 未经指令、自然发生的（spontaneous laughs 自发的笑）
与 volitional（有意的）对照；名词 spontaneity 自发性

ex.en: Study participants from 21 societies, including those in Austria and Turkey, listened to randomized recordings of 18 spontaneous laughs taken from natural conversations between pairs of women and 18 volitional laughs produced separately by 18 different women in response to an experimenter's instruction to laugh.
ex.zh: 来自 21 个社会（包括奥地利与土耳其）的研究参与者，听了一批随机排序的录音：18 段取自两名女性自然对话中的自发笑声，以及另外 18 名女性按实验者指令发出的有意笑声。

ex.src: 卷 2007 · Module M1 · Q5 · 补充语境
ex.en: When classical pianist Martha Argerich performs, it appears as if the music is coming to her spontaneously.
ex.zh: 古典钢琴家玛塔·阿格里奇演奏时，音乐仿佛是自她心中即兴涌现。

senses.text: 阻碍顺畅进行的阻力（cognitive friction 认知摩擦）
人际、组织间的摩擦；动词 frictional

ex.en: One reason is that exact prices may create greater cognitive friction during purchase decisions than do whole-number prices or prices easily rounded to whole numbers (e.g., $5.99, which is little different from $6).
ex.zh: 原因之一是：与整数价格或易于取整的价格（例如 5.99 美元，与 6 美元相差无几）相比，精确价格在购买决策中可能带来更大的认知摩擦。

ex.src: 卷 2069 · Module M1 · Q8 · 补充语境
ex.en: Using carbon nanotubes and oil, Jun Qu and colleagues at a US Department of Energy lab have created a coating for moving parts that reduces friction to the point where it is almost nonexistent.
ex.zh: Jun Qu 及其美国能源部实验室的同事利用碳纳米管和油，为运动部件研制出一种涂层，把摩擦减低到几乎不复存在。

senses.text: 树木或植物的全部叶子（the foliage of the oaks 橡树的叶丛）
foliage gleaning 叶面拾取：鸟类从叶面啄食昆虫的觅食方式

ex.en: Conversely, Myrmotherula guttata (the rufous-bellied antwren), with which M. fusca shares territory in French Guiana, practices foliage gleaning (picking insects off leaves), substantially limiting the bird’s field of vision while foraging.
ex.zh: 相反，Myrmotherula guttata（红腹蚁鸟）——在法属圭亚那与 M. fusca 共享领地——采用「叶面拾取」（从叶片上啄食昆虫）的方式觅食，这大大限制了该鸟觅食时的视野。

ex.src: 卷 2058 · Module M1 · Q3 · 补充语境
ex.en: The wood I walk in on this mild May day, with the young yellow-brown foliage of the oaks between me and the blue sky, the white star-flowers and the blue-eyed speedwell and the ground ivy at my feet, is one of those happy spots where the soul may sit and hold silent converse with itself.

senses.text: 写在页面空白处的（marginal notes 页边批注）
边缘的、微小的（marginal change 微小变化）

ex.en: In some domestic breeds, such as the Spanish Merino, the outer fiber is only marginally coarser than the inner, and the wool is soft overall.
ex.zh: 在一些家养品种中，例如西班牙美利奴羊，外层纤维只比内层略粗一些，羊毛整体柔软。

ex.src: 卷 2109 · Module M2 · Q15 · 补充语境
ex.en: Support for the argument that a " onsumer rewohlutiom, in which possession ofconsumer goods among an increasingly wide range ofsociceconomic goups surged despite only marginal wage growith, oecurred in Engand between 1600 and 1750has largely hinged on scholars analyses of peobate inventorles (detalled legal records ofdeceased persons' possesions).
ex.zh: 「1600 至 1750 年间英格兰发生过一场『消费革命』——工资仅微涨而拥有消费品的社会群体却大为拓宽」这一论点的支持，主要系于学者对遗嘱财产清单（对逝者财产的详细法律记录）的分析。

senses.text: 货币面值超过其生产成本所产生的利润（positive seigniorage 正铸币税）
经济学专门术语：政府凭铸币权获得的收入，SAT 经济类文章偶见

ex.src: 真题原句 · 经济 passage · 同源片段
ex.en: … Issuing a one-dollar coin yields positive seigniorage—profit generated when the face value of a coin exceeds the unit cost of producing it …
ex.zh: 发行一美元硬币可产生正铸币税——即硬币面值超过其单位生产成本所产生的利润——供新加坡政府用于交通等公共服务。

senses.text: 某事开始发生的时点（the epoch's onset 该世元的起始）
常指疾病、季节、时期的「发作、来临」；与 outset 近义

ex.en: Some geologists have proposed designating the period from 1950 to the present as a new geological epoch (the Anthropocene) characterized by human impact on Earth, but they have struggled to identify reliable stratigraphic markers of the epoch’s onset.
ex.zh: 一些地质学家提议把 1950 年至今定为一个新的地质世元（人类世），以人类对地球的影响为特征，但他们一直难以找到该世元起始的可靠地层标志。

ex.src: 卷 2063 · Module M2 · Q12 · 补充语境
ex.en: Researchers tested the hypothesis by examining a population of broadleaf arrowhead, a plant for which bloom onset generally takes longer for male flowers than for female flowers, during the flowering season.
ex.zh: 研究者通过考察一个阔叶慈姑种群来检验该假说——这种植物的雄花通常比雌花更晚开花。

senses.text: 在现实条件下做得到的（might be feasible 也许可行）
与 possible 不同：feasible 强调「资源、条件下可实现」

ex.en: While rebuilding an HZ’s physical structure (e.g., with gravel) might be feasible, is it possible to restore its biological community?
ex.zh: 重建一个 HZ 的物理结构（例如用砾石）也许可行，但能否恢复其生物群落呢？

ex.src: 卷 2101 · Module M2 · Q13 · 补充语境
ex.en: Assuming a scenario in which 10% coverage of currently eligible land by such infrastructure is feasible …
ex.zh: 假设目前可用土地中 10% 用于此类基础设施是可行的……

senses.text: 体会他人感受的能力（greater patient empathy 更强的患者共情）
与 sympathy（同情）不同：empathy 是「设身处地」，sympathy 是「为之难过」

ex.en: There is a growing belief that teaching medical students about art alongside standard science and clinical coursework helps them become more observant, develop greater patient empathy, and strengthen their communication skills.
ex.zh: 越来越多的人相信，在标准理科与临床课程之外，同时教医学生艺术，有助于他们变得更善于观察、培养更强的患者共情，并增强沟通能力。

senses.text: 与韵文相对的书面表达（the prose in his novel 他小说中的散文笔法）
prose poem 散文诗；prosaic 平淡乏味的

ex.en: For example, it is true that the prose in his novel Foundation is quite plain—we are often given only the faintest ideas of what people, objects, and settings look like.
ex.zh: 例如，他小说《基地》中的散文笔法确实相当平实——我们往往只能得到关于人物、物体与场景的最模糊的印象。

ex.src: 卷 2014 · Module M2 · Q7 · 补充语境
ex.en: His prose is workmanlike: his characters are flat and discuss ideas rather than emotions.
ex.zh: 他的文笔只是工匠水平：人物扁平，谈的是观念而非情感。

senses.text: 供研究用的生物或矿物样本（specimens of Pacific herring 太平洋鲱鱼标本）
医学语境指「化验样本」；与 sample 相比更强调「个体样本」

ex.en: To measure changes in parasite abundance over time, Chelsea Wood and colleagues counted parasite individuals preserved on specimens of Pacific herring, spotted ratfish, and six other fish species collected from Puget Sound between 1880 and 2019.
ex.zh: 为测量寄生虫丰度随时间的变化，Chelsea Wood 及同事清点了保存在太平洋鲱、斑点鼠鱼等八种鱼类标本上的寄生虫个体——这些标本于 1880 至 2019 年间采自普吉特湾。

ex.src: 卷 2003 · Module M2 · Q8 · 补充语境
ex.en: Michael G. Campana and colleagues relied on historical DNA (hDNA)—genomic data incidentally preserved in specimens housed in natural history collections—to investigate the evolutionary origins of a fungal pathogen affecting bats.
ex.zh: Michael G. Campana 及同事依赖历史 DNA——偶然保存于自然史馆藏标本中的基因组数据——来研究一种侵害蝙蝠的真菌病原体的演化起源。

senses.text: 协同演出的艺术团体（the Negro Ensemble Company 黑人剧团）
整套、整体（an ensemble cast 群像阵容）；音乐指「合奏」

ex.en: Steve Carter’s award-winning play Eden was produced in 1976 by the groundbreaking Negro Ensemble Company (NEC).
ex.zh: Steve Carter 的获奖剧作《伊甸园》（Eden）于 1976 年由具有开创意义的黑人剧团（Negro Ensemble Company，NEC）制作。

ex.src: 卷 2068 · Module M1 · Q3 · 补充语境
ex.en: Steiger Butte Drum, a family ensemble from the Klamath Tribes of the Pacific Northwest, collaborated with composer Michael Gordon to create Natural History, a work featuring traditional drumming and vocals alongside an orchestra and chorus.
ex.zh: 来自西北太平洋克拉马斯部落的家族鼓乐团 Steiger Butte Drum 与作曲家 Michael Gordon 合作创作了《自然史》——一部以传统鼓乐与人声，联袂管弦乐团与合唱团的作品。

senses.text: 用以间接代表另一事物的量（proxy indicators 替代性指标）
代理人、委托书；by proxy 通过代理

ex.en: To better understand consumer loyalty to specific online retailers, Peter Štarchon and colleagues created a survey using 58 statements as proxy indicators of customer experience with receiving goods purchased online.
ex.zh: 为更好地理解消费者对特定网络零售商的忠诚度，Peter Štarchon 及同事设计了一份问卷，用 58 项陈述作为衡量顾客网购收货体验的替代性指标。

ex.src: 卷 2071 · Module M2 · Q15 · 补充语境
ex.en: Melissa Toups et al. proposed a novel proxy: the evolution of the clothing-exclusive variant of the human-exclusive parasite Pediculus humanus (head lice), which Toups et al. date to as early as 170 Ka.
ex.zh: Melissa Toups 等人提出了一个新颖的替代指标：人类专有寄生虫（头虱）之「衣物专有变种」的演化——Toups 等人将其年代定至最早 17 万年前。

senses.text: 以彼物喻此物的修辞（metaphors and other poetic devices 隐喻及其它诗歌手法）
与 simile（明喻，用 like/as）不同：metaphor 是直接替换

ex.en: Wole Soyinka’s prose poem “Chimes of Silence” challenges the notion that prose poetry—a hybrid form that blends prose formatting with metaphors and other traditional poetic devices—ought to be contained within a single page.
ex.mark: metaphors and other traditional poetic devices
ex.zh: 沃莱·索因卡的散文诗《寂静的钟声》挑战了这样一种观念：散文诗——一种把散文排版与隐喻等传统诗歌手法相融合的混合形式——应当被限制在一页之内。

ex.src: 卷 2035 · Module M2 · Q9 · 补充语境
ex.en: Poetry in Classical Nahuatl, the language of the Aztec Empire, relies on difrasismo, or a parallel noun construction that conventionally operates as a single metaphor.
ex.zh: 古典纳瓦特尔语（阿兹特克帝国的语言）诗歌依赖 difrasismo——一种习惯上作为单一隐喻运作的平行名词结构。

senses.text: 出资支持艺术家、团体的人（the role of patron 赞助人的角色）
与 customer（顾客）不同：patron 含「庇护、扶持」意味；patronize 光顾/居高临下

ex.en: Whether resigned or not to the verdict of the public, he ceased to write plays and assumed instead the nobler role of patron to unrecognized authors and artists and to ruined managers.
ex.zh: 无论他是否接受了公众的裁决，他都不再写剧本，转而承担起更崇高的角色：为未获赏识的作家、艺术家以及破产的剧团经理充当赞助人。

senses.text: 以数量数据为基础的分析（a quantitative analysis 定量分析）
与 qualitative（定性的）相对；quantity → quantitative

ex.en: Focusing on two characteristics that are positive indices of grammatical complexity, fusion (when new phonemes arise from the merger of previously distinct ones) and informativity (languages' capacity for meaningful variation), Olena Shcherbakova and colleagues conducted a quantitative analysis for more than 1,300 languages and claim the outcome is inconsistent with the LNH.
ex.zh: Olena Shcherbakova 及同事聚焦于两项标志语法复杂度的正向指标——融合（新音素由原本相异的音素合并而生）与信息性（语言产生有意义变体的能力）——对 1300 多种语言做了定量分析，并声称结果与语言生态位假说不符。

ex.src: 卷 2041 · Module M2 · Q6 · 补充语境
ex.en: Meanwhile, Elizabeth von Armin's The Enchanted April, whose coherent, linear narrative structure recalls the fiction of previous centuries, attracts woefully little attention from scholars of modernism.Text 2Distant reading, or computer-assisted quantitative analysis of massive collections of digitized texts, can reveal stylistic elements that have heretofore escaped notice, despite being shared by numerous texts from the modernist period.
ex.zh: 与此同时，伊丽莎白·冯·阿尼姆的《魔幻四月》——其连贯的线性叙事结构令人想起前几个世纪的小说——却几乎得不到现代主义学者的关注。——远读，即对海量数字化文本的计算机辅助定量分析，能够揭示此前无人察觉的风格要素，尽管这些要素为现代主义时期的众多文本所共有。

senses.text: 独自生活、不成群的（from the solitary to the social 从独居到群居）
与 lonely（寂寞的）不同：solitary 是客观状态，不含情绪

ex.en: The scenario of a dwarf mongoose engaging in territorial conflict with an outgroup dwarf mongoose illustrates a major dimension of social life across animal species, from the solitary to those with complex sociality: intraspecific contact with perceived outsiders.
ex.mark: from the solitary to those with complex sociality
ex.zh: 一只侏儒獴与外来侏儒獴发生领地冲突的情景，例示了动物物种社会生活的一个重要维度：从独居到高度群居，都存在与被视为外来者的同类接触。

ex.src: 卷 2612 · Module RW · Q13 · 补充语境
ex.en: The narrator indicates that her aunt and uncle’s home in Kansas is remote and solitary, writing that ______

senses.text: 唯一一次、不重复的（the singular nature 单一性）
与 single 不同：singular 强调「独一无二、罕见」；语法中指单数

ex.en: Accounts of American revolutionary history often imply that the US Declaration of Independence (published in 1776) was a document that specifically resulted from the presumably exceptional nature of the soon‑to‑be United States—in this interpretation, the Declaration is a singular instrument born from a response to injustice that was intended to announce the birth of a new kind of nation and win foreign allies to that nation’s cause.
ex.zh: 关于美国革命史的叙述常常暗示，1776 年发表的《美国独立宣言》是一项独特的文献，专门诞生于即将成形的美国那想必不同寻常的特质——按此解读，《宣言》是为回应不义而诞生的独特文书，旨在宣告一个新型国家的诞生，并为这个国家的事业赢得外国盟友。

ex.src: 卷 2081 · Module M1 · Q3 · 补充语境
ex.en: By focusing on singular individuals and incidents in exhaustive detail, Paul Seaver’s Wellington’s World and other microhistories aim to show how broader phenomena were experienced at a human level.
ex.zh: 通过穷尽式地聚焦个别个体与事件，Paul Seaver 的《威灵顿的世界》等微观史力求展示宏大现象在人的尺度上是如何被经历的。

senses.text: 音乐的速度（music tempo 音乐节拍）
（活动、生活）节奏（the tempo of change 变化的速度）

ex.en: In a study of the effects of music tempo (as measured in beats per minute, or bpm) during exercise, participants jogged outdoors for 30 minutes while listening to Beyoncé’s “Irreplaceable” (88 bpm) continuously.
ex.zh: 在一项关于运动时音乐节拍（以每分钟拍数 bpm 计）影响的研究中，参与者一边连续听碧昂丝的《Irreplaceable》（88 bpm），一边在户外慢跑 30 分钟。

ex.src: 卷 2031 · Module M1 · Q10 · 补充语境
ex.en: Many believe that lullabies, characterized by their slow tempos, contain some acoustic features that are universally calming to infants.
ex.zh: 许多人相信，以缓慢节拍为特征的摇篮曲，含有对婴儿普遍具有安抚作用的声学特征。

senses.text: 画家使用的色彩范围（a limited color palette 有限的色彩组合）
（可供选择的）全部手段、风格范围

ex.en: Artists’ palettes—the surfaces on which painters arrange and mix their paints—can provide valuable insights into the painters’ creative processes.
ex.zh: 刻意简化的人物，配以鲜明而有限的色彩。

ex.src: 卷 2040 · Module M1 · Q18 · 补充语境
ex.en: Contrasting a high saturation color palette against dark paper and stoneware, Atlanta-based artist Jiha Moon creates fused pieces, wherein Korean folk art, Western contemporary art, and global popular culture mix.
ex.zh: 以高饱和配色对照深色纸张与炻器，驻亚特兰大的艺术家 Jiha Moon 创作出融合之作：韩国民间艺术、西方当代艺术与全球流行文化在其中交汇。

senses.text: 资金的花费（taxable expenditures 应税支出）
比 expense 更正式，常指机构、政府层面的开支

ex.en: … by Reason,2003-2005 80 70 60 50 40 30 20 10 Percentage of total penalty 0 self-dealing uted income expenditures taxable expenditures undistributed income ress business holdings ess business Reason for tax penalty ■2003□2004■2005 While US public charities …
ex.zh: （图表：2003–2005 年提交 4720 表的私人基金会各类原因税务处罚占比）……而美国的公共慈善机构（如国际仁人家园）必须每年向国税局（IRS）申报 990 表……

senses.text: 教士群体的总称（a high-ranking clergy member 一位高级神职人员）
集合名词，单复数同形；与 laity（平信徒）相对

ex.en: Charles James is the son of a high-ranking clergy member. Charles James was an exact and careful boy; he never committed himself; he well knew how much was expected from the eldest son of the Archdeacon of Barchester; and was therefore mindful not to mix too freely with other boys.
ex.zh: 查尔斯·詹姆斯是一位高级神职人员的儿子。他是个一丝不苟、行事谨慎的男孩，从不轻易表态；他深知作为巴切斯特副主教的长子，人们对他期许有多高，因此留心不与其他男孩过分厮混。

senses.text: 认为某事物卑劣而不屑一顾（repudiated with contempt 被轻蔑地否弃）
contempt for 而非 contempt to；形容词 contemptuous

ex.src: 真题原句 · 同源片段
ex.en: … was something to be repudiated with contempt, like a mirror trick.
ex.zh: 在密西西比乡下，一个被称为「陌生人」的男人正走在一群他圈在围栏里的野性花斑马之间。那些马在栏中甩动、旋转，像碗里晕头转向的鱼。此前这围栏看似很大，但此刻，那么多暴烈的动能竟然都发生在一道围栏之内，这念头让人觉得可鄙，像变戏法一样该被轻蔑地否弃。

senses.text: 引导行为的外部线索（an additional cue 额外的线索）
on cue 恰在此时；v. 给…提示（cue the music）

ex.en: Researchers Ximena Bernal and Priyanka de Silva wondered if the calls alone are sufficient for midges to locate the frogs or if midges use carbon dioxide emitted by frogs as an additional cue to their prey's whereabouts, like mosquitoes do.
ex.zh: 研究者 Ximena Bernal 与 Priyanka de Silva 想知道：仅凭鸣声是否足以让蠓找到青蛙，还是蠓会像蚊子那样，把青蛙排出的二氧化碳当作定位猎物的额外线索。

ex.src: 卷 2087 · Module M2 · Q13 · 补充语境
ex.en: In the wild, crustose coralline algae (CCA) promote growth in the healthy reefs they inhabit by releasing lipids and other metabolites—chemical cues that trigger coral larvae settlement.
ex.zh: 在野外，壳状珊瑚藻通过释放脂质与其他代谢物——触发珊瑚幼虫附着的化学信号——促进其栖居的健康珊瑚礁的生长。

senses.text: 直接向消费者销售商品的商家（an online retailer 网络零售商）
retail 零售 → retailer；与 wholesaler（批发商）相对

ex.en: For example, a marketing study simply trying to identify the average amount customers spend per transaction at an online retailer has a straightforward central question that doesn’t require many years of data collection.
ex.zh: 例如，一项只想弄清顾客在某网络零售商处每笔交易平均消费额的营销研究，其核心问题十分直接，并不需要多年数据收集。

ex.src: 卷 2059 · Module M2 · Q12 · 补充语境
ex.en: But in one of the experiments, Sevilla and Townsend arranged the same jewelry with different levels of intervening space at an upscale retailer (Tiffany & Co.) and a relatively inexpensive retailer (Forever 21).
ex.zh: 在其中一项实验里，Sevilla 与 Townsend 把相同的珠宝以不同的间距陈列，分别放在高档零售商（蒂芙尼）和相对平价的零售商（Forever 21）。

senses.text: 织物、纺织材料（textile artist 纺织艺术家）
纺织的；textile industry 纺织业

ex.en: When using hairy coneflower for dyeing cloth, textile artists first soak it in water to release its color.
ex.zh: 用毛金光菊染布时，纺织艺术家首先把它泡入水中以释出颜色。

ex.src: 卷 2092 · Module M2 · Q1 · 补充语境
ex.en: Developed in the Edo period (1603‑1868) in Japan to mend clothing and domestic textiles, sashiko uses tightly spaced rows of stitching to beautify and reinforce worn cloth.
ex.zh: 刺子绣于江户时代（1603-1868）创于日本，本为修补衣物与家用织品，以细密成排的针脚美化并加固磨损的布料。

senses.text: 因不谙世事而天真、轻信的（naive to the new medium 对这种新媒介毫无概念）
与 gullible（易受骗的）不同；席勒美学中与 sentimental 相对

ex.en: When the 50-second-long film Arrival of the Train—which depicts what its title says, a train pulling into a station—was first shown publicly in 1896, spectators, naive to the new medium of film and seeing a train appearing to come directly at them, leaped from their seats and fled the room.
ex.mark: naive to the new medium of film
ex.zh: 1896 年，那部 50 秒的影片《火车进站》——内容正如片名所说，一列火车驶入车站——首次公开放映时，观众对这种新生的电影媒介毫无概念，看到火车仿佛直冲自己驶来，纷纷从座位上跳起、逃出放映厅。

ex.src: 卷 2034 · Module M1 · Q8 · 补充语境
ex.en: Our belief that the coming of film was transformative is so strong that we invented and keep retelling a founding myth that divides cultural history into a (naive) “before” and (sophisticated) “after.”
ex.zh: 我们对「电影的到来具有变革性」这一信念如此强烈，以至于发明并不断重述一个奠基神话，把文化史切成（素朴的）「之前」与（成熟的）「之后」。

senses.text: 看、注视（多用于书面、庄重语境）（I behold these steep and lofty cliffs 我凝望这些陡峭高耸的崖壁）
古雅、文学化； behold! 看哪！

ex.en: Once again Do I behold these steep and lofty cliffs, Which on a wild secluded scene impress Thoughts of more deep seclusion; and connect The landscape with the quiet of the sky.
ex.mark: I behold these steep and lofty cliffs
ex.zh: 我又一次凝望这些陡峭高耸的崖壁，它们在一片荒野幽僻的景致上，印下更深的幽居之思，并把这片山水与天空的宁静连成一体。

senses.text: 以为、料想（reckon sth to be）；名词 reckoning 清算、估算
计算、估算；reckon with 应对、考虑到

ex.en: The Reckoning and Resilience (2022) exhibition at Duke University's Nasher Museum of Art was the first to focus entirely on North Carolina artists since the exhibition Across County Lines four years earlier.
ex.zh: 杜克大学纳舍尔艺术博物馆 2022 年的展览《Reckoning and Resilience》，是自四年前的《Across County Lines》以来首个完全聚焦北卡罗来纳州艺术家的展览。

ex.src: 卷 2032 · Module M2 · Q8 · 补充语境
ex.en: Any assessment of the state of contemporary poetry must reckon with the professionalization of the field.
ex.zh: 任何对当代诗歌现状的评估，都必须直面这一领域的职业化。

senses.text: 与空间分布、尺度相关的（across spatial scales 跨越不同空间尺度）
与 temporal（时间的）相对；名词 spatiality 空间性

ex.en: Because research tends to focus on large-scale effects in cities, decision-makers may be unaware that those outcomes are not always generalizable across spatial scales.
ex.zh: 由于研究往往聚焦城市中的大规模效应，决策者可能并不知道这些结果未必能跨空间尺度推广。

ex.src: 卷 2089 · Module M1 · Q4 · 补充语境
ex.en: Animal dispersers may congregate at varying distances from parent trees, may carry seeds for varying lengths of time, and may have idiosyncratic spatial trajectories.
ex.zh: 动物传播者可能在距母树不同距离处聚集，携带种子的时长各异，行进的空间轨迹也各有癖性。

senses.text: 补充而使整体更完善（complementing its surroundings 与周边环境相得益彰）
与 compliment（称赞）同音异义；形容词 complementary 互补的

ex.en: A two- dimensional photograph, however, cannot capture how a building interacts with its surroundings, whether by complementing, blending in with, or perhaps even clashing with sights and activities nearby.
ex.zh: 然而，一张二维照片无法呈现建筑与周边环境的关系——它是与近旁的景物和活动相得益彰、融为一体，还是格格不入。

ex.src: 卷 2111 · Module M2 · Q19 · 补充语境
ex.en: Computational models can be used to analyze biological mechanisms, complementing the findings of direct experimentation.
ex.zh: 计算模型可用于分析生物机制，与直接实验的发现互为补充。

senses.text: 当前在任、在位的（incumbent cities 原有城市）
be incumbent on sb 是某人的职责；n. 现任者

ex.en: Based on the data, the researchers concluded that growth of the manufacturing sector in these counties during this period mainly occurred outside incumbent cities.
ex.zh: 基于这些数据，研究者得出结论：这一时期这些县制造业的增长主要发生在原有城市之外。

senses.text: 值得相信的（more credible than messages from doctors 比医生的信息更可信）
与 credulous（轻信的）、creditable（值得称赞的）区分
