senses.text: 派驻他国的最高外交代表（the US ambassador 美国大使）
代表、使者（a goodwill ambassador 亲善大使）

ex.en: Both are works by proven masters-James had published The Portrait ofa Lady (1881);Scorsese had directed Taxi Driver (1976)—who began to make demanding works, such as James's The Ambassadors (1903) and Scorsese's Silence (2016),that ask more of their audiences than their earlier works do but give more in return.
ex.zh: 两者都出自已被证明的大师之手——詹姆斯已出版《一位女士的画像》（1881），斯科塞斯已执导《出租车司机》（1976）——而他们随后都开始创作要求更高的作品。

senses.text: 为解决某问题而发起的计划（initiatives that rely on natural features 依托自然特征的倡议）
主动性、进取心（take the initiative 主动出击）

ex.en: Conservationists worldwide are working to protect ecosystems from habitat destruction and biodiversity loss, and in many cases, initiatives that rely on natural features or processes can help address such challenges.
ex.zh: 世界各地的保育工作者正努力保护生态系统免遭栖息地破坏与生物多样性丧失，许多倡议依托自然特征……

ex.src: 卷 2100 · Module M2 · Q16 · 补充语境
ex.en: A premortem is an exercise in which teams imagine their initiative has already failed, then brainstorm possible reasons for that failure.
ex.zh: 事前验尸是一种练习：团队假想自己的计划已经失败，然后头脑风暴失败的可能原因。

senses.text: 努力所要达成的结果（a key objective 关键目标）
/əbˈdʒektɪv/ 客观的（objective documentation 客观记录）

ex.en: Increasing stony coral colonies worldwide is a key objective for ecologists, since land-based runoff and other pressures are causing growing harm to reefs.
ex.zh: 增加全球石珊瑚群落数量是生态学者的关键目标，因为陆源径流及其他压力正日益损害珊瑚礁。

ex.src: 卷 2611 · Module M2A · Q18 · 补充语境
ex.en: These data provide objective measurements for evaluating both process and product quality.

senses.text: 从过去传承下来的文化或自然财富（the National Heritage Fellowship 国家传统艺术基金）
heritage 强调「传承下来的文化资产」；inheritance 强调「继承的财产」

ex.en: The National Heritage Fellowship was created to raise public awareness about exceptional folk and traditional artists in the United States.
ex.zh: 国家传统艺术基金的设立，旨在提高公众对美国杰出民间与传统艺术家的认识。

ex.src: 卷 2056 · Module M2 · Q2 · 补充语境
ex.en: From the traditional stories of the Kanaka Maoli, or Native Hawaiian people, to the works of writers such as David Malo, the literary heritage of Hawaiʻi is distinctive and vibrant.
ex.zh: 从卡纳卡毛利人（即夏威夷原住民）的传统故事，到 David Malo 等作家的作品，夏威夷的文学遗产独特而生机勃勃。

senses.text: 某一语言使用的书写体系（the cuneiform script 楔形文字）
剧本；笔迹；动词「编写剧本」

ex.src: 真题原句 · 同源片段
ex.en: … to be written using the cuneiform script …
ex.zh: 苏美尔语是最早使用楔形文字书写的语言之一。

senses.text: 前人留下并持续产生影响的事物（the legacy of the painter 那位画家的遗产）
与 heritage 近义，但 legacy 更强调「留下的影响」而非「被继承的传统」

ex.en: The image calls attention to the album’s title song, in which Mitchell sings about the legacy of the postimpressionist painter.
ex.zh: 这张图像使人注意到专辑的同名歌曲——米切尔在其中歌唱那位后印象派画家的遗产。

ex.src: 卷 2001 · Module M2 · Q19 · 补充语境
ex.en: As mastermind of the university’s architecture and curriculum, Jefferson assured that his legacy was sound.
ex.zh: 作为大学建筑与课程的总设计师，杰斐逊确保了自己留下的遗产根基稳固。

senses.text: 一国流通的交换媒介（foreign currency reserves 外汇储备）
通用、流行（gain currency 流传开来）

ex.en: In pre-Columbian Mesoamerica, obsidian was used as a commodity currency.
ex.zh: 在前哥伦布时期的中美洲，黑曜石曾被用作商品货币（commodity currency）。

ex.src: 卷 2036 · Module M1 · Q7 · 补充语境
ex.en: "Culture" has considerable currency among sociologists but has no fixed definition: it might include art, or laws, or one of several other concepts.
ex.zh: 「文化」在社会学家中颇为流行，却没有固定定义：它可能包括艺术、法律，或若干其他概念中的任何一种。

senses.text: 货物与服务的大规模交换（the Commerce Department 商务部）
与 trade 近义，commerce 更正式、更强调体系性

ex.en: 1926: The US Congress gave the US Commerce Department authority to regulate safety standards in the fledgling commercial airline industry.
ex.zh: 1926 年，美国国会授权商务部监管新兴商业航空业的安全标准。

ex.src: 卷 2070 · Module M2 · Q3 · 补充语境
ex.en: Featuring contributions from Zulema Valdez, Bea Stotzer, and others, it explores contemporary issues while also providing context dating all the way back to the sixteenth century on Latino populations and their experiences with business and commerce.
ex.zh: 本书由 Zulema Valdez、Bea Stotzer 等人撰稿，既探讨当代议题，也把拉美裔人口及其商贸经历的历史脉络一路追溯至十六世纪。

senses.text: resort to 不得已而采用（resorted to cheaper forms 转而采用更廉价的形式）
/rɪˈzɔːt/ 度假地；凭借、手段（as a last resort 作为最后手段）

ex.en: Eventually, ningyo joruri productions resorted to cheaper forms of puppetry, such as kuruma ningyo, which involves only one puppeteer.
ex.zh: 最终，人形净琉璃的演出转而采用更廉价的木偶形式，如只需一名操偶师的「车人形」。

ex.src: 卷 2078 · Module M2 · Q8 · 补充语境
ex.en: … rather than leveraging the medium’s potential to confront difficult truths, filmmakers and studios often resorted to platitudes about contemporary US society.
ex.zh: ……电影人与制片厂往往不去发掘这一媒介直面残酷真相的潜力，而是退而堆砌关于美国当代社会的陈词滥调。

senses.text: 公开交流意见的平台（provide a forum for 为…提供论坛）
古罗马的公共广场

ex.en: Since its beginning, NEC has provided a forum for the voices of Harrison and other Black playwrights through workshops and performances.
ex.zh: 自成立以来，NEC 通过工作坊与演出，为哈里森及其他黑人剧作家的声音提供了论坛。

ex.src: 卷 2059 · Module M2 · Q17 · 补充语境
ex.en: The 1948 founding of the American GI Forum and the 1946 Mendez v.
ex.zh: 1948 年美国退伍军人 GI 论坛的创立，以及 1946 年的门德斯诉……案……

senses.text: 从事经营的组织（a business enterprise 商业企业）
事业心、进取精神（a spirit of enterprise 进取精神）

ex.src: 真题原句 · 同源片段
ex.en: … prohibited from holding excess interests in a business enterprise …
ex.zh: 私人基金会不得在企业中持有超额权益，不得从事「自我交易」，也不得进行应税支出。

senses.text: 为共同目的结成的团体（the silversword alliance 银剑菊类群）
与 coalition 近义，alliance 更强调长期的利益结合

ex.en: Dubautia raillardioides is a species in a family of plants known collectively as the silversword alliance, all of which grow only on the Hawaiian Islands.
ex.zh: Dubautia raillardioides 是植物学上统称为「银剑菊类群」的一个科中的物种，它们全部只生长在夏威夷群岛。

ex.src: 卷 2007 · Module M1 · Q6 · 补充语境
ex.en: Members of this alliance exhibit an extraordinary range of phenotypes, with some species maturing into vines and others into shrubs and trees.
ex.zh: 这一联盟的成员表型极为多样：有的物种长成藤本，有的长成灌木或乔木。

senses.text: 拥有优势地位的小群体（readings favored by elites 精英阶层偏爱的读物）
精英的、顶尖的（an elite university 顶尖大学）

ex.en: Most other contemporaneous personal manuscripts like the Findern Anthology (FA) consist primarily of pieces by celebrated medieval authors like Hoccleve and other readings favored by elites, whereas the HM has a distinctive emphasis on the popular, including entertainments like crude comedies, and the practical, with advice about manners.​​​​​​​
ex.zh: 其他同时期的私人手稿主要由著名中世纪作家的作品以及精英阶层偏爱的读物组成。

ex.src: 卷 2612 · Module RW · Q83 · 补充语境
ex.en: Most other contemporary personal manuscripts like the Barton Anthology (BA) consist primarily of pieces for polite society like genteel romances and other readings favored by elites, whereas the KM has a distinctive emphasis on the popular, including entertainments like parody romances, and the practical, with advice a

senses.text: 按前述顺序一一对应（71 seconds and 87 seconds respectively 分别为 71 秒与 87 秒
respectively 要求前后项严格按顺序对应；respective 为形容词

ex.en: When exposed to the treatment, cinnabar moth caterpillars and scarce vapourer moth caterpillars remained coiled in a defensive position for an average of 71 seconds and 87 seconds, respectively, whereas European peacock butterfly caterpillars continued to flail defensively for 20 seconds.
ex.zh: 接触处理物后，朱砂蛾与稀薄尺蛾的幼虫平均分别保持防御卷曲姿势 71 秒与 87 秒。

ex.src: 卷 2032 · Module M2 · Q11 · 补充语境
ex.en: Subjects included flies identified by mutations silencing DptA, DptB, or both DptA and DptB (termed types A, B, and AB, respectively).
ex.zh: 受试果蝇包括 DptA 被沉默突变体、DptB 被沉默突变体，以及两者同时被沉默的突变体（分别称为 A 型、B 型与 AB 型）。

senses.text: 作品或人的初次登场（debut novels 处女作小说）
make one's debut 首次亮相；注意法语来源，t 不发音

ex.en: Debut novels are especially interesting to literary critics (people whose job it is to evaluate books) and readers because these books offer a look at new voices in the literary world.
ex.zh: 处女作小说尤其令文学批评家与读者感兴趣，因为这些书让人得以一窥文学界的新声音。

ex.src: 卷 2004 · Module M2 · Q25 · 补充语境
ex.en: Argentum debuted in 2018 at the Bronx Museum of the Arts in New York City, New York..
ex.zh: 《Argentum》于 2018 年在纽约市布朗克斯艺术博物馆首展。

senses.text: 依法拘押（the recent arrest of his brother 他兄弟近来的被捕）
阻止、抑制（arrest the decline 遏止下滑）；吸引（arrest attention 引起注意）

ex.en: Richard is reflecting on the recent arrest of his brother, the Duke of Clarence, on suspicion of treason against King Edward IV.
ex.zh: 理查德正在回想兄长——克拉伦斯公爵——近日因涉嫌叛国而被捕一事。

senses.text: 仅限于特定对象或来源的（almost exclusively derives from biological sources 几乎只来自生物来源）
高档的、专属的（an exclusive club 高级会所）

ex.en: Despite potential independent confirmation, the apparent detection in 2020 of phosphine (PH₃)—a gas that on Earth almost exclusively derives from biological sources—in Venus’s cloud deck remains controversial, in part because Venus is thought to be uninhabitable.
ex.zh: 尽管可能存在独立验证，2020 年对磷化氢（一种在地球上几乎只来自生物来源的气体）的表观探测……

ex.src: 卷 2001 · Module M2 · Q13 · 补充语境
ex.en: This cactus thrives exclusively in the specific climate conditions found within a certain state, with documented occurrences limited to the central region of the state.
ex.zh: 这种仙人掌只在某州境内的特定气候条件下繁茂生长，有记录的分布仅限于该州中部地区。

senses.text: 用以衡量某现象的量化标准（indexed by age bracket 按年龄段编制指数）
索引；动词「编制索引、按指数调整」

ex.en: The table presents percentages of people who make particular kinds of New Year's resolutions among those who choose to make them, indexed by age bracket.
ex.zh: 该表呈现的是：在愿意制定新年计划的人群中，各类计划所占的百分比，并按年龄段编制指数。

ex.src: 卷 2092 · Module M2 · Q11 · 补充语境
ex.en: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​P50—the pressure in the xylem (water‑conducting tissue) at which a plant loses 50% of its hydraulic conductivity due to embolisms (air bubbles in the water flow)—is a key index of xylem embolism resistance and, by extension, tolerance of water stress; lower P50 values indicate lower vulnerability to xylem embolisms.
ex.zh: P50——植物木质部（输水组织）因栓塞（水流中的气泡）而失去 50% 导水率时的压力——是木质部抗栓塞能力、进而也是耐旱能力的关键指标；P50 越低，木质部越不易栓塞。

senses.text: 有组织的安排或计划（the small world's scheme 这个小世界的运作方式）
英式英语中 scheme 常中性指「方案」；美式常含「阴谋」色彩

ex.en: At night in bed I rehearsed the small world’s scheme and set challenges: Find the store using backyards only.
ex.zh: 夜里躺在床上，我反复推演这个小世界的运作方式，并给自己设下挑战：只靠后院找到那家商店。

ex.src: 卷 2059 · Module M2 · Q19 · 补充语境
ex.en: Scheme is referred to as a compiled programming language because it typically incorporates a compiler—a tool that translates lines of code into executable commands.
ex.zh: Scheme 之所以被称为编译型语言，是因为它通常内置编译器——一种把代码行翻译成可执行指令的工具。

senses.text: 正式通过的决定，或坚定的意愿（New Year's resolutions 新年决心）
（图像）分辨率；解决（conflict resolution 冲突解决）

ex.en: Hydrologist Yonghong Yi and her colleagues modeled seasonal changes in net CO₂ in Alaska in a landscape grid of 1 square kilometer (km²) cells and again in a grid of 10 km² cells, which are finer resolutions than most models of net CO₂ have achieved.
ex.zh: 水文学家 Yonghong Yi 及其同事先以 1 平方公里、再以 10 平方公里的网格，建模模拟阿拉斯加净 CO₂ 的季节变化——这样的分辨率比大多数净 CO₂ 模型所达到的都要精细。

ex.src: 卷 2102 · Module M1 · Q5 · 补充语境
ex.en: High-resolution images show these eruptions produce thin streams of hot gas moving at speeds between 55 and 200 kilometers per second.
ex.zh: 高分辨率图像显示，这些喷发产生细束状热气流，速度在每秒 55 至 200 公里之间。

senses.text: 正式记录在案（a registered trademark 注册商标）
显示出、流露出（register surprise 显出惊讶）；名词「登记簿、语域」

ex.en: In the US, "Q-tips" is a registered trademark of the company Unilever.
ex.zh: 在美国，「Q-tips」是联合利华公司的注册商标。

ex.src: 卷 2110 · Module M1 · Q26 · 补充语境
ex.en: In 2021, there were a total of1,051 merchant vessels registered in Cyprus. ·The combined DWT of these vessels was 34 million tons.
ex.zh: 2021 年，在塞浦路斯注册的商船共 1,051 艘；这些船舶的载重吨位合计 3,400 万吨。

senses.text: 竞赛中的优胜者（a defending champion 卫冕冠军）
拥护、捍卫（champion a cause 捍卫某项事业）

ex.en: Though John Crowley, author of Flint and Mirror, is perhaps not as well known as the most commercially successful American writers of the past fifty years, his work has had several influential champions, including the poet James Merrill and the literary critic Harold Bloom.
ex.zh: 尽管《燧石与镜子》的作者约翰·克劳利或许不如过去五十年间商业上最成功的美国作家那样广为人知，但他的作品一直……

ex.src: 卷 2020 · Module M2 · Q22 · 补充语境
ex.en: During the 1952 New York ticker-tape parade for US Olympic champions, the ribbonlike swirls descending on the scene were paper spools from “tickers," telegraph machines used to transmit stock prices.
ex.zh: 1952 年纽约为美国奥运冠军举行的纸带游行中，如彩带般盘旋而下的，是「行情机」——用于传送股价的电报机——吐出的纸卷。

senses.text: 正式委托某人制作某物（commissioned the Luttrell Psalter 委托制作《卢特雷尔诗篇》）
委员会；佣金（a sales commission 销售佣金）

ex.en: Sir Geoffrey Luttrell commissioned the Luttrell Psalter, a celebrated document of religious songs and images of life in medieval England. Not all of Luttrell's actions were admirable, however.
ex.zh: 杰弗里·卢特雷尔爵士委托制作了《卢特雷尔诗篇》——一部著名的宗教歌咏与中世纪英格兰生活图像文献。

ex.src: 卷 2038 · Module M2 · Q4 · 补充语境
ex.en: The first public library became available in Rome in 28 BCE and was soon followed by one commissioned by Emperor Augustus.
ex.zh: 第一座公共图书馆于公元前 28 年在罗马向公众开放，不久之后奥古斯都大帝又敕建了一座。
